# End a Social Round Early — Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Let the scorer of a social round end it after any number of complete holes, with a proper result (leader wins, level = halved), no handicap impact, correct side-game settlement and stats, working offline.

**Architecture:**
- A new `rounds.holes_played` column records how many holes were played. NULL means the round was played as planned.
- The scoring store keeps the **planned** holes, so daily-handicap math is unchanged, and gains a `holesPlayed` count. Anything that renders, validates or counts holes remaining slices to the played holes via `filterPlayableHoles`.
- A pending end-early is held in a local, persisted record until submit.
- On submit, a `SECURITY DEFINER` RPC sets the column and trims side-game rows. Offline, it runs from a new queued "finalise round" sync item, which also fixes offline-submitted rounds never completing.
- A card-level `isCompleteForHandicap` gate keeps partial cards out of handicap at every differential site.
- **Part A** (Tasks A1a–A6c) is a set of standalone bug fixes the feature builds on, and can merge on its own.
- **Part B** (Tasks B1a–B11) is the feature.
- The Task Index below gives the run order. The Contract amendments override the Interface Contract where they differ.

**Tech Stack:** Expo SDK 54 / React Native / TypeScript, Zustand (+ `persist` with AsyncStorage), React Query, Expo SQLite (offline DAOs), Supabase (Postgres + RLS + RPC), Jest (`jest-expo`), pnpm.

**Spec:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-07-end-round-early-design.md`. Read the whole thing. **"Revision 2" (R1–R11) overrides the earlier sections** wherever they conflict.

## Global Constraints

- **Scope:** social (standalone) rounds only, i.e. `rounds.competition_id IS NULL`. Competition rounds must behave exactly as today.
- **Who can end:** "End round early" shows only when every one of these holds:
  - the round is standalone;
  - the round is `in-progress`;
  - the device scores **every** player in the round: store `allowedPlayerIds` is empty **or** contains every `currentPlayers` id (`ScorecardEntryScreen` always fills it);
  - at least 1 hole is complete for every player;
  - not every planned hole is complete.
- **N** = the number of leading holes, in hole order from the round's first hole, where every player has `strokes > 0`. A pickup (`strokes === PICKUP_SCORE`, 10) counts as scored. Scores on later holes are removed.
- **Exactly 9 of 18** (`nineType 'full'`, N = 9) converts the round to `front9` with `holes_played = NULL`. Every other N sets `holes_played = N`.
- **Handicap:** an early-ended card never gets a `handicap_differential`. Only a full 18 or a combined pair of 9s counts towards the index.
  - A card with **no per-hole data at all** keeps today's gross-based behaviour (legacy).
- **Match result:**
  - No holes remaining ⇒ "N UP" (`calculateMatchStatus` casing: `'N up'`), or All Square / "A/S". Never "N & 0" / "N&0". This applies to all matches (R7).
  - Ended-early: a real close-out against the **planned** holes stands; otherwise the final lead after N wins.
- **Net:** an early-ended card's `total_net` = Σ(gross − strokes received) over the holes played. `daily_handicap_used` stays the planned round's daily handicap. Complete cards are unchanged.
- **Skins** hole values are priced on the planned hole count. The settlement buy-in is `calculateTotalPot(type, value, planned) × holesPlayed / planned / participants`. Settlement must be zero-sum.
- **Wolf:** trim decisions after N and display "of N holes". Do **not** wire Wolf finalisation.
- **Copy** (exact strings):
  - "End round early" — menu item and sheet title.
  - "End round after hole {lastHoleNumber}?"
  - "Ended after {N} of {M}" — label and banner text, where M = `getHoleCount(nineType)`.
  - "Resume playing".
  - "This round won't count towards your handicap index."
  - "This becomes a front-9 round. Results are recalculated on 9-hole handicaps."
- **UI rules (CLAUDE.md):**
  - Colours come from `useThemeColors()`; static tokens are imported from `@/constants/theme`.
  - **Never** use Paper `Button`; use `TouchableOpacity`.
  - Every RN `<Modal>` / `presentation: 'modal'` subtree is wrapped in `<SystemModalTheme>` (`@/components/common`).
  - Touch targets are ≥ 44px.
- **Offline-first:** ending early and submitting must work with no network. Server writes are queued.
- **Scoring guardrails (CLAUDE.md).** Before editing any file under:
  - `src/services/scoring`
  - `src/store/{scorecardStore,scoreUpdateSlice,initializeRoundSlice}.ts`
  - the shared scoring utils
  - `src/components/scorecard/**`

  read `docs/guides/SCORING_ARCHITECTURE.md` and run the `scoring-impact-analyst` agent on the file. Lock unprotected behaviour with a characterization test **before** changing it. Blast-radius findings from planning are summarised in "Scoring guardrail notes" below.
- **Test subset.** Run after every task:
  ```bash
  pnpm test --testPathPattern='(golden|parity|services/scoring|utils/(scoring|dailyHandicap|subMatches|scorecardCalculations|holeTransformers|adjustedGross|matchMargin|matchPlayResult|handicapEligibility|roundShape|endRoundEarly)|components/scorecard|store/|services/offline|services/handicap|services/rounds|integration/(scoringFlow|matchPlayScorecard)|hooks/scorecard|MatchPlayScoringScreen|MatchPlayScorecardScreen|TeamMatchPlayScoringScreen|ReviewScorecardScreen|SubMatchLeaderboardTab|subMatchLeaderboard|skins|wolf)'
  ```
  Expected: all green, apart from pre-existing failures recorded in Task 0. Then run `pnpm type-check`. Run `pnpm verify:gate` at the end of each Part.
- **Git:**
  - Work only in this worktree (`.claude/worktrees/end-round-early`, branch `worktree-end-round-early`).
  - Commit after each task. Every commit message ends with:

## Review Focus

These are the input classes most likely to bite a real user that the spec implies but no other test covers. Each line names the task that adds its test.

1. **Relaunch after ending early offline, before submitting.** The app is killed with no signal. On relaunch the round must reopen still ended after N, with the removed scores still gone, and land on the finish screen. It must not reappear as a full round with holes N+1… re-enabled. **Test owners: B3c** (store init with a persisted record and a failed metadata fetch) and **B6b** (the redirect to the finish screen).
2. **Back-9 round ended after 6.**
   - Played holes are 10–15 everywhere.
   - The RPC trims side-game rows for holes > 15, not > 6.
   - The label reads "Ended after 6 of 9".
   - **Test owners:** B2 (`filterPlayableHoles`, `lastPlayedHoleNumber`) and B1a (RPC SQL uses `lastPlayedHoleNumber` semantics; its verification script checks the offset).
3. **Resume, then finish normally.** After Resume (**test owner: B3b**):
   - the local record is cleared;
   - all planned holes are back (including after a front-9 conversion);
   - a relaunch does not re-apply the end;
   - submit again requires every hole.

4. **Pickup on the boundary hole.** A pickup on hole N counts as complete, so N includes it. A pickup alone on hole N+1 is removed. **Test owner: B2** (`planEndRoundEarly`).
5. **A round scored on two phones.** A round where this device doesn't score every player must not offer "End round early". **Test owner: B6b** (`useEndRoundEarly` → `canEndRoundEarly` false when `allowedPlayerIds` is a strict subset of the round's players; true when it covers them all).

## Interface Contract

Every task uses exactly these names and types. A task that **produces** an item creates it; tasks that **consume** it import it as written.

### Pure utilities (B2 produces; A3 produces `handicapEligibility`)

```ts
// src/utils/holeTransformers.ts  (B2) — added beside filterHolesByNineType
/** filterHolesByNineType, then — when holesPlayed is a positive integer — sort by
 *  hole number and keep the first `holesPlayed`. null/undefined/<=0 ⇒ identical to
 *  filterHolesByNineType (no sort). */
export function filterPlayableHoles(holes: Hole[], nineType: NineType, holesPlayed?: number | null): Hole[];

// src/utils/roundShape.ts  (B2, new)
export interface EndedEarlyRecord {
  holesPlayed: number;        // N, counted from the round's first hole
  convertToFront9: boolean;   // true only for nineType 'full' ended at exactly 9
  originalNineType: NineType; // nine type before ending (Resume restores it)
  endedAt: string;            // ISO timestamp
}
export interface RoundShape { nineType: NineType; holesPlayed: number | null }
/** Local record wins: convertToFront9 ⇒ { 'front9', null }; else { server nine_type ?? 'full', local.holesPlayed }.
 *  No local record ⇒ { server.nine_type ?? 'full', server.holes_played ?? null }. */
export function resolveRoundShape(
  server: { nine_type?: NineType | null; holes_played?: number | null } | null | undefined,
  local?: EndedEarlyRecord | null,
): RoundShape;
export function firstHoleNumber(nineType: NineType): number;                        // back9 ⇒ 10, else 1
export function lastPlayedHoleNumber(nineType: NineType, holesPlayed: number): number; // firstHoleNumber + N − 1
export function isEndedEarly(round: { holes_played?: number | null } | null | undefined): boolean;
export function formatEndedEarlyLabel(holesPlayed: number, nineType: NineType): string; // "Ended after 6 of 9"

// src/utils/endRoundEarly.ts  (B2, new)
export interface EndRoundEarlyRemovedScore { playerId: string; playerName: string; holeNumber: number }
export interface EndRoundEarlyPlan {
  holesPlayed: number;       // N
  plannedHoles: number;      // getHoleCount(nineType)
  nineType: NineType;        // the round's nine type at the time of ending
  convertToFront9: boolean;
  lastHoleNumber: number;    // lastPlayedHoleNumber(nineType, N)
  removedScores: EndRoundEarlyRemovedScore[];
}
export function isHoleScored(score: HoleScore | MultiBallHoleScore | null | undefined): boolean; // strokes > 0 (any ball for multi-ball)
/** null when no hole is complete for every player, or when every planned hole is complete. */
export function planEndRoundEarly(input: {
  holes: Hole[];                                     // planned holes (store `holes`)
  nineType: NineType;
  players: { id: string; name: string }[];
  scorecards: Map<string, { scores: Scorecard['scores'] }>;
}): EndRoundEarlyPlan | null;

// src/utils/handicapEligibility.ts  (A3, new)
/** Planned holes come from getHoleRange(nineType) — NEVER from a hole list.
 *  scores null/undefined/{} (no per-hole data) ⇒ true (legacy gross-only card).
 *  Otherwise true iff every hole in the range has strokes > 0 (number or {strokes}; multi-ball: any ball). */
export function isCompleteForHandicap(
  scores: Record<string | number, unknown> | null | undefined,
  nineType: NineType,
): boolean;

// src/utils/matchPlayResult.ts  (A1 produces; B5 adds holesPlayed)
export interface StandaloneMatchResult { winnerId: string | null; winnerName: string; margin: string }
/** Extracted from useRoundList.computeMatchPlayResult. Margins via formatMatchMargin ('2&3', '2 UP', 'A/S'). */
export function computeStandaloneMatchResult(
  p1: ScorecardForMatchPlay, p2: ScorecardForMatchPlay, holes: Hole[], holesPlayed?: number | null,
): StandaloneMatchResult | null;

// src/utils/skins/holeCounts.ts  (A5, new)
export interface SkinsHoleCounts { plannedHoles: number; holesPlayed: number }
export function getSkinsHoleCounts(
  round: { nine_type?: NineType | null; holes_played?: number | null } | null | undefined,
): SkinsHoleCounts; // planned = getHoleCount(nine_type ?? 'full'); played = holes_played ?? planned
```

### Match status (A1 fixes ordering, A2 threads totalHoles, B5 adds holesPlayed)

```ts
// src/screens/scoring/MatchPlayScoringScreen/utils/matchPlayCalculations.ts
export function calculateMatchStatus(
  holeResults: Record<number, HoleResult>, totalHoles: number = 18, holesPlayed?: number | null,
): MatchStatus;
// src/screens/scoring/TeamMatchPlayScoringScreen/utils/teamMatchPlayCalculations.ts
export function calculateTeamMatchStatus(
  holeResults: Record<number, TeamHoleResult>, totalHoles: number = 18, holesPlayed?: number | null,
): TeamMatchStatus;
```

`totalHoles` is always the **planned** count. `holesPlayed` (B5) means the round ended after that many holes. If the match wasn't closed out against the planned holes and `holesPlayed` decided holes exist, the result is complete with the final lead: `'N up'` or `'All Square'`.

`finalizeRoundStatus` must report whether it completed the round. A6 changes its return type from `Promise<void>` to `Promise<boolean>`, and updates its callers.

### Database (B1)

Migration: `supabase/migrations/20261007000000_end_round_early.sql`.

- **Column:** `rounds.holes_played SMALLINT NULL`, with `CHECK (holes_played IS NULL OR holes_played > 0)`.
- **Function:** `end_round_early(p_round_id UUID, p_holes_played INT, p_convert_to_front9 BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE) RETURNS VOID`, `SECURITY DEFINER`, `SET search_path = public`. `GRANT EXECUTE … TO authenticated`.
  - **Raises unless:** the round exists and isn't deleted; `competition_id IS NULL`; and the caller is the owner or a round participant.
  - **Convert case:** sets `nine_type='front9'` and `holes_played=NULL`; last hole = 9.
  - **Otherwise:** sets `holes_played = p_holes_played`; last hole = (back9 ? 9 : 0) + N.
  - **Deletes**, for `hole_number > last hole`, the round's `skins_results`, `wolf_hole_decisions` and `score_entries`.
  - Idempotent.
- **Activity feed:** `get_activity_feed` / `get_round_feed_card` are **dropped and recreated** from their latest definitions (`20260905000150_ugc_moderation_feed.sql`). `holes_played INT` and `nine_type TEXT` are added to `RETURNS TABLE` (and to the feed CTE's SELECT + GROUP BY). COMMENTs and grants are re-added. The precedent is `20260616000000_activity_feed_course_id.sql`.

TS types to update:
- `Round.holes_played?: number | null` (`src/types/database/round.types.ts`)
- `SupabaseRoundData.holes_played?: number | null` (`src/types/supabase/roundQueries.ts`), plus `holes_played` in `ROUND_METADATA_SELECT`
- `RoundMetadata.holesPlayed: number | null` (`useRoundMetadata.ts`)
- `ActivityFeedCard.holes_played?: number | null; nine_type?: NineType | null` (`src/hooks/activity/types.ts`)

### Execution notes (cross-task seams found while assembling)

- **Snippets moved by earlier tasks.** Line numbers are from planning time. Several tasks edit code an earlier task already changed, and each says so ("as A2 leaves it", "post-B5"). When a quoted "current" snippet doesn't match exactly, apply the same substitution to the code as it now stands. Never re-introduce the earlier task's change.
- **A2c/A2d were drafted last.** Tasks B3a, B3b, B4, B7a, B9a, B9b, B9d, A5d and B8b quote code as it stood *before* A2c/A2d. Apply their changes as merges, per Appendix A → "Nine-aware live DHC", Contract note 6. The ones that change behaviour are listed below.
- **`calculatePlayerStats` options.** A2c introduces `options?: { nineType?: NineType | null }`. B4 **extends that same object** to `{ nineType?: NineType | null; holesPlayed?: number | null }`; it does not add a second param, and adds `filterPlayableHoles` to A2c's `holeTransformers` import line. B7a, B9a, B9b and `describeEndRoundEarlyResult` (B6a) pass both fields where they know them. Where B9a nine-filters the meta holes, `nineType` **must** stay in the options.
- **`PlayerTotalsContext.nineType`.** A2c adds it, plus `StoreState.nineType` and the `nineType` pass-through at the four `applyScoreUpdate` call sites (B3b adds only `holesPlayed`). B3a's `removePlayerHoleScores` reads `nineType` from `get()` and passes it in the context.
- **B3b `recomputeTotals` takes a third parameter, `nineType: NineType` (required).** The conversion calls `recomputeTotals(get(), frontNine, 'front9')`; Resume calls `recomputeTotals(state, restoredHoles, restoredNineType)`. Without it the exact-9 conversion recomputes the front 9 against the 18-hole rating (DHC 52 instead of 10). B3b's conversion tests expect the nine-aware values.
- **Review `index.tsx`.** A2d adds the `useScorecardStore` import and `const storeNineType = useScorecardStore((s) => s.nineType);`. A5d and B8b must **not** declare them again.
- **Skins / wolf cut.** B9g points B9e's two Wolf selectors at `lastCountedHoleNumber` (which also covers the exact-9 conversion). B9e's tests still hold.
- **`useScoreSubmission` ordering.** `checkRoundAchievements` (which reads the store's `holesPlayed`, B10b) runs before the shared finalise step (which clears the record, B8a), and both run before `resetRound`.
- **Converted rounds settle skins on `{ plannedHoles: 18, holesPlayed: 9 }`** (B8a), not `{9, 9}`.

## Contract amendments (from drafting — these override the Interface Contract above)

**End-early record, round shape and store**
- **`EndedEarlyRecord`** gains optional `gameType?: GameType` and `handicapSource?: HandicapSource`, filled in by `store.endRoundEarly`. They let an offline relaunch rebuild the round correctly.
- **`resolveRoundShape`:** with a local non-convert record and **no server row**, the nine type falls back to `local.originalNineType` (not `'full'`).
- **`waitForEndRoundEarlyHydration(): Promise<void>`** is exported from `src/store/endRoundEarlyStore.ts`. Init paths and the finalise step await it (capped at 2 s).
- **The store logic** lives in `src/store/endRoundEarlySlice.ts`. `scorecardStore.ts` delegates to it.
- **`fetchCourseHolesForRound`** (`initializeRoundSlice.ts`) becomes an export, as the fallback for Resume.
- **`isHoleAfterEarlyEnd(...)`** and (B9g) **`lastCountedHoleNumber(nineType, holesPlayed): number | null`** are added to `roundShape.ts`. The latter returns 9 after an exact-9 conversion and `null` when nothing is cut.
- **`applyScoreUpdate`** returns `Scorecard | null`. Score writes after N are no-ops while `holesPlayed != null`.
- **`removePlayerHoleScores`** deletes from SQLite first and throws on failure. `endRoundEarly` removes every score key after the last played hole and aborts before writing the record if the delete fails.

**End-early UI**
- **"Who can end"** means `allowedPlayerIds` is empty **or** contains every `currentPlayers` id. `ScorecardEntryScreen` always fills the list.
- **"In-progress"** is checked offline: the action is hidden if the store's `holesPlayed` is set, a record exists, or any card is terminal.
- **`useEndRoundEarly`** takes optional `teamFormat` and `getMatchContext`. It also redirects once to the finish screen when the round is already ended (Review Focus #1).
- **`EndRoundEarlySheetProps`** gains `startHole?`.
- **New helpers in `src/utils/endRoundEarly.ts`:** `describeEndRoundEarlyResult(input)` and `planFromEndedEarlyRecord(record)`. The Par preview ranks by par score.

**Match engines**
- **`calculateMatchStatus` / `calculateTeamMatchStatus` with `holesPlayed`:** walk the holes in order; the first close-out against the planned holes stands; otherwise the final lead after `holesPlayed` decided holes wins.
- **New exports:** `resolveEndedAfter` (`matchPlayResult.ts`) and `compactMatchMargin` (`matchMargin.ts`).
- **No 18 defaults:** `useTeamMatchPlayState({ totalHoles })` and the `TeamMatchPlayScoreView` `totalHoles` prop are **required**.

**Net totals and sync**
- **`calculatePlayerStats(..., options?: { nineType?, holesPlayed? })`.** With `holesPlayed`, it totals only the first N planned holes.
- **`calculateNetOverHolesPlayed(scores, playedHoles, dailyHandicap)`** is the single per-hole net formula, used by calc, sync and `recomputeScorecardTotals` (which gains an `options` param).
- **SQLite** `scorecards` gains nullable sync-metadata columns (local migrations 19–22) so the fallback sync path keeps `syncNineType` / `syncHoles` / `syncGameType` / `syncHolesPlayed` (B4).

**Handicap**
- **`calculateTeeDailyHandicap({ gaHandicap, tee, par, nineType?, gender? })`** (`src/utils/dailyHandicap.ts`, A2c) is the one live-DHC entry point. It forwards the tee's 9-hole ratings to `calculateNineAwareDailyHandicap`; with `'full'` or no `nineType` it equals `calculateGADailyHandicap`.
- **`calculatePlayerTotals`, `calculatePlayerStats` and `buildDailyHandicapMap`** narrow `holes` with `filterHolesByNineType(holes, nineType)` before Σpar. `buildDailyHandicapMap` gains a 5th param, `nineType?`.
- **`RecalculationResult`** is exported.
- **"No per-hole data"** means `scores` is null/undefined or has no keys.
- **Quick Score helpers:** `computeQuickScoreDailyHandicap` / `computeQuickScoreDifferential` (A4b). The 9-hole Quick Score DHC, net and points become nine-aware (a bug fix).

**Stats and achievements**
- **`calculateBunkerStats` / `calculateHazardStats`** take an optional third param (B10a).
- **Achievements** omit `net_score` as well as `gross_score` for ended-early rounds (B10b). `NET_MASTER` thresholds on net.

**Skins**
- **Settlement services:** `finalizeSkinsGame(gameId, holeCounts?)` and `finalizeActiveSkinsForRound(roundId, holeCounts?)`. The latter returns `{ finalized, game?, error? }`.
- **New helpers:** `fetchSkinsHoleCounts`, `calculatePlayedPot`, `DEFAULT_SKINS_HOLE_COUNTS`, `getSkinsHoleCountsForRecord`.
- **Display cut (B9g):** `buildSkinsGameSummary(game, results, payouts, holeCounts?, lastHoleNumber?)` and `filterResultsThroughHole` in `src/utils/skins/summary.ts`; `useSkinsSummary(gameId, holeCounts?, options?: { lastHoleNumber?: number | null })`. The cut happens before the carryover is derived.
- **`awardSkinsAchievements`** keeps the skins achievements firing once settlement moves into the service.

**Round finalisation**
- **`finalizeSubmittedRound`** returns `{ completed, skinsGame }`.
- **`finalizeRoundStatus`** returns `false` (no throw) on a 0-row RLS refusal.
- **All four submit paths** (Review, MatchPlayScoring, MatchPlayScorecard, PlayerScorecard) go through `finalizeOrQueueRound` / `useFinalizeSubmittedRound`. That shared step decides online vs offline with `getIsOnline()`, reads the record after hydration, passes the payload and clears the record.
- **Queued `round` items** run after card uploads in a drain. An item stays queued (no retry spent) only while this device holds unconfirmed cards for that round (`hasUnsyncedScorecardsForRound`); otherwise it is dropped.
- **End-early submits skip `checkSubmissionReadiness`** (B8b). Only the device that scores every player can end early, and the discarded `score_entries` are deleted by the RPC.

**RPC**
- **`end_round_early`** rejects N outside `1…planned−1`, and rejects convert on a back-9 round.
- It also deletes `score_mismatches` after the last played hole.
- It is added to the typed `Database['public']['Functions']`.

**Display helpers (additive)**
- `buildRoundListMeta` and `getViewRoundHoles`.
- `filterDecisionsThroughHole` and `buildWolfGameSummary`.
- `useWolfSummary(gameId, { lastHoleNumber? })`.
- `RoundSummary.roundHolesPlayed?` and `RoundSummary.nineType?`. The existing `RoundSummary.holesPlayed` keeps meaning the count of scored holes.
- `nineType?` props (A2d) on `ScorecardTable`, `ScrollableHeaderCells` and `ScorecardTabContent`; `useViewRoundPlayerData({ …, nineType? })`; `computeUserProgress` exported from `useInProgressRounds.ts`.
- `holesPlayed?` props on `ScorecardTable`, `MatchPlayScorecardTable`, `TeamMatchPlayScorecardTable`, `RoundScorecardTab`, `StatsTab`, `MatchTab` and `SubMatchLeaderboardTab` (plus `nineType?`).


and replace:

```ts
  const holesRemaining = totalHoles - holesPlayed;
  const absLead = Math.abs(player1Up);

  // Check for early finish (dormie or beyond)
  if (absLead > holesRemaining) {
    const winner = player1Up > 0 ? 'player1' : 'player2';
    const margin = `${absLead} & ${holesRemaining}`;
    return { status: 'complete', winner, margin };
  }

  // Check if all holes played
  if (holesRemaining === 0) {
    if (player1Up === 0) {
      return { status: 'complete', winner: 'halved', margin: 'All Square' };
    }
    const winner = player1Up > 0 ? 'player1' : 'player2';
    return { status: 'complete', winner, margin: `${absLead} up` };
  }
```

with:

```ts
  const holesRemaining = totalHoles - holesPlayed;
  const absLead = Math.abs(player1Up);

  // No holes left to play: the match went the distance, so the leader wins
  // "N up" and a level match is halved. This must run BEFORE the close-out
  // check — with 0 remaining any lead is "> holesRemaining", which used to
  // report a last-hole win as "N & 0" (invariant I10).
  if (holesRemaining <= 0) {
    if (player1Up === 0) {
      return { status: 'complete', winner: 'halved', margin: 'All Square' };
    }
    const winner = player1Up > 0 ? 'player1' : 'player2';
    return { status: 'complete', winner, margin: `${absLead} up` };
  }

  // Closed out early: the lead is bigger than the holes left to play.
  if (absLead > holesRemaining) {
    const winner = player1Up > 0 ? 'player1' : 'player2';
    const margin = `${absLead} & ${holesRemaining}`;
    return { status: 'complete', winner, margin };
  }
```

`src/utils/matchMargin.ts`: append after `formatMatchMargin`:

```ts

/**
 * Convert a `calculateMatchStatus` / `calculateTeamMatchStatus` margin
 * ("3 & 2", "2 up", "All Square") to the compact token above
 * ("3&2", "2 UP", "A/S"). Anything else passes through unchanged.
 */
export function compactMatchMargin(margin: string): string {
  if (margin === 'All Square') return 'A/S';
  if (margin.includes('&')) return margin.replace(/\s+/g, '');
  const up = /^(\d+)\s*up$/i.exec(margin.trim());
  return up ? `${up[1]} UP` : margin;
}
```

```tsx
/**
 * Header summary for the match. The match numbers come from the canonical
 * `calculateTeamMatchStatus` engine against the planned hole count — this
 * card only formats them ("Team A 2 UP", "Team A 2 UP (Dormie)",
 * "Team A wins 3&2", "All Square").
 */
function describeMatchStatus(
  holeResults: Map<number, 'team1' | 'team2' | 'halved'>,
  totalHoles: number,
  team1Name: string,
  team2Name: string
): { status: string; team1Holes: number; team2Holes: number; halved: number; winner: 'team1' | 'team2' | null } {
  const results: Record<number, TeamHoleResult> = {};
  holeResults.forEach((winner, holeNumber) => {
    results[holeNumber] = {
      team1Score: null,
      team2Score: null,
      team1PlayerScores: {},
      team2PlayerScores: {},
      winner,
    };
  });

  const { team1: team1Holes, team2: team2Holes, halved } = countHolesWon(results);
  const matchStatus = calculateTeamMatchStatus(results, totalHoles);
  const nameFor = (team: 'team1' | 'team2') => (team === 'team1' ? team1Name : team2Name);

  if (matchStatus.status === 'complete') {
    if (matchStatus.winner === 'halved') {
      return { status: 'All Square', team1Holes, team2Holes, halved, winner: null };
    }
    return {
      status: `${nameFor(matchStatus.winner)} wins ${compactMatchMargin(matchStatus.margin)}`,
      team1Holes,
      team2Holes,
      halved,
      winner: matchStatus.winner,
    };
  }

  if (matchStatus.leader === null) {
    return { status: 'All Square', team1Holes, team2Holes, halved, winner: null };
  }

  // Dormie: the lead equals the holes left to play.
  const isDormie = matchStatus.holesUp === matchStatus.holesRemaining;
  return {
    status: `${nameFor(matchStatus.leader)} ${matchStatus.holesUp} UP${isDormie ? ' (Dormie)' : ''}`,
    team1Holes,
    team2Holes,
    halved,
    winner: matchStatus.leader,
  };
}
```

Create `src/utils/matchPlayResult.ts`. The body is moved verbatim from `useRoundList.ts:922-1026`; only the names and exports change:

```ts
/**
 * Standalone (social) match-play result — the round-list winner row and the
 * "You: Won 4&3" pill.
 *
 * Walks the holes in order using the difference method (`getMatchPlayStrokes`,
 * invariant I1) on each scorecard's stored `daily_handicap_used`, and stops at
 * the first close-out. Self-contained so the round list can run it without the
 * full scoring engine + course/tee context.
 */

import { getMatchPlayStrokes } from '@/utils/scoring';
import { isSingleBallScore } from '@/types/database/base';
import type { Hole, HoleScore, MultiBallHoleScore } from '@/types/database/base';

/**
 * Minimal scorecard shape the match-play result needs. Match play is decided
 * hole by hole rather than from totals, so it keeps its own slice of the row.
 */
export interface ScorecardForMatchPlay {
  player_id: string;
  scores: Record<string, HoleScore | MultiBallHoleScore> | null;
  daily_handicap_used: number | null;
  player: { id: string; name: string } | null;
}

export interface StandaloneMatchResult {
  /** Winner's player id; null when halved. */
  winnerId: string | null;
  /** Winner's name, or 'Halved'. */
  winnerName: string;
  /** Compact margin token. */
  margin: string;
}

/**
 * Compute a two-player match result from raw scorecards and the round's
 * holes. Returns null when no hole has a score from both players.
 */
export function computeStandaloneMatchResult(
  p1: ScorecardForMatchPlay,
  p2: ScorecardForMatchPlay,
  holes: Hole[]
): StandaloneMatchResult | null {
  const dhc1 = p1.daily_handicap_used ?? 0;
  const dhc2 = p2.daily_handicap_used ?? 0;

  const sortedHoles = [...holes].sort((a, b) => a.number - b.number);
  const totalHoles = sortedHoles.length;

  let player1Up = 0;
  let holesPlayed = 0;

  for (const hole of sortedHoles) {
    const score1 = p1.scores?.[String(hole.number)];
    const score2 = p2.scores?.[String(hole.number)];
    const gross1 =
      score1 && isSingleBallScore(score1) && score1.strokes > 0
        ? score1.strokes
        : null;
    const gross2 =
      score2 && isSingleBallScore(score2) && score2.strokes > 0
        ? score2.strokes
        : null;
    if (gross1 == null || gross2 == null) continue;

    // Difference method: the lower-DHC player plays off scratch and the
    // higher-DHC player receives the difference on this hole.
    const { a: strokes1, b: strokes2 } = getMatchPlayStrokes(
      dhc1,
      dhc2,
      hole.strokeIndex
    );

    const net1 = gross1 - strokes1;
    const net2 = gross2 - strokes2;

    holesPlayed++;
    if (net1 < net2) player1Up++;
    else if (net2 < net1) player1Up--;

    // Early finish — match is decided when lead > holes remaining
    const holesRemaining = totalHoles - holesPlayed;
    if (Math.abs(player1Up) > holesRemaining) {
      const winnerId = player1Up > 0 ? p1.player_id : p2.player_id;
      const winnerName =
        (player1Up > 0 ? p1.player?.name : p2.player?.name) ?? 'Unknown';
      return {
        winnerId,
        winnerName,
        margin: `${Math.abs(player1Up)}&${holesRemaining}`,
      };
    }
  }

  if (holesPlayed === 0) return null;

  if (player1Up === 0) {
    return { winnerId: null, winnerName: 'Halved', margin: 'A/S' };
  }

  const absLead = Math.abs(player1Up);
  const winnerId = player1Up > 0 ? p1.player_id : p2.player_id;
  const winnerName =
    (player1Up > 0 ? p1.player?.name : p2.player?.name) ?? 'Unknown';
  const margin =
    holesPlayed === totalHoles
      ? `${absLead}up`
      : `${absLead}&${totalHoles - holesPlayed}`;

  return { winnerId, winnerName, margin };
}
```

Create `src/__tests__/utils/matchPlayResult.test.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * computeStandaloneMatchResult — the round-list match pill.
 */

import {
  computeStandaloneMatchResult,
  type ScorecardForMatchPlay,
} from '@/utils/matchPlayResult';
import { create18Holes } from '@/__tests__/utils/testFixtures';

const HOLES = create18Holes();
const FRONT_NINE = HOLES.filter((h) => h.number <= 9);

/** A scorecard with `strokes` keyed by hole number (as the DB stores them). */
function card(
  playerId: string,
  name: string | null,
  strokesByHole: Record<number, number>,
  dailyHandicap: number | null = 0
): ScorecardForMatchPlay {
  const scores: NonNullable<ScorecardForMatchPlay['scores']> = {};
  for (const [hole, strokes] of Object.entries(strokesByHole)) {
    scores[hole] = { strokes };
  }
  return {
    player_id: playerId,
    scores,
    daily_handicap_used: dailyHandicap,
    player: name ? { id: playerId, name } : null,
  };
}

/** The same stroke count on holes `from`..`to` inclusive. */
function range(from: number, to: number, strokes: number): Record<number, number> {
  const out: Record<number, number> = {};
  for (let h = from; h <= to; h++) out[h] = strokes;
  return out;
}

describe('computeStandaloneMatchResult — current behaviour (characterization)', () => {
  it('returns null when no hole has a score from both players', () => {
    const sam = card('p1', 'Sam', range(1, 3, 4));
    const dave = card('p2', 'Dave', {});
    expect(computeStandaloneMatchResult(sam, dave, HOLES)).toBeNull();
  });

  it('halves a level match as "A/S"', () => {
    const sam = card('p1', 'Sam', range(1, 18, 4));
    const dave = card('p2', 'Dave', range(1, 18, 4));
    expect(computeStandaloneMatchResult(sam, dave, HOLES)).toEqual({
      winnerId: null,
      winnerName: 'Halved',
      margin: 'A/S',
    });
  });

  it('stops at the first close-out even if later holes swing back', () => {
    // Sam wins 1-10 (10 up with 8 to play); Dave wins 11-18.
    const sam = card('p1', 'Sam', { ...range(1, 10, 3), ...range(11, 18, 5) });
    const dave = card('p2', 'Dave', { ...range(1, 10, 5), ...range(11, 18, 3) });
    expect(computeStandaloneMatchResult(sam, dave, HOLES)).toEqual({
      winnerId: 'p1',
      winnerName: 'Sam',
      margin: '10&8',
    });
  });

  it('reports an incomplete card with no close-out against the unplayed holes', () => {
```

```ts
/** Winner + compact margin for a final `player1Up` lead with `holesRemaining` unplayed. */
function toResult(
  p1: ScorecardForMatchPlay,
  p2: ScorecardForMatchPlay,
  player1Up: number,
  holesRemaining: number
): StandaloneMatchResult {
  if (player1Up === 0) {
    return { winnerId: null, winnerName: 'Halved', margin: formatMatchMargin(0, 0, true) };
  }
  const leader = player1Up > 0 ? p1 : p2;
  return {
    winnerId: leader.player_id,
    winnerName: leader.player?.name ?? 'Unknown',
    margin: formatMatchMargin(Math.abs(player1Up), holesRemaining, false),
  };
}
```

```ts
/** Scores for `holes`: player 1 cards 3 on `wonHoles` and 4 elsewhere; player 2 cards 4. */
function scoresFor(
  holes: Hole[],
  wonHoles: number[]
```

```ts
/**
 * useTeamMatchPlayState Hook Tests
 *
 * Match status is judged against the round's planned hole count
 * (`totalHoles`), so a 9-hole team match can complete.
 */

import { renderHook } from '@testing-library/react-native';
import { useTeamMatchPlayState } from './useTeamMatchPlayState';
import type { MatchTeam } from '../types';

// The hook only needs the dialog helper from the hooks barrel — use the real
// one without loading every hook in '@/hooks'.
jest.mock('@/hooks', () => ({
  useConfirmationDialog: jest.requireActual('@/hooks/useConfirmationDialog').useConfirmationDialog,
}));

type Winner = 'team1' | 'team2' | 'halved' | null;

interface HoleProps {
  currentHole: number;
  currentHoleWinner: Winner;
}

function buildTeam(id: string, name: string, memberIds: string[]): MatchTeam {
  return {
    id,
    name,
    handicap: 0,
    members: memberIds.map((memberId) => ({
      id: memberId,
      name: memberId,
      handicap: 0,
      score: null,
      pickedUp: false,
    })),
  };
}

const reds = buildTeam('t1', 'Reds', ['a1', 'a2']);
const blues = buildTeam('t2', 'Blues', ['b1', 'b2']);
const getPlayerScoreValue = () => 4;
const onSubmitSuccess = jest.fn();

function renderState(totalHoles: number, firstHole = 1) {
  return renderHook(
    ({ currentHole, currentHoleWinner }: HoleProps) =>
      useTeamMatchPlayState({
        team1: reds,
        team2: blues,
        currentHole,
        team1BestScore: 4,
        team2BestScore: 4,
        currentHoleWinner,
        getPlayerScoreValue,
        onSubmitSuccess,
        totalHoles,
      }),
    { initialProps: { currentHole: firstHole, currentHoleWinner: null } as HoleProps }
  );
}

/** Swipe through holes in order, recording each hole's winner as the screen does. */
function playHoles(rerender: (props: HoleProps) => void, firstHole: number, winners: Winner[]) {
  winners.forEach((currentHoleWinner, i) => rerender({ currentHole: firstHole + i, currentHoleWinner }));
}

describe('useTeamMatchPlayState — planned hole count', () => {
  it('completes a front-9 match once all 9 holes are decided', () => {
    const { result, rerender } = renderState(9);

    playHoles(rerender, 1, ['team1', 'team1', 'halved', 'halved', 'halved', 'halved', 'halved', 'halved', 'halved']);

    expect(result.current.isMatchComplete).toBe(true);
    expect(result.current.matchStatus).toEqual({ status: 'complete', winner: 'team1', margin: '2 up' });
    expect(result.current.matchStatusText).toBe('Reds wins 2 up');
  });

  it('closes out a back-9 match against 9 planned holes (5 & 4)', () => {
    const { result, rerender } = renderState(9, 10);

    playHoles(rerender, 10, ['team2', 'team2', 'team2', 'team2', 'team2']);

    expect(result.current.matchStatus).toEqual({ status: 'complete', winner: 'team2', margin: '5 & 4' });
  });

  it('reads an 18-hole match against 18 (characterization)', () => {
    const { result, rerender } = renderState(18);

    playHoles(rerender, 1, ['team1', 'team1', 'halved', 'halved', 'halved', 'halved', 'halved', 'halved', 'halved']);

    expect(result.current.isMatchComplete).toBe(false);
    expect(result.current.matchStatus).toEqual({
      status: 'in_progress',
      leader: 'team1',
      holesUp: 2,
      holesRemaining: 9,
    });
  });
});
```

```ts
    expect(r.lastHoleNumber).toBe(9);

  it('narrows a back-9 round to holes 10-18', () => {
    const r = resolveMatchHoles(course, 'back9');
    expect(r.holes.map((h) => h.number)).toEqual([10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17, 18]);
    expect(r.firstHoleNumber).toBe(10);
    expect(r.lastHoleNumber).toBe(18);
  });

  it('falls back to the default card, still nine-filtered, when the course has no holes', () => {
    const r = resolveMatchHoles(null, 'back9');
    expect(r.holes.map((h) => h.number)).toEqual([10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17, 18]);
    expect(r.holes[0]).toBe(DEFAULT_HOLES[9]);
  });

  it("uses the nine's hole range for bounds when the course hole list is empty", () => {
    const r = resolveMatchHoles([], 'back9');
    expect(r.holes).toEqual([]);
    expect(r.firstHoleNumber).toBe(10);
    expect(r.lastHoleNumber).toBe(18);
  });
});
```

Create `src/screens/scoring/TeamMatchPlayScoringScreen/utils/matchHoles.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * Hole list + navigation bounds for a team match.
 *
 * Team match play rounds can be front9 / back9; the hole list is the course's
 * holes (or the default card) narrowed to the round's nine, and the bounds
 * come from that list — back-9 runs 10..18.
 */

import { filterHolesByNineType } from '@/utils/holeTransformers';
import { getHoleRange } from '@/constants/scoring';
import type { Hole } from '@/types';
import type { NineType } from '@/types/database/enums';
import { DEFAULT_HOLES } from '../constants';

export interface MatchHoles {
  /** The round's planned holes for its nine. */
  holes: Hole[];
  firstHoleNumber: number;
  lastHoleNumber: number;
}

export function resolveMatchHoles(
  courseHoles: Hole[] | null | undefined,
  nineType: NineType
): MatchHoles {
  const source = Array.isArray(courseHoles) ? courseHoles : DEFAULT_HOLES;
  const holes = filterHolesByNineType(source, nineType);
  const range = getHoleRange(nineType);
  return {
    holes,
    firstHoleNumber: holes[0]?.number ?? range.start,
    lastHoleNumber: holes[holes.length - 1]?.number ?? range.end,
  };
}
```

### Task A2b: Nine-aware playing handicap on the match-play surfaces (I4)

**Why:** see Contract note 2. These surfaces feed **nine-filtered** holes to `calculatePlayingHandicap` without `nineType`, which inflates the daily handicap by about 33 ("DHC: 45"). The stroke difference stays at the 18-hole scale, so shots don't match the nine-aware `daily_handicap_used` stored at sync, or the round-list pill. `ScorecardEntryScreen:178-183` already passes `nineType`. This brings the match-play surfaces in line.

**Behaviour change:** 9-hole matches only. Strokes received drop to the 9-hole scale, roughly half. Full rounds pass `nineType: 'full'`, which is identical to today's default.

### Task A2c: Nine-aware live daily handicap — shared helper, store totals, `calculatePlayerStats`, leaderboard map (invariant I4)

**Why.** For a 9-hole round, the store's `calculatePlayerTotals` (`src/store/utils/scorecardCalculations.ts:63-80`) and the live branch of `calculatePlayerStats` (`src/utils/scorecardCalculations.ts:139-183`) both call `calculateGADailyHandicap({ par: Σpar of the 9 holes, full 18-hole slope/CR })`.
- The 18-hole course rating (~72.5) is paired with a 9-hole par (36). For HC 18 on a 125/72.5 tee that gives DHC **52**, not the nine-aware **10** (the I4 golden value).
- Live stableford points and nets on every 9-hole social round stay wrong until sync. Sync uses `calculateNineAwareDailyHandicap` (`scorecardSync.ts:377-394`).
- `buildDailyHandicapMap` (`src/utils/leaderboardHandicaps.ts:41-67`) has the same bug, and feeds the Review/ViewRound leaderboards (I7).

This task fixes the math. A2d threads the round's nine type into the views.

**Behaviour change.** It applies only when a caller passes a 9-hole nine type: the store's four score actions, `setPlayerTee` and `getPlayerTotals` do from this task on. `'full'`/omitted is byte-identical (`filterHolesByNineType(…, 'full')` returns the same array, and `calculateNineAwareDailyHandicap('full')` is `calculateGADailyHandicap`).

```ts
// ============================================================================
// Nine-aware daily handicap (invariant I4)
// ============================================================================

describe('calculatePlayerTotals — nine-aware daily handicap (I4)', () => {
  // create18Holes: front 9 and back 9 are each par 36. Tee 125 / 72.5, HC 18:
  //   18 holes → DHC 19
  //   a 9-hole par paired with the 18-hole rating (the I4 bug) → DHC 52
  //   nine-aware 9 holes (halved 18-hole value) → DHC 10
  const HOLES = create18Holes();
  const FRONT_NINE = HOLES.filter((h) => h.number <= 9);
  const BACK_NINE = HOLES.filter((h) => h.number >= 10);
  const TEE = { name: 'White', color: 'white', slopeRating: 125, courseRating: 72.5 };

  /** HC-18 male player, one over par on every given hole. */
  function bogeyCard(holes: Hole[]): Scorecard {
    const scores: Record<number, { strokes: number }> = {};
    for (const h of holes) scores[h.number] = { strokes: h.par + 1 };
    return {
      player: { id: 'p1', name: 'Test', handicap: 18, handicapIndex: null, gender: 'male' },
      scores,
    } as unknown as Scorecard;
  }

  describe('characterization', () => {
    it('full 18: nets and scores off the 18-hole daily handicap (19)', () => {
      const context = { selectedTee: TEE, handicapSource: 'profile' as const, nineType: 'full' as const };

      expect(calculatePlayerTotals(bogeyCard(HOLES), HOLES, 'stroke', context)).toMatchObject({
        gross: 90,
        net: 71,
      });
      expect(calculatePlayerTotals(bogeyCard(HOLES), HOLES, 'stableford', context).points).toBe(37);
    });

    it("front 9: today's inflated daily handicap (52) — flipped by the nine-aware fix", () => {
      const context = { selectedTee: TEE, handicapSource: 'profile' as const, nineType: 'front9' as const };

      expect(calculatePlayerTotals(bogeyCard(FRONT_NINE), FRONT_NINE, 'stroke', context)).toMatchObject({
        gross: 45,
        net: 19,
      });
      expect(calculatePlayerTotals(bogeyCard(FRONT_NINE), FRONT_NINE, 'stableford', context).points).toBe(35);
    });
  });
});
```

```ts
// ============================================================================
// calculatePlayerStats — nine-aware daily handicap (invariant I4)

describe('calculatePlayerStats — nine-aware daily handicap (I4)', () => {
  const holes = create18Holes();
  const frontNine = holes.filter((h) => h.number <= 9);
  const backNine = holes.filter((h) => h.number >= 10);
  // Tee 125 / 72.5, HC 18: 18 holes → DHC 19; a 9-hole par paired with the
  // 18-hole rating (the I4 bug) → 52; nine-aware 9 holes → 10.
  const tee = { name: 'White', color: 'white', slopeRating: 125, courseRating: 72.5 };
  const bogeys = (list: Hole[]) => createPartialScores(holes, list.map((h) => h.number), 1);

  describe('characterization', () => {
    it("full 18: daily handicap 19, identical with or without nineType 'full'", () => {
      const players = [createScorecardPlayerData('p1', 'Sam', 18, bogeys(holes))];
      const [stats] = calculatePlayerStats(players, holes, tee, 'profile', { nineType: 'full' });

      expect(stats.dailyHandicap).toBe(19);
      expect(stats.totalStableford).toBe(37);
      expect(calculatePlayerStats(players, holes, tee, 'profile')).toEqual([stats]);
    });

    it("front 9: today's inflated daily handicap (52) — flipped by the nine-aware fix", () => {
      const players = [createScorecardPlayerData('p1', 'Sam', 18, bogeys(frontNine))];
      const [stats] = calculatePlayerStats(players, frontNine, tee, 'profile', { nineType: 'front9' });

      expect(stats.dailyHandicap).toBe(52);
      expect(stats.totalStableford).toBe(35);
      expect(stats.totalNet).toBe(-7); // 45 − 52
    });
  });
});
```

Append after `calculateNineAwareDailyHandicap` (after line 200):

```ts

/**
 * The tee ratings a live daily handicap needs: the full 18-hole slope/course
 * rating plus the tee's dedicated 9-hole ratings when it has them.
 */
export type TeeDailyHandicapRatings = Pick<
  TeeBox,
  | 'slopeRating'
  | 'courseRating'
  | 'slopeRatingFront9'
  | 'courseRatingFront9'
  | 'slopeRatingBack9'
  | 'courseRatingBack9'
>;

/**
 * Nine-aware daily handicap from a tee box: the shape every live scoring
 * view holds (store totals, scorecard table and header, leaderboards, player
 * scorecard).
 *
 * `par` is Σpar of the round's PLANNED holes for `nineType` (the 9-hole par
 * for a 9-hole round). The tee's 9-hole ratings are forwarded to
 * {@link calculateNineAwareDailyHandicap}, the same helper the sync pipeline
 * stores `daily_handicap_used` with, so a live total can't drift from the
 * synced snapshot (invariant I4). `nineType` 'full' / omitted is exactly
 * {@link calculateGADailyHandicap}.
 */
export function calculateTeeDailyHandicap(params: {
  gaHandicap: number;
  tee: TeeDailyHandicapRatings;
  par: number;
  nineType?: NineType | null;
  gender?: 'male' | 'female' | null;
}): DailyHandicapResult {
  const { gaHandicap, tee, par, nineType, gender } = params;
  return calculateNineAwareDailyHandicap({
    gaHandicap,
    nineType: nineType ?? 'full',
    par,
    slopeRating: tee.slopeRating,
    courseRating: tee.courseRating,
    slopeRatingFront9: tee.slopeRatingFront9,
    courseRatingFront9: tee.courseRatingFront9,
    slopeRatingBack9: tee.slopeRatingBack9,
    courseRatingBack9: tee.courseRatingBack9,
    gender,
  });
}
```

**`src/store/utils/scorecardCalculations.ts`.** Replace lines 1-123 (everything before `isValidUUID`) with:

```ts
/**
 * Pure calculation functions for the scorecard store.
 * Extracted for testability and reuse.
 */

import type { Scorecard, Hole, GameType, TeeBox } from '@/types';
import type { HandicapSource } from '@/types/database';
import type { NineType } from '@/types/database/enums';
import { isSingleBallScore } from '@/types/database/base';
import {
  getStrokesReceived,
  calculateStablefordPointsNet,
  calculateParScore,
  getEffectiveGrossStrokes,
} from '@/utils/scoring';
import { calculateTeeDailyHandicap } from '@/utils/dailyHandicap';
import { filterHolesByNineType } from '@/utils/holeTransformers';
import { getBaseHandicap } from '@/utils/scorecardCalculations';

/**
 * Optional round-level context used to compute the correct WHS daily
 * handicap for stableford / par / stroke calculations. When provided,
 * the store uses the same DHC formula as the sync pipeline and the
 * scorecard view, so live totals match the stored snapshot.
 */
export interface PlayerTotalsContext {
  /** The tee the player is using (honours per-player override). */
  selectedTee?: TeeBox | null;
  /** Whether to read profile HC, social HC, or no HC for the player. */
  handicapSource?: HandicapSource;
  /**
   * The round's nine type (store `nineType`). A 9-hole round pairs its 9-hole
   * par with 9-hole ratings, exactly as the sync pipeline does (invariant I4).
   * Defaults to 'full'.
   */
  nineType?: NineType;
}

/**
 * Calculate player totals based on game type.
 *
 * When `context.selectedTee` is provided AND has valid slope/course
 * ratings, the WHS Daily Handicap is computed nine-aware via
 * `calculateTeeDailyHandicap` (the helper behind the synced
 * `daily_handicap_used`) and used for strokes received. Otherwise the
 * function falls back to the player's raw profile handicap, which
 * preserves behaviour for legacy callers that don't pass context.
 *
 * `holes` are the round's PLANNED holes. They are narrowed to
 * `context.nineType` (a no-op for the store's already-filtered list and for
 * 'full'). Never pass a played-only slice: Σpar drives the daily handicap.
 */
export function calculatePlayerTotals(
  scorecard: Scorecard,
  holes: Hole[],
  gameType: GameType,
  context?: PlayerTotalsContext
): { gross: number; net: number; points: number; parScore: number } {
  // Resolve the effective handicap for scoring. Prefer WHS DHC from the
  // selected tee so totals match the sync pipeline and the scorecard view.
  // Fall back to the raw profile HC only when tee data or course par isn't
  // available.
  const rawHandicap = getBaseHandicap(
    scorecard.player
      ? {
          id: scorecard.player.id,
          name: scorecard.player.name,
          handicap: scorecard.player.handicap ?? null,
          handicap_index: scorecard.player.handicapIndex ?? null,
          gender: scorecard.player.gender ?? null,
        }
      : null,
    context?.handicapSource ?? 'profile'
  );

  // The round's planned holes for its nine type. A 9-hole round's Σpar is the
  // 9-hole par, which calculateTeeDailyHandicap pairs with a 9-hole rating.
  const nineType: NineType = context?.nineType ?? 'full';
  const plannedHoles = filterHolesByNineType(holes, nineType);
  const coursePar = plannedHoles.reduce((sum, h) => sum + (h.par || 0), 0);

  let effectiveHandicap = rawHandicap;
  if (
    context?.handicapSource !== 'none' &&
    context?.selectedTee?.slopeRating &&
    context?.selectedTee?.courseRating &&
    coursePar > 0
  ) {
    const result = calculateTeeDailyHandicap({
      gaHandicap: rawHandicap,
      tee: context.selectedTee,
      par: coursePar,
      nineType,
      gender: scorecard.player?.gender ?? null,
    });
    effectiveHandicap = result.dailyHandicap;
  }

  let totalGross = 0;
  let totalNet = 0;
  let totalPoints = 0;
  let totalParScore = 0;

  for (const hole of plannedHoles) {
    const rawHoleScore = scorecard.scores[hole.number];
    if (!rawHoleScore) continue;

    // Get strokes based on score type
    const rawStrokes = isSingleBallScore(rawHoleScore)
      ? rawHoleScore.strokes
      : rawHoleScore.balls?.[0]?.strokes; // Use first ball for multi-ball

    if (!rawStrokes || rawStrokes <= 0) continue;

    const strokesReceived = getStrokesReceived(effectiveHandicap, hole.strokeIndex);

    // Pickups (>= PICKUP_SCORE) score net double bogey for handicap purposes
    // (WHS "most likely score"), rather than being dropped from the total.
    // Completed holes use their actual strokes. This keeps the stored gross /
    // net / differential consistent with the scorecard view.
    const strokes = getEffectiveGrossStrokes(rawStrokes, hole.par, strokesReceived);
    if (strokes == null) continue;

    totalGross += strokes;

    const netStrokes = strokes - strokesReceived;

    if (gameType === 'stableford') {
      totalPoints += calculateStablefordPointsNet(strokes, hole.par, strokesReceived);
      totalNet = totalPoints; // For stableford, the store overloads net=points
    } else if (gameType === 'stroke') {
      totalNet += netStrokes;
    } else if (gameType === 'par') {
      totalParScore += calculateParScore(strokes, hole.par, strokesReceived);
      totalNet += netStrokes;
    }
  }

  return { gross: totalGross, net: totalNet, points: totalPoints, parScore: totalParScore };
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Calculate statistics for all players in a scorecard display
 *
 * @param players Array of player data with scores
 * @param holes Array of hole data
 * @param selectedTee Optional tee data with slope/course ratings for daily handicap calculation
 * @param handicapSource Which handicap value to use ('profile' = profile handicap, 'calculated' = Social Index, 'none' = no handicap)
 * @returns Array of player statistics
 */
export function calculatePlayerStats(
  players: ScorecardPlayerData[],
  holes: Hole[],
  selectedTee?: TeeBox | null,
  handicapSource: HandicapSource = 'profile'
): PlayerStats[] {
  // Guard against non-array holes data
  const safeHoles = Array.isArray(holes) ? holes : [];

  // Calculate course par once for daily handicap calculations
  const coursePar = safeHoles.reduce((sum, hole) => sum + hole.par, 0);
```

```ts
/**
 * Calculate statistics for all players in a scorecard display
 *
 * @param players Array of player data with scores
 * @param holes The round's planned holes. Narrowed to `options.nineType`
 *   (a no-op for an already nine-filtered list and for 'full').
 * @param selectedTee Optional tee data with slope/course ratings for daily handicap calculation
 * @param handicapSource Which handicap value to use ('profile' = profile handicap, 'calculated' = Social Index, 'none' = no handicap)
 * @param options.nineType The round's nine type. A 9-hole round's live daily
 *   handicap pairs its 9-hole par with a 9-hole rating (invariant I4), as the
 *   synced `daily_handicap_used` does. Defaults to 'full'.
 * @returns Array of player statistics
 */
export function calculatePlayerStats(
  players: ScorecardPlayerData[],
  holes: Hole[],
  selectedTee?: TeeBox | null,
  handicapSource: HandicapSource = 'profile',
  options?: { nineType?: NineType | null }
): PlayerStats[] {
  // Guard against non-array holes data, then narrow to the round's nine
  // (callers on the course's raw holes get the nine's Σpar, not 72).
  const nineType: NineType = options?.nineType ?? 'full';
  const safeHoles = filterHolesByNineType(Array.isArray(holes) ? holes : [], nineType);

  // Calculate course par once for daily handicap calculations
  const coursePar = safeHoles.reduce((sum, hole) => sum + hole.par, 0);
```

**`src/utils/leaderboardHandicaps.ts`.** Replace the whole file with:

```ts
import type { Hole, TeeBox } from '@/types';
import type { HandicapSource, NineType } from '@/types/database/enums';
import { calculateTeeDailyHandicap } from './dailyHandicap';
import { filterHolesByNineType } from './holeTransformers';

export interface LeaderboardHandicapInput {
  playerId: string;
  /** Player's raw WHS/GA handicap index (profile handicap). */
  gaHandicap: number | null | undefined;
  /**
   * Daily (playing) handicap captured at scoring time (`daily_handicap_used`),
   * when known. Populated on completed/confirmed scorecards; null/undefined on
   * in-progress cards.
   */
  storedDailyHandicap?: number | null;
  /** Used for the WHS consistency factor when computing from the tee. */
  gender?: 'male' | 'female' | null;
}

/**
 * Resolve each player's daily (playing) handicap for leaderboard scoring so the
 * leaderboard's Stableford/Par points match the on-course scorecard.
 *
 * Resolution mirrors the scorecard's `calculatePlayerStats`:
 *   1. Prefer the stored `daily_handicap_used` snapshot — authoritative once a
 *      card is completed/confirmed.
 *   2. Otherwise convert the GA index → daily handicap via the round tee's
 *      slope/course rating, nine-aware for a 9-hole round (the same live
 *      recompute the scorecard performs — invariant I4).
 *   3. Otherwise (no tee data, or handicap disabled) fall back to the raw GA
 *      index.
 *
 * @param holes The round's planned holes, or the course's raw holes — they are
 *   narrowed to `nineType` before Σpar is taken.
 * @param nineType The round's nine type; defaults to 'full'.
 * @returns Map of playerId → daily handicap.
 */
export function buildDailyHandicapMap(
  players: LeaderboardHandicapInput[],
  holes: Hole[],
  selectedTee: TeeBox | null | undefined,
  handicapSource: HandicapSource = 'profile',
  nineType?: NineType | null
): Record<string, number> {
  const nine: NineType = nineType ?? 'full';
  const safeHoles = filterHolesByNineType(Array.isArray(holes) ? holes : [], nine);
  const coursePar = safeHoles.reduce((sum, hole) => sum + hole.par, 0);

  const map: Record<string, number> = {};

  for (const player of players) {
    const ga = player.gaHandicap ?? 0;

    // 1. Stored snapshot wins.
    if (typeof player.storedDailyHandicap === 'number') {
      map[player.playerId] = player.storedDailyHandicap;
      continue;
    }

    // 2. Compute from the tee's slope/course rating (nine-aware).
    if (
      handicapSource !== 'none' &&
      selectedTee?.slopeRating &&
      selectedTee?.courseRating &&
      coursePar > 0
    ) {
      map[player.playerId] = calculateTeeDailyHandicap({
        gaHandicap: ga,
        tee: selectedTee,
        par: coursePar,
        nineType: nine,
        gender: player.gender ?? undefined,
      }).dailyHandicap;
      continue;
    }

    // 3. Raw index fallback.
    map[player.playerId] = ga;
  }

  return map;
}
```

```tsx
/**
 * ScorecardTabContent — the Review scorecard's live daily handicap is
 * nine-aware (invariant I4): a front-9 round pairs its 9-hole par with a
 * 9-hole rating, as the synced daily_handicap_used does.
 */

import React from 'react';
import { render, screen } from '@/__tests__/utils/renderHelpers';
import { ScorecardTabContent } from './ScorecardTabContent';
import * as scorecardCalculations from '@/utils/scorecardCalculations';
import { create18Holes } from '@/__tests__/utils/testFixtures';
import type { ScorecardTablePlayer } from '@/components/scorecard';
import type { Hole, Player } from '@/types';

const HOLES = create18Holes();
const FRONT_NINE = HOLES.filter((h) => h.number <= 9);
const TEE = { name: 'White', color: 'white', slopeRating: 125, courseRating: 72.5 };
const player = { id: 'p1', name: 'Noah', handicap: 18 } as Player;

function bogeys(holes: Hole[]): Record<string, { strokes: number }> {
  const scores: Record<string, { strokes: number }> = {};
  for (const h of holes) scores[String(h.number)] = { strokes: h.par + 1 };
  return scores;
}

function twoBallBogeys(holes: Hole[]): Record<string, { balls: { strokes: number }[] }> {
  const scores: Record<string, { balls: { strokes: number }[] }> = {};
  for (const h of holes) scores[String(h.number)] = { balls: [{ strokes: h.par + 1 }, { strokes: h.par }] };
  return scores;
}

function renderTab(
  holes: Hole[],
  overrides: Partial<React.ComponentProps<typeof ScorecardTabContent>> = {}
) {
  return render(
    <ScorecardTabContent
      holes={holes}
      tablePlayerData={[
        { id: 'p1', playerId: 'p1', player, scores: bogeys(holes), hasScorecard: true } as ScorecardTablePlayer,
      ]}
      currentPlayers={[player]}
      effectiveGameType="stroke"
      isScramble={false}
      scrambleTeams={[]}
      getPlayerScore={() => undefined}
      onHolePress={() => {}}
      isRefreshing={false}
      onRefresh={() => {}}
      bottomInset={0}
      selectedTeeData={TEE}
      handicapSource="profile"
      {...overrides}
    />
  );
}

describe('ScorecardTabContent — nine-aware daily handicap (I4)', () => {
  afterEach(() => {
    jest.restoreAllMocks();
  });

  it('keeps the 18-hole daily handicap for a full round (characterization)', () => {
    renderTab(HOLES, { nineType: 'full' });

    expect(screen.getByText('DHC: 19')).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it("front 9: today's inflated daily handicap — flipped by the nine-aware fix", () => {
    renderTab(FRONT_NINE, { nineType: 'front9' });

    expect(screen.getByText('DHC: 52')).toBeTruthy();
  });
});
```

```tsx
function renderTab(nineType: 'full' | 'front9') {

      roundPlayers={[]}

  );
}

function openIndividualView() {
  fireEvent.press(screen.getByTestId('icon-card-account-details-outline'));
}
```

```ts
describe('usePlayerScorecard — nine-aware daily handicap (I4)', () => {
  // Tee 125 / 72.5, HC 18. `holes` above are 18 par-4 holes (a nine = par 36):
  // 18 holes → DHC 19; a 9-hole par against the 18-hole rating → 52;
  // nine-aware → 10.
  const TEE = { name: 'White', color: 'white', slopeRating: 125, courseRating: 72.5 };
  const FRONT_NINE = holes.slice(0, 9);

  function liveStore(overrides: Record<string, unknown>) {
    mockedUseScorecardStore.mockReturnValue({
      ...emptyStore(),
      currentRoundId: 'r1',
      isInitialized: true,
      selectedTeeData: TEE,
      currentPlayers: [{ id: 'p1', name: 'Bob', handicap: 18, email: 'b@x.com', gender: 'male' }],
      groupScorecards: new Map([['p1', { scores: { '1': { strokes: 5 } } }]]),
      ...overrides,
    });
  }

  function readOnlyFrontNine() {
    mockedUseRoundScorecards.mockReturnValue({
      data: [
        {
          player_id: 'p1',
          // No stored snapshot (in progress) → the daily handicap is computed.
          daily_handicap_used: null,
          ga_handicap_used: null,
          scores: { '1': { strokes: 5 } },
          player: { id: 'p1', name: 'Alice', handicap: 18, handicap_index: null, gender: 'male' },
        },
      ],
      isLoading: false,
    });
    mockedUseRoundDetails.mockReturnValue({
      data: {
        id: 'r1',
        nine_type: 'front9',
        selected_tee: TEE,
        course: { holes },
        competition: { handicap_source: 'profile' },
      },
      isLoading: false,
    });
  }

  it('live full round: the 18-hole daily handicap (characterization)', () => {
    liveStore({ holes, nineType: 'full' });
    const { result } = renderHook(() => usePlayerScorecard('p1', 'r1'));

    expect(result.current.playerStats.dailyHandicap).toBe(19);
  });

  it("live front 9: today's inflated daily handicap — flipped by the nine-aware fix", () => {
    liveStore({ holes: FRONT_NINE, nineType: 'front9' });
    const { result } = renderHook(() => usePlayerScorecard('p1', 'r1'));

    expect(result.current.playerStats.dailyHandicap).toBe(52);
  });

  it("read-only front 9 without a stored DHC: today's 18-hole value — flipped by the nine-aware fix", () => {
    readOnlyFrontNine();
    const { result } = renderHook(() => usePlayerScorecard('p1', 'r1'));

    expect(result.current.playerStats.dailyHandicap).toBe(19);
  });
});
```

```ts
describe('computeUserProgress — stableford points on a 9-hole round (I4)', () => {
  // The carousel reads the course's raw 18 holes. Tee 125 / 72.5, HC 18:
  // over the raw holes (par 72) DHC 19 → 19 pts for nine bogeys; nine-aware
  // front 9 (par 36) DHC 10 → 14 pts, the value sync will store.
  const TEE = { name: 'White', color: 'white', slopeRating: 125, courseRating: 72.5 };
  const holes = create18Holes();

  function round(nineType: 'full' | 'front9'): RoundWithCourse {
    return {
      id: 'r1',
      competition_id: null,
      game_type: 'stableford',
      nine_type: nineType,
      selected_tee: TEE,
      handicap_source: 'profile',
      course: { holes },
    } as unknown as RoundWithCourse;
  }

  const scores: ProgressScorecardRow['scores'] = {};
  for (const h of holes.filter((x) => x.number <= 9)) scores[String(h.number)] = { strokes: h.par + 1 };

  // No synced snapshot yet, so points are computed live.
  const card: ProgressScorecardRow = {
    round_id: 'r1',
    status: 'in-progress',
    scores,
    daily_handicap_used: null,
    ga_handicap_used: null,
    total_points: null,
    player: { id: 'p1', name: 'Sam', handicap: 18, gender: 'male' },
  };

  it('full round: points off the 18-hole daily handicap (characterization)', () => {
    expect(computeUserProgress(round('full'), card)?.points).toBe(19);
  });

  it("front 9: today's 18-hole daily handicap over 9 holes — flipped by the nine-aware fix", () => {
    expect(computeUserProgress(round('front9'), card)?.points).toBe(19);
  });
});
```

```ts
// src/utils/handicapEligibility.ts
/**
 * Handicap Eligibility — the card-level completeness gate (invariant I12)
 *
 * A WHS Score Differential is only produced for a COMPLETE card: every hole of
 * the round's planned nine or eighteen carries a score. A partial card — an
 * early-ended social round, a part-filled Quick Score card, a half-scored nine
 * — would otherwise yield a wildly low differential (an 18-hole round ended
 * after 6 holes comes out around −38) and poison the handicap index.
 *
 * Card-based on purpose: it reads the card's own scores and the round's planned
 * nine type — never `rounds.holes_played` and never a hole list — so it holds
 * even when the card syncs before the round-level end-early write (offline),
 * whatever hole list a caller happens to have in scope.
 *
 * Legacy cards with no per-hole data at all keep the old gross-only behaviour
 * (treated as complete).
 *
 * @see docs/guides/SCORING_ARCHITECTURE.md (I8 differential call sites)
 */

import { getHoleRange } from '@/constants/scoring';
import type { NineType } from '@/types/database/enums';

/**
 * Whether one stored hole score carries a stroke count. Accepts every shape a
 * card may hold: a bare number, a `{ strokes }` object (app or JSONB), or a
 * multi-ball `{ balls: [...] }` (scored when any ball is). A pickup is stored as
 * strokes = PICKUP_SCORE, so it counts as scored.
 */
function hasStrokes(raw: unknown): boolean {
  if (typeof raw === 'number') return raw > 0;
  if (raw == null || typeof raw !== 'object') return false;
  const { balls, strokes } = raw as { balls?: unknown; strokes?: unknown };
  if (Array.isArray(balls)) return balls.some((ball) => hasStrokes(ball));
  return typeof strokes === 'number' && strokes > 0;
}

/**
 * True when the card is complete for handicap purposes: every planned hole
 * (`getHoleRange(nineType)`) has a score. A card with no per-hole data at all
 * (null / undefined / no keys) is a legacy gross-only card and returns true.
 */
export function isCompleteForHandicap(
  scores: Record<string | number, unknown> | null | undefined,
  nineType: NineType,
): boolean {
  if (!scores || Object.keys(scores).length === 0) return true;
  const { start, end } = getHoleRange(nineType);
  for (let hole = start; hole <= end; hole++) {
    if (!hasStrokes(scores[hole])) return false;
  }
  return true;
}
```

```ts
describe('calculateHandicapData — handicap completeness gate (I12)', () => {
  const range = (start: number, end: number): number[] =>
    Array.from({ length: end - start + 1 }, (_, i) => start + i);

  /** Level par on the listed holes only. */
  function parScoresOn(holeNumbers: number[]): Record<number, { strokes: number }> {
    const scores: Record<number, { strokes: number }> = {};
    for (const n of holeNumbers) scores[n] = { strokes: PAR_72_HOLES[n - 1].par };
    return scores;
  }

  // Scratch player, as in the block above: daily handicap −1, so no strokes
  // are received and every hole caps at par + 2.
  const scratchCard = (overrides: Partial<Scorecard>) =>
    makeScorecard({ playerHandicap: 0, syncHoles: PAR_72_HOLES, coursePar: 72, ...overrides });

  const BACK_NINE = PAR_72_HOLES.filter((h) => h.number >= 10);

  it('keeps the legacy gross-only rule for a card with no per-hole data (locks current behaviour)', () => {
    const result = calculateHandicapData(makeScorecard({ scores: {}, totalGross: 90 }));
    // (113 / 122) × (90 − 71) = 17.6
    expect(result.handicapDifferential).toBeCloseTo(17.6, 1);
  });

  it('computes a differential for a complete 18-hole card (locks current behaviour)', () => {
    const result = calculateHandicapData(
      scratchCard({ scores: parScoresOn(range(1, 18)), totalGross: 72 }),
    );
    // (113 / 122) × (72 − 71) = 0.9
    expect(result.handicapDifferential).toBeCloseTo(0.9, 1);
  });

    const scores = parScoresOn(range(1, 18));
    scores[7] = { strokes: PICKUP_SCORE };
    const result = calculateHandicapData(scratchCard({ scores, totalGross: 78 }));
    // The pickup caps at net double bogey (6): adjusted 74 → (113 / 122) × 3 = 2.8
    expect(result.handicapDifferential).toBeCloseTo(2.8, 1);
  });

  it('computes a differential for a complete back-9 card (locks current behaviour)', () => {
    const result = calculateHandicapData(
      scratchCard({
        syncNineType: 'back9',
        syncHoles: BACK_NINE,
        coursePar: 36,
        scores: parScoresOn(range(10, 18)),
        totalGross: 36,
      }),
    );
    expect(result.handicapDifferential).not.toBeNull();
  });

  it('returns a NULL differential for an 18-hole card scored on only 6 holes', () => {
    const result = calculateHandicapData(
      scratchCard({ scores: parScoresOn(range(1, 6)), totalGross: 24 }),
    );
    // Before the gate: (113 / 122) × (24 − 71) = −43.5, straight into the index.

    const result = calculateHandicapData(

        syncNineType: 'back9',
        syncHoles: BACK_NINE,
        coursePar: 36,
        scores: parScoresOn(range(10, 15)),
        totalGross: 24,
      }),
    );
    expect(result.handicapDifferential).toBeNull();

  it('judges completeness from the nine type, not from syncHoles', () => {
    // syncHoles lists only holes 1–6, but the round is a full 18.

});
```

```ts
  // 8. Calculate differential from the WHS ADJUSTED gross score — every hole
  // capped at net double bogey (par + 2 + strokes received). Falls back to the
  // raw total_gross when hole data is unavailable, which is what this call site
  // used before the cap was introduced.
  //
  // Handicap completeness gate (I12): an incomplete card — an early-ended
  // round, or an in-progress card recalculated by mid-round Change Tees — gets
  // a NULL differential instead of an error, so the daily handicap and points
  // snapshot below still refresh. Cards with no per-hole data keep the legacy
  // gross-only rule.
  const isCompleteCard = isCompleteForHandicap(scorecard.scores, nineType);
  let handicapDifferential: number | null = null;

  if (isCompleteCard) {
    const adjustedGross =
      effectiveHoles.length > 0 && scorecard.scores
        ? calculateAdjustedGrossScore({
            holes: effectiveHoles,
            scores: scorecard.scores as AdjustedGrossParams['scores'],
            dailyHandicap: dailyHandicapUsed ?? 0,
          }).adjustedGross
        : scorecard.total_gross;

    handicapDifferential = calculateScoreDifferential({
      adjustedGrossScore: adjustedGross > 0 ? adjustedGross : scorecard.total_gross,
      courseRating: ratings.courseRating,
      slopeRating: ratings.slopeRating,
    });

    if (handicapDifferential === null) {
      throw new Error('Failed to calculate differential from current ratings');
    }
  }
```

```ts
import { tagRoundToLeague } from '@/services/api/leagues/mutations';

const USER_ID = 'user-1';
const LEAGUE_ID = 'league-1';
const SCORECARD_ID = 'scorecard-1';

function scoresOn(holeCount: number): Record<string, { strokes: number }> {
  const scores: Record<string, { strokes: number }> = {};
  for (let hole = 1; hole <= holeCount; hole++) scores[String(hole)] = { strokes: 5 };
  return scores;
}

function makeScorecard(overrides: Record<string, unknown> = {}): Record<string, unknown> {
  return {
    id: SCORECARD_ID,
    player_id: USER_ID,
    handicap_differential: null,
    status: 'completed',
    scores: scoresOn(18),
    round_id: 'round-1',
    ...overrides,
  };
}

function recalcResult(handicapDifferential: number | null) {
  return {
    handicapDifferential,
    dailyHandicapUsed: 19,
    courseRatingUsed: 72.5,
    slopeRatingUsed: 125,
    gaHandicapUsed: 18,
  };
}

let leagueRoundInserts: Record<string, unknown>[] = [];

function wireTables(scorecard: Record<string, unknown>) {
  mockFrom.mockImplementation((table: string) => {
    switch (table) {
      case 'scorecards':
        return {
          select: () => ({
            eq: () => ({ single: () => Promise.resolve({ data: scorecard, error: null }) }),
          }),
        };
      case 'leagues':
        return {
          select: () => ({
            eq: () => ({
              single: () =>
                Promise.resolve({
                  data: { id: LEAGUE_ID, status: 'active', league_type: 'ongoing' },
                  error: null,
                }),
            }),
          }),
        };
      case 'league_rounds':
        return {
          insert: (payload: Record<string, unknown>) => {
            leagueRoundInserts.push(payload);
            return {
              select: () => ({
                single: () => Promise.resolve({ data: { id: 'league-round-1', ...payload }, error: null }),
              }),
            };
          },
        };
      default:
        throw new Error(`Unexpected table: ${table}`);
    }
  });
}

    jest.clearAllMocks();

    mockGetUser.mockResolvedValue({ data: { user: { id: USER_ID } }, error: null });

    expect(mockRecalculate).toHaveBeenCalledWith(SCORECARD_ID);
    expect(leagueRoundInserts[0].handicap_differential).toBe(12.3);

  it('wraps a failed recalculation (locks current behaviour)', async () => {

      'This round is not eligible for a handicap differential',
    );
    expect(leagueRoundInserts).toEqual([]);
  });
});
```

```ts
  // Validate the card BEFORE any recalculation: a partial card is rejected
  // outright rather than sent through recalculateScorecardDifferential, which
  // writes to the scorecard row.
  const scores = sc.scores;
  if (!scores || typeof scores !== 'object') {

  const holesWithStrokes = Object.values(scores).filter(
    (s) => s && s.strokes != null && s.strokes > 0

  if (holesWithStrokes.length < 18) {
    throw new Error('Only 18-hole rounds can be tagged to leagues');
  }

  if (sc.handicap_differential == null) {
    // Attempt retroactive recalculation — tee data may have been updated since round was scored
    let recalculated: number | null;
    try {
      const result = await recalculateScorecardDifferential(scorecardId);
      recalculated = result.handicapDifferential;
    } catch (recalcError) {
      const msg = recalcError instanceof Error ? recalcError.message : 'Unknown error';
      throw new Error(
        `This scorecard does not have a handicap differential and recalculation failed: ${msg}`
      );
    }
    // The completeness gate (I12) can legitimately withhold a differential;
    // a league row must never be written with a null one.
    if (recalculated == null) {
      throw new Error('This round is not eligible for a handicap differential');
    }
    sc.handicap_differential = recalculated;
  }
```

```ts
// src/__tests__/services/handicap/combineHandicapRounds.test.ts
/**
 * Combine-two-nines validation — handicap completeness gate (I12).
 *
 * A combined 18 is handicap-eligible only when each nine is fully scored for
 * its own nine. The current combined differential is locked first.
 */

// supabase.from(table) → a chain whose first .eq(column, value) picks the row
// mockRows[table][value]; .single() resolves it (or a not-found error).
const mockRows: Record<string, Record<string, unknown>> = {};

function mockQuery(table: string) {
  let key: string | undefined;
  const chain: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  chain.select = () => chain;
  chain.eq = (_column: string, value: string) => {
    if (key === undefined) key = value;
    return chain;
  };
  chain.single = () => {
    const row = key === undefined ? undefined : mockRows[table]?.[key];
    return Promise.resolve(
      row ? { data: row, error: null } : { data: null, error: { message: 'not found' } },
    );
  };
  chain.maybeSingle = () => Promise.resolve({ data: null, error: null });
  return chain;
}

jest.mock('@/services/supabase/client', () => ({
  supabase: { from: (table: string) => mockQuery(table) },
}));

jest.mock('@/services/queryClient', () => ({
  invalidateHandicapCache: jest.fn(),
}));

jest.mock('@/services/handicap/updatePlayerHandicapIndex', () => ({
  updatePlayerHandicapIndex: jest.fn(() => Promise.resolve()),
}));

jest.mock('@/utils/debugLogger', () => ({
  syncLogger: { info: jest.fn(), debug: jest.fn(), warn: jest.fn(), error: jest.fn() },
}));

import { previewCombinedDifferential } from '@/services/handicap/combineHandicapRounds';

const PLAYER_ID = 'player-1';
const TEE_ID = 'tee-1';

/** 18 × par 4, stroke indexes 1..18 in hole order. */
const COURSE_HOLES = Array.from({ length: 18 }, (_, i) => ({
  number: i + 1,
  par: 4,
  strokeIndex: i + 1,
}));

const range = (start: number, end: number): number[] =>
  Array.from({ length: end - start + 1 }, (_, i) => start + i);

/** Five strokes on each listed hole, JSONB-keyed. */
function fivesOn(holeNumbers: number[]): Record<string, { strokes: number }> {
  const scores: Record<string, { strokes: number }> = {};
  for (const n of holeNumbers) scores[String(n)] = { strokes: 5 };
  return scores;
}

type Scores = Record<string, { strokes: number }> | null;

/** Seed a front9 + back9 pair on the same course and tee. Null scores = legacy card (gross 45). */
function seedPair(frontScores: Scores, backScores: Scores) {
  const grossOf = (scores: Scores) =>
    scores ? Object.values(scores).reduce((sum, s) => sum + s.strokes, 0) : 45;
  const card = (id: string, roundId: string, scores: Scores) => ({
    id,
    player_id: PLAYER_ID,
    round_id: roundId,
    total_gross: grossOf(scores),
    ga_handicap_used: null,
    status: 'completed',
    scores,
  });
  const round = (id: string, nineType: string) => ({
    id,
    course_id: 'course-1',
    nine_type: nineType,
    selected_tee: { tee_id: TEE_ID, name: 'Blue', color: 'blue' },
    courses: { holes: COURSE_HOLES },
  });

  mockRows.scorecards = {
    'sc-front': card('sc-front', 'round-front', frontScores),
    'sc-back': card('sc-back', 'round-back', backScores),
  };
  mockRows.rounds = {
    'round-front': round('round-front', 'front9'),
    'round-back': round('round-back', 'back9'),
  };
  mockRows.tees = {
    [TEE_ID]: { id: TEE_ID, name: 'Blue', slope: 125, course_rating: 72.5, slope_women: null, course_rating_women: null },
  };
  mockRows.players = {
    [PLAYER_ID]: { id: PLAYER_ID, gender: 'male', handicap: null },
  };
}

describe('previewCombinedDifferential — completeness gate', () => {
  it('previews a differential for two fully scored nines (locks current behaviour)', async () => {
    seedPair(fivesOn(range(1, 9)), fivesOn(range(10, 18)));

    const preview = await previewCombinedDifferential('sc-front', 'sc-back');

    // (113 / 125) × (90 − 72.5) = 15.8
    expect(preview.handicapDifferential).toBe(15.8);
    expect(preview.combinedGross).toBe(90);
  });

  it('still combines legacy nines with no hole data (locks current behaviour)', async () => {
    seedPair(null, null);

    const preview = await previewCombinedDifferential('sc-front', 'sc-back');
```
