- [ ] **Step 1: Write the characterization test (locks current behaviour)**

Create `src/utils/holeTransformers.test.ts`:

```ts
import { filterHolesByNineType } from './holeTransformers';
import type { Hole } from '@/types';

const hole = (n: number): Hole => ({ number: n as Hole['number'], par: 4, strokeIndex: n });
const numbers = (holes: Hole[]) => holes.map((h) => h.number);

const EIGHTEEN: Hole[] = Array.from({ length: 18 }, (_, i) => hole(i + 1));
// Scrambled order, as some course imports deliver holes.
const UNSORTED: Hole[] = [3, 1, 2, 12, 10, 11, 18, 9, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17].map(hole);

describe('filterHolesByNineType (characterization)', () => {
  it('returns the input array itself for full, without sorting', () => {
    expect(filterHolesByNineType(EIGHTEEN, 'full')).toBe(EIGHTEEN);
    expect(filterHolesByNineType(UNSORTED, 'full')).toBe(UNSORTED);
  });

  it('keeps holes 1–9 for front9, in input order', () => {
    expect(numbers(filterHolesByNineType(EIGHTEEN, 'front9'))).toEqual([1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9]);
    expect(numbers(filterHolesByNineType(UNSORTED, 'front9'))).toEqual([3, 1, 2, 9, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8]);
  });

  it('keeps holes 10–18 for back9, in input order', () => {
    expect(numbers(filterHolesByNineType(EIGHTEEN, 'back9'))).toEqual([10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17, 18]);
    expect(numbers(filterHolesByNineType(UNSORTED, 'back9'))).toEqual([12, 10, 11, 18, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17]);
  });

  it('is idempotent', () => {
    const back = filterHolesByNineType(EIGHTEEN, 'back9');
    expect(filterHolesByNineType(back, 'back9')).toEqual(back);
    const front = filterHolesByNineType(EIGHTEEN, 'front9');
    expect(filterHolesByNineType(front, 'front9')).toEqual(front);
  });
});
```

```ts
import {

  lastPlayedHoleNumber,
  isEndedEarly,

} from './roundShape';

const record = (overrides: Partial<EndedEarlyRecord> = {}): EndedEarlyRecord => ({
  holesPlayed: 6,
  convertToFront9: false,
  originalNineType: 'full',
  endedAt: '2026-10-07T01:02:03.000Z',
  ...overrides,
});

describe('resolveRoundShape', () => {
  it('uses the server row when there is no local record', () => {
    expect(resolveRoundShape({ nine_type: 'back9', holes_played: 6 })).toEqual({ nineType: 'back9', holesPlayed: 6 });
    expect(resolveRoundShape({ nine_type: 'front9', holes_played: null }, null)).toEqual({ nineType: 'front9', holesPlayed: null });
  });

  it('defaults to a full round played as planned when nothing is known', () => {
    expect(resolveRoundShape(null)).toEqual({ nineType: 'full', holesPlayed: null });
    expect(resolveRoundShape(undefined, undefined)).toEqual({ nineType: 'full', holesPlayed: null });
    expect(resolveRoundShape({})).toEqual({ nineType: 'full', holesPlayed: null });
  });

  it('treats a non-positive server holes_played as played as planned', () => {
    expect(resolveRoundShape({ nine_type: 'full', holes_played: 0 })).toEqual({ nineType: 'full', holesPlayed: null });

    expect(resolveRoundShape({ nine_type: 'full', holes_played: null }, record({ holesPlayed: 6 }))).toEqual({
      nineType: 'full',
      holesPlayed: 6,
    });
  });

  it('falls back to the record\'s original nine type when the server row is unavailable (offline relaunch)', () => {
    expect(resolveRoundShape(null, record({ originalNineType: 'back9' }))).toEqual({ nineType: 'back9', holesPlayed: 6 });
  });

  it('a local front-9 conversion wins even while the server row still says full', () => {
    expect(

      nineType: 'front9',
      holesPlayed: null,
    });
  });
```

```ts
import { isHoleScored, planEndRoundEarly } from './endRoundEarly';
import type { Hole, Scorecard } from '@/types';
import type { NineType } from '@/types/database/enums';

type Scores = Scorecard['scores'];

const hole = (n: number): Hole => ({ number: n as Hole['number'], par: 4, strokeIndex: n });
const range = (from: number, to: number) => Array.from({ length: to - from + 1 }, (_, i) => from + i);
const EIGHTEEN: Hole[] = range(1, 18).map(hole);

const SAM = { id: 'p-sam', name: 'Sam' };
const DAVE = { id: 'p-dave', name: 'Dave' };
const PLAYERS = [SAM, DAVE];

const strokesOn = (holeNumbers: number[], strokes = 4): Scores =>
  Object.fromEntries(holeNumbers.map((h) => [h, { strokes }]));

const plan = (byPlayer: Record<string, Scores>, nineType: NineType = 'full', holes: Hole[] = EIGHTEEN) =>
  planEndRoundEarly({
    holes,
    nineType,
    players: PLAYERS,
    scorecards: new Map(
      Object.entries(byPlayer).map(([id, scores]): [string, { scores: Scores }] => [id, { scores }])
    ),
  });

describe('isHoleScored', () => {
  it('is false for a missing or zero-stroke score', () => {
    expect(isHoleScored(null)).toBe(false);
    expect(isHoleScored(undefined)).toBe(false);
    expect(isHoleScored({ strokes: 0 })).toBe(false);
    expect(isHoleScored({ strokes: 0, didNotAttempt: true })).toBe(false);
  });

  it('is true for strokes > 0, including a pickup', () => {
    expect(isHoleScored({ strokes: 4 })).toBe(true);
    expect(isHoleScored({ strokes: 10 })).toBe(true);
  });

  it('is true for a multi-ball score when any ball has strokes', () => {
    expect(isHoleScored({ balls: [{ strokes: 0 }, { strokes: 5 }] })).toBe(true);
    expect(isHoleScored({ balls: [{ strokes: 0 }] })).toBe(false);
    expect(isHoleScored({ balls: [] })).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe('planEndRoundEarly', () => {
  it('returns null when no hole is complete for every player', () => {
    expect(plan({ [SAM.id]: strokesOn(range(1, 3)), [DAVE.id]: {} })).toBeNull();
  });

  it('returns null when every planned hole is complete (that is a normal submit)', () => {
    expect(plan({ [SAM.id]: strokesOn(range(1, 18)), [DAVE.id]: strokesOn(range(1, 18)) })).toBeNull();
    expect(plan({ [SAM.id]: strokesOn(range(1, 9)), [DAVE.id]: strokesOn(range(1, 9)) }, 'front9')).toBeNull();
  });

  it('ends after the last hole every player has scored and drops a half-scored hole', () => {
    expect(plan({ [SAM.id]: strokesOn(range(1, 7)), [DAVE.id]: strokesOn(range(1, 6)) })).toEqual({
      holesPlayed: 6,
      plannedHoles: 18,
      nineType: 'full',
      convertToFront9: false,
      lastHoleNumber: 6,
      removedScores: [{ playerId: SAM.id, playerName: 'Sam', holeNumber: 7 }],
    });
  });

  it('stops at a skipped hole and removes every later score, hole by hole', () => {
    const both = strokesOn([...range(1, 5), 7, 8]);
    const result = plan({ [SAM.id]: both, [DAVE.id]: both });
    expect(result?.holesPlayed).toBe(5);
    expect(result?.lastHoleNumber).toBe(5);
    expect(result?.removedScores).toEqual([
      { playerId: SAM.id, playerName: 'Sam', holeNumber: 7 },
      { playerId: DAVE.id, playerName: 'Dave', holeNumber: 7 },
      { playerId: SAM.id, playerName: 'Sam', holeNumber: 8 },
      { playerId: DAVE.id, playerName: 'Dave', holeNumber: 8 },
    ]);
  });

  it('counts a pickup on hole N as scored (Review Focus #4)', () => {
    const result = plan({
      [SAM.id]: strokesOn(range(1, 6)),
      [DAVE.id]: { ...strokesOn(range(1, 5)), 6: { strokes: 10 } },
    });
    expect(result?.holesPlayed).toBe(6);
    expect(result?.removedScores).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('removes a pickup alone on hole N+1 (Review Focus #4)', () => {
    const result = plan({
      [SAM.id]: { ...strokesOn(range(1, 6)), 7: { strokes: 10 } },
      [DAVE.id]: strokesOn(range(1, 6)),
    });
    expect(result?.holesPlayed).toBe(6);
    expect(result?.removedScores).toEqual([{ playerId: SAM.id, playerName: 'Sam', holeNumber: 7 }]);
  });

  it('numbers a back-9 round from hole 10 (Review Focus #2)', () => {
    const result = plan(
      { [SAM.id]: strokesOn(range(10, 16)), [DAVE.id]: strokesOn(range(10, 15)) },
      'back9'
    );
    expect(result).toEqual({
      holesPlayed: 6,
      plannedHoles: 9,
      nineType: 'back9',
      convertToFront9: false,
      lastHoleNumber: 15,
      removedScores: [{ playerId: SAM.id, playerName: 'Sam', holeNumber: 16 }],
    });
  });

  it('converts an 18-hole round ended at exactly 9 to a front 9', () => {
    const result = plan({ [SAM.id]: strokesOn(range(1, 9)), [DAVE.id]: strokesOn(range(1, 10)) });
    expect(result).toMatchObject({ holesPlayed: 9, convertToFront9: true, lastHoleNumber: 9, plannedHoles: 18 });
    expect(result?.removedScores).toEqual([{ playerId: DAVE.id, playerName: 'Dave', holeNumber: 10 }]);
  });

  it('does not convert at 8 or 10 holes of a full round', () => {
    expect(plan({ [SAM.id]: strokesOn(range(1, 8)), [DAVE.id]: strokesOn(range(1, 8)) })?.convertToFront9).toBe(false);
    expect(plan({ [SAM.id]: strokesOn(range(1, 10)), [DAVE.id]: strokesOn(range(1, 10)) })?.convertToFront9).toBe(false);
  });

  it('handles holes passed in any order', () => {
    const shuffled = [...EIGHTEEN].reverse();
    const result = plan({ [SAM.id]: strokesOn(range(1, 7)), [DAVE.id]: strokesOn(range(1, 6)) }, 'full', shuffled);
    expect(result?.holesPlayed).toBe(6);
    expect(result?.lastHoleNumber).toBe(6);
  });

  it('treats a multi-ball card as scored when any ball has strokes', () => {
    const result = planEndRoundEarly({
      holes: EIGHTEEN,
      nineType: 'full',
      players: [SAM],
      scorecards: new Map<string, { scores: Scores }>([
        [SAM.id, { scores: { 1: { balls: [{ strokes: 4 }, { strokes: 5 }] }, 2: { balls: [{ strokes: 0 }, { strokes: 4 }] } } }],
      ]),
    });
    expect(result?.holesPlayed).toBe(2);
  });

  it('returns null when there are no players or no planned holes', () => {
    expect(planEndRoundEarly({ holes: EIGHTEEN, nineType: 'full', players: [], scorecards: new Map() })).toBeNull();
    expect(planEndRoundEarly({ holes: [], nineType: 'full', players: PLAYERS, scorecards: new Map() })).toBeNull();
  });
});
```

After `filterHolesByNineType` (lines 17-28), add:

```ts

/**
 * The holes a round actually used: `filterHolesByNineType`, then, when the
 * round was ended early (`holesPlayed` is a positive integer), sorted by hole
 * number and cut to the first `holesPlayed`. A back-9 round ended after 6 →
 * holes 10–15.
 *
 * null / undefined / non-positive / non-integer ⇒ identical to
 * `filterHolesByNineType` (same array for 'full', no sort).
 *
 * Rendering, validation and "holes remaining" use this. Daily-handicap maths
 * must keep using the PLANNED holes (Σpar of the holes passed in) — see
 * docs/guides/SCORING_ARCHITECTURE.md.
 */
export function filterPlayableHoles(
  holes: Hole[],
  nineType: NineType,
  holesPlayed?: number | null
): Hole[] {
  const planned = filterHolesByNineType(holes, nineType);
  if (holesPlayed == null || !Number.isInteger(holesPlayed) || holesPlayed <= 0) {
    return planned;
  }
  return [...planned].sort((a, b) => a.number - b.number).slice(0, holesPlayed);
}
```

Create `src/utils/roundShape.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * Round shape — the planned nine type plus how many holes were actually played.
 *
 * A social round can be ended early (see docs/superpowers/specs/
 * 2026-10-07-end-round-early-design.md). Until submit, the end lives only in
 * a local record (src/store/endRoundEarlyStore.ts); after submit it is
 * `rounds.holes_played` (or `nine_type = 'front9'` for exactly 9 of 18).
 * Every scoring init path resolves the shape through `resolveRoundShape` so a
 * pending local end isn't "corrected" back to the server row.
 */

import type { GameType, HandicapSource, NineType } from '@/types/database/enums';
import { getHoleCount, getHoleRange } from '@/constants/scoring';

export interface EndedEarlyRecord {
  holesPlayed: number; // N, counted from the round's first hole
  convertToFront9: boolean; // true only for nineType 'full' ended at exactly 9
  originalNineType: NineType; // nine type before ending (Resume restores it)
  endedAt: string; // ISO timestamp
  /** Round scoring context, so an offline relaunch can rebuild the store
   *  without the server row (Review Focus #1). Optional: older records lack it. */
  gameType?: GameType;
  handicapSource?: HandicapSource;
}

export interface RoundShape {
  nineType: NineType;
  holesPlayed: number | null;
}

/**
 * Local record wins:
 * - convertToFront9 ⇒ { 'front9', null };
 * - otherwise ⇒ { server nine_type ?? record.originalNineType, record.holesPlayed }.
 *   (The record's nine type stands in when the server row is unavailable — an
 *   offline relaunch of a back-9 round must still resolve to holes 10–15.)
 * No local record ⇒ { server nine_type ?? 'full', server holes_played ?? null }.
 */
export function resolveRoundShape(
  server: { nine_type?: NineType | null; holes_played?: number | null } | null | undefined,
  local?: EndedEarlyRecord | null
): RoundShape {
  if (local) {
    if (local.convertToFront9) {
      return { nineType: 'front9', holesPlayed: null };
    }
    return {
      nineType: server?.nine_type ?? local.originalNineType,
      holesPlayed: local.holesPlayed,
    };
  }

  const serverHolesPlayed = server?.holes_played;
  return {
    nineType: server?.nine_type ?? 'full',
    holesPlayed: serverHolesPlayed != null && serverHolesPlayed > 0 ? serverHolesPlayed : null,
  };
}

/** The round's first hole number: 10 for a back 9, otherwise 1. */
export function firstHoleNumber(nineType: NineType): number {
  return getHoleRange(nineType).start;
}

/** The hole number the round ended on: firstHoleNumber + N − 1 (back9 + 6 ⇒ 15). */
export function lastPlayedHoleNumber(nineType: NineType, holesPlayed: number): number {
  return firstHoleNumber(nineType) + holesPlayed - 1;
}

/** True when the (submitted) round row records an early end. */
export function isEndedEarly(round: { holes_played?: number | null } | null | undefined): boolean {
  const holesPlayed = round?.holes_played;
  return holesPlayed != null && holesPlayed > 0;
}

/** "Ended after 6 of 9" — M is the planned hole count for the nine type. */
export function formatEndedEarlyLabel(holesPlayed: number, nineType: NineType): string {
  return `Ended after ${holesPlayed} of ${getHoleCount(nineType)}`;
}
```

Create `src/utils/endRoundEarly.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * End round early — planning.
 *
 * N is the number of leading holes (in hole order, from the round's first
 * hole) on which EVERY player has a score. A pickup (strokes = PICKUP_SCORE)
 * counts as scored. Scores after hole N are removed when the round is ended.
 *
 * Pure: the store (src/store/endRoundEarlySlice.ts) applies the plan, and the
 * confirmation sheet shows it.
 */

import type { Hole, Scorecard } from '@/types';
import type { HoleScore, MultiBallHoleScore } from '@/types/database/base';
import { isMultiBallScore } from '@/types/database/base';
import type { NineType } from '@/types/database/enums';
import { getHoleCount } from '@/constants/scoring';
import { filterHolesByNineType } from '@/utils/holeTransformers';
import { lastPlayedHoleNumber } from '@/utils/roundShape';

export interface EndRoundEarlyRemovedScore {
  playerId: string;
  playerName: string;
  holeNumber: number;
}

export interface EndRoundEarlyPlan {
  holesPlayed: number; // N
  plannedHoles: number; // getHoleCount(nineType)
  nineType: NineType; // the round's nine type at the time of ending
  convertToFront9: boolean;
  lastHoleNumber: number; // lastPlayedHoleNumber(nineType, N)
  removedScores: EndRoundEarlyRemovedScore[];
}

/** strokes > 0 (any ball for multi-ball). A pickup (10) is scored; 0 / didNotAttempt is not. */
export function isHoleScored(score: HoleScore | MultiBallHoleScore | null | undefined): boolean {
  if (!score) return false;
  if (isMultiBallScore(score)) {
    return score.balls.some((ball) => (ball?.strokes ?? 0) > 0);
  }
  return (score.strokes ?? 0) > 0;
}

/** null when no hole is complete for every player, or when every planned hole is complete. */
export function planEndRoundEarly(input: {
  holes: Hole[]; // planned holes (store `holes`)
  nineType: NineType;
  players: { id: string; name: string }[];
  scorecards: Map<string, { scores: Scorecard['scores'] }>;
}): EndRoundEarlyPlan | null {
  const { holes, nineType, players, scorecards } = input;
  const plannedHoles = [...filterHolesByNineType(holes, nineType)].sort((a, b) => a.number - b.number);
  if (plannedHoles.length === 0 || players.length === 0) return null;

  const scoreFor = (playerId: string, holeNumber: number) => scorecards.get(playerId)?.scores[holeNumber];

  let holesPlayed = 0;
  for (const hole of plannedHoles) {
    const completeForEveryone = players.every((player) => isHoleScored(scoreFor(player.id, hole.number)));
    if (!completeForEveryone) break;
    holesPlayed += 1;
  }

  if (holesPlayed === 0 || holesPlayed >= plannedHoles.length) return null;

  const lastHoleNumber = lastPlayedHoleNumber(nineType, holesPlayed);
  const removedScores: EndRoundEarlyRemovedScore[] = [];
  for (const hole of plannedHoles) {
    if (hole.number <= lastHoleNumber) continue;
    for (const player of players) {
      if (isHoleScored(scoreFor(player.id, hole.number))) {
        removedScores.push({ playerId: player.id, playerName: player.name, holeNumber: hole.number });
      }
    }
  }

  return {
    holesPlayed,
    plannedHoles: getHoleCount(nineType),
    nineType,
    convertToFront9: nineType === 'full' && holesPlayed === 9,
    lastHoleNumber,
    removedScores,
  };
}
```

**Why each piece is needed:**
- **SQLite delete.** `getScorecardsByRound` rebuilds `scores` from `hole_scores` rows (`ScorecardDAO.ts:20` → `getHoleScores`), and `saveScorecard` only upserts (`bulkSaveHoleScores` at `HoleScoreDAO.ts:152-161`). A removed key would come back on the next load unless its row is deleted.
- **Server.** The server side needs nothing new: `write_scorecard_snapshot` replaces `scores` wholesale (`20260714000000_…:96`). The comment in `scorecardSyncDebounce.ts:11-15` about a "server-side completeness check" skipping smaller cards is stale (see Follow-ups).

```ts
import {
  useEndRoundEarlyStore,
  getEndRoundEarlyRecord,
  waitForEndRoundEarlyHydration,
} from '@/store/endRoundEarlyStore';
import type { EndedEarlyRecord } from '@/utils/roundShape';

const ROUND_A = 'round-a';
const ROUND_B = 'round-b';
const RECORD: EndedEarlyRecord = {
  holesPlayed: 6,
  convertToFront9: false,
  originalNineType: 'full',
  endedAt: '2026-10-07T01:02:03.000Z',
  gameType: 'stroke',
  handicapSource: 'profile',
};

describe('endRoundEarlyStore', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    useEndRoundEarlyStore.setState({ records: {} });
  });

  it('returns null when the round has no record', () => {
    expect(getEndRoundEarlyRecord(ROUND_A)).toBeNull();
  });

  it('setRecord stores a record keyed by round id', () => {
    useEndRoundEarlyStore.getState().setRecord(ROUND_A, RECORD);

    expect(getEndRoundEarlyRecord(ROUND_A)).toEqual(RECORD);
    expect(getEndRoundEarlyRecord(ROUND_B)).toBeNull();
  });

  it('clearRecord removes only that round', () => {
    useEndRoundEarlyStore.getState().setRecord(ROUND_A, RECORD);
    useEndRoundEarlyStore.getState().setRecord(ROUND_B, { ...RECORD, holesPlayed: 4 });

    useEndRoundEarlyStore.getState().clearRecord(ROUND_A);

    expect(getEndRoundEarlyRecord(ROUND_A)).toBeNull();
    expect(getEndRoundEarlyRecord(ROUND_B)?.holesPlayed).toBe(4);
  });

  it('clearRecord for a round without a record leaves the state object untouched', () => {
    const before = useEndRoundEarlyStore.getState().records;
    useEndRoundEarlyStore.getState().clearRecord(ROUND_A);
    expect(useEndRoundEarlyStore.getState().records).toBe(before);
  });

  it('persists records to AsyncStorage under "end-round-early"', () => {
    useEndRoundEarlyStore.getState().setRecord(ROUND_A, RECORD);

    expect(AsyncStorage.setItem).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      'end-round-early',
      expect.stringContaining('"holesPlayed":6')
    );
  });

  it('rehydrates a persisted record after an app restart', async () => {
    (AsyncStorage.getItem as jest.Mock).mockResolvedValueOnce(
      JSON.stringify({ state: { records: { [ROUND_A]: RECORD } }, version: 0 })
    );

    await useEndRoundEarlyStore.persist.rehydrate();

    expect(getEndRoundEarlyRecord(ROUND_A)).toEqual(RECORD);
  });

  it('waitForEndRoundEarlyHydration resolves once the store has hydrated', async () => {
    await useEndRoundEarlyStore.persist.rehydrate();
    await expect(waitForEndRoundEarlyHydration()).resolves.toBeUndefined();
  });

  it('waitForEndRoundEarlyHydration gives up after the timeout instead of hanging', async () => {
    jest.useFakeTimers();
    const hasHydrated = jest
      .spyOn(useEndRoundEarlyStore.persist, 'hasHydrated')
      .mockReturnValue(false);

    const waiting = waitForEndRoundEarlyHydration(500);
    jest.advanceTimersByTime(500);

    await expect(waiting).resolves.toBeUndefined();
    hasHydrated.mockRestore();
    jest.useRealTimers();
  });
});
```

Create `src/store/endRoundEarlyStore.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * Pending "end round early" records, keyed by round id.
 *
 * Ending a social round early is a local action until submit (it must work
 * offline). The record says how many holes were played and whether an
 * 18-hole round became a front 9, so every scoring init path can rebuild the
 * ended round after an app kill instead of reopening it as a full round with
 * holes N+1… re-enabled. Submit sends it to the server (end_round_early RPC)
 * and clears it; "Resume playing" clears it too.
 *
 * Persisted via AsyncStorage (precedent: teeOverrideStore). Device-local by
 * design: only a device that scores every player can end a round early.
 */

import { create } from 'zustand';
import { persist, createJSONStorage } from 'zustand/middleware';
import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
import type { EndedEarlyRecord } from '@/utils/roundShape';

interface EndRoundEarlyStoreState {
  records: Record<string, EndedEarlyRecord>;
  setRecord: (roundId: string, record: EndedEarlyRecord) => void;
  clearRecord: (roundId: string) => void;
}

export const useEndRoundEarlyStore = create<EndRoundEarlyStoreState>()(
  persist(
    (set) => ({
      records: {},

      setRecord: (roundId, record) =>
        set((state) => ({ records: { ...state.records, [roundId]: record } })),

      clearRecord: (roundId) =>
        set((state) => {
          if (!(roundId in state.records)) return state;
          const { [roundId]: _, ...rest } = state.records;
          return { records: rest };
        }),
    }),
    {
      name: 'end-round-early',
      storage: createJSONStorage(() => AsyncStorage),
      partialize: (state) => ({ records: state.records }),
    }
  )
);

/** The pending end-early record for a round, or null. Non-reactive (store slices, services). */
export function getEndRoundEarlyRecord(roundId: string): EndedEarlyRecord | null {
  return useEndRoundEarlyStore.getState().records[roundId] ?? null;
}

const HYDRATION_TIMEOUT_MS = 2000;

/**
 * Resolve once the persisted records have been read back from AsyncStorage.
 *
 * `persist` hydrates asynchronously. A cold-start init path that reads a
 * record before hydration finishes would see none and reopen an ended round
 * as a full round. Capped so a storage failure (zustand never reports
 * hydration finished in that case) can't block round loading.
 */
export function waitForEndRoundEarlyHydration(timeoutMs: number = HYDRATION_TIMEOUT_MS): Promise<void> {
  if (useEndRoundEarlyStore.persist.hasHydrated()) return Promise.resolve();

  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    let settled = false;
    // `finish` only runs later (hydration listener / timer), after both
    // consts below are initialised. Declared as consts for prefer-const.
    const finish = (): void => {
      if (settled) return;
      settled = true;
      clearTimeout(timer);
      unsubscribe();
      resolve();
    };
    const unsubscribe = useEndRoundEarlyStore.persist.onFinishHydration(finish);
    const timer = setTimeout(finish, timeoutMs);
  });
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Delete the given holes' scores for a scorecard.
 *
 * `saveScorecard` only upserts hole rows (bulkSaveHoleScores), and
 * `getScorecardsByRound` rebuilds `scores` from these rows — so a score
 * removed from the in-memory card (ending a round early) must be deleted
 * here or it comes back on the next load.
 */
export async function deleteHoleScoresForHoles(scorecardId: string, holeNumbers: number[]): Promise<void> {
  if (holeNumbers.length === 0) return;
  const database = await getDb();
  const placeholders = holeNumbers.map(() => '?').join(', ');
  await database.runAsync(
    `DELETE FROM ${TABLE_NAMES.HOLE_SCORES} WHERE scorecard_id = ? AND hole_number IN (${placeholders})`,
    [scorecardId, ...holeNumbers]
  );
}
```

At the end of `src/store/scoreUpdateSlice.ts`, after `updateLocalScore` (which ends at line 315), add:
```ts

/**
 * Remove a player's scores on the given holes (ending a round early discards
 * every score after the last complete hole).
 *
 * Unlike the other actions, SQLite is written FIRST and a failure throws:
 * the caller (endRoundEarly) must abort before recording the end, otherwise
 * a relaunch would bring the "removed" scores back from hole_scores. The
 * queued snapshot sync then carries the smaller `scores` to the server —
 * write_scorecard_snapshot replaces `scores` wholesale.
 */
export async function removePlayerHoleScores(
  get: GetFn,
  set: SetFn,
  playerId: string,
  holeNumbers: number[],
): Promise<void> {
  const { allowedPlayerIds, currentRoundId } = get();

  if (allowedPlayerIds.length > 0 && !allowedPlayerIds.includes(playerId)) {
    storeLogger.warn('Player not in allowed list, rejecting score removal', {
      playerId: playerId.substring(0, 8) + '...',
    });
    return;
  }

  const scorecard = get().groupScorecards.get(playerId);
  if (!scorecard) {
    storeLogger.warn('Scorecard not found for player', { playerId });
    return;
  }

  const toRemove = holeNumbers.filter((holeNumber) => scorecard.scores[holeNumber] !== undefined);
  if (toRemove.length === 0) return;

  await deleteHoleScoresForHoles(scorecard.id, toRemove);

  // Re-read state after the await: other cards may have changed meanwhile.
  const { groupScorecards, holes, gameType, selectedTeeData, playerTeeMap, handicapSource, nineType } = get();
  const current = groupScorecards.get(playerId) ?? scorecard;
  const removeSet = new Set(toRemove);
  const nextScores: Scorecard['scores'] = {};
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(current.scores)) {
    const holeNumber = Number(key);
    if (!removeSet.has(holeNumber)) nextScores[holeNumber] = value;
  }

  const updatedScorecard: Scorecard = { ...current, scores: nextScores, updatedAt: new Date() };
  const playerTee = playerTeeMap.get(playerId) ?? selectedTeeData;
  // nineType: A2c's nine-aware daily handicap (StoreState.nineType already exists).
  const totals = calculatePlayerTotals(updatedScorecard, holes, gameType, {
    selectedTee: playerTee,
    handicapSource,
    nineType,
  });
  updatedScorecard.totalGross = totals.gross;
  updatedScorecard.totalNet = totals.net;
  updatedScorecard.total_par_score = totals.parScore;

  const newScorecards = new Map(groupScorecards);
  newScorecards.set(playerId, updatedScorecard);
  set({ groupScorecards: newScorecards });

  await persistScorecardUpdate({
    scorecard: { scorecardId: updatedScorecard.id, scorecard: updatedScorecard },
    context: 'removePlayerHoleScores',
  });

  if (currentRoundId && !updatedScorecard.isStandalone) {
    debouncedQueueScorecardSync(updatedScorecard.id, () => get().groupScorecards.get(playerId));
  }

  storeLogger.info('Removed player hole scores', {
    playerId: playerId.substring(0, 8) + '...',
    holes: toRemove,
  });
}
```

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes:
  - `EndRoundEarlyPlan`, `planEndRoundEarly`, `isHoleScored` (B2);
  - `filterPlayableHoles` (B2);
  - `useEndRoundEarlyStore`, `getEndRoundEarlyRecord`, `removePlayerHoleScores` (B3a);
  - `getHoles` (`@/services/offline/database`);
  - `calculatePlayerTotals` with A2c's `PlayerTotalsContext.nineType` (A2c already added `StoreState.nineType` and passes it at the four `applyScoreUpdate` call sites; this task adds only `holesPlayed` there), `persistScorecardUpdate`, `debouncedQueueScorecardSync`.
- Produces (contract):
  - `holesPlayed: number | null`;
  - `endRoundEarly(plan): Promise<void>`, `resumeRound(): Promise<void>`, `getPlayedHoles(): Hole[]`;
  - `resetRound` clears `holesPlayed`;
  - `Scorecard.syncHolesPlayed?: number | null`, stamped by `submitScorecards`;
  - `isHoleAfterEarlyEnd(nineType, holesPlayed, holeNumber): boolean` (`src/utils/roundShape.ts`);
  - **closed holes:** while `holesPlayed != null` (ended, not yet submitted), score writes to holes after the last played hole are no-ops. That covers `setPlayerScore`, `updatePlayerHoleScore`, `updateShotContributions` and `updateLocalScore` (via `applyScoreUpdate`), plus `setMultiBallScore` and `updateMultiBallStats`.
  - Consumed by B4 (sync net), B5 (match hooks), B6 (`useEndRoundEarly`), B7 (Review, banner Resume), B8 (submit), B10 (achievements).

**Rules this task must keep (R1):**
- `holes` stays the **planned** list. `submitScorecards` keeps `coursePar = Σpar(planned)`, so the daily handicap stays the planned round's.
- Only "exactly 9 of 18" changes the planned holes, to a genuine front 9.
- After a partial end, the holes after N are **closed** until Resume or submit. A user who backs out of Review to the scoring screen must not be able to re-add scores there; otherwise they would reach SQLite, the sync queue and the submitted card. A front-9 conversion needs no guard, because holes 10–18 are no longer planned holes and the setters already ignore unknown holes.

```ts
// The payload `syncScorecard` received for a player at submit.
const submittedPayload = (playerId: string): Scorecard => {
  const call = (syncScorecard as jest.Mock).mock.calls.find(
    (args) => (args[0] as Scorecard).playerId === playerId
  );
  if (!call) throw new Error(`no submit payload for ${playerId}`);
  return call[0] as Scorecard;
};
```

Create `src/store/endRoundEarlySlice.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * endRoundEarlySlice - "End round early" / "Resume playing" for scorecardStore.
 *
 * The store keeps the PLANNED holes: every daily-handicap calculation derives
 * par from the holes passed in (docs/guides/SCORING_ARCHITECTURE.md, "Derive
 * DHC from the planned holes"), so cutting `holes` to the played holes would
 * inflate DHC. Ending early records `holesPlayed`; anything that renders,
 * validates or counts holes remaining slices via getPlayedHoles().
 *
 * The one exception: an 18-hole round ended after exactly 9 becomes a genuine
 * front-9 round (planned holes 1–9, 9-hole totals). The local record keeps the
 * original nine type so Resume can restore it from the SQLite holes cache
 * (saveHoles never deletes rows).
 */

import type { Scorecard, Player, Hole, GameType, TeeBox } from '@/types';
import type { HandicapSource } from '@/types/database';
import type { NineType } from '@/types/database/enums';
import { getHoles } from '@/services/offline/database';
import { getHoleCount } from '@/constants/scoring';
import { storeLogger } from '@/utils/debugLogger';
import { filterHolesByNineType } from '@/utils/holeTransformers';
import { isHoleScored, type EndRoundEarlyPlan } from '@/utils/endRoundEarly';
import { useEndRoundEarlyStore, getEndRoundEarlyRecord } from './endRoundEarlyStore';
import { fetchCourseHolesForRound } from './initializeRoundSlice';
import { persistScorecardUpdate } from './scorecardPersistence';
import { debouncedQueueScorecardSync } from './scorecardSyncDebounce';
import { calculatePlayerTotals } from './utils/scorecardCalculations';

interface StoreState {
  currentRoundId: string | null;
  currentPlayers: Player[];
  currentHole: number;
  holes: Hole[];
  nineType: NineType;
  holesPlayed: number | null;
  gameType: GameType;
  handicapSource: HandicapSource;
  selectedTeeData: TeeBox | null;
  playerTeeMap: Map<string, TeeBox>;
  groupScorecards: Map<string, Scorecard>;
  allowedPlayerIds: string[];
  removePlayerHoleScores: (playerId: string, holeNumbers: number[]) => Promise<void>;
}

type GetFn = () => StoreState;
type SetFn = (
  partial: Partial<Pick<StoreState, 'holes' | 'nineType' | 'holesPlayed' | 'groupScorecards' | 'currentHole'>>
) => void;

/**
 * Every card's totals recomputed over `holes` (the planned holes totals derive
 * from). `nineType` is the nine those holes are, so the daily handicap uses the
 * matching ratings (A2c, I4): a converted front 9 must not use the 18-hole one.
 */
function recomputeTotals(state: StoreState, holes: Hole[], nineType: NineType): Map<string, Scorecard> {
  const next = new Map<string, Scorecard>();
  const now = new Date();
  for (const [playerId, scorecard] of state.groupScorecards) {
    const totals = calculatePlayerTotals(scorecard, holes, state.gameType, {
      selectedTee: state.playerTeeMap.get(playerId) ?? state.selectedTeeData,
      handicapSource: state.handicapSource,
      nineType,
    });
    next.set(playerId, {
      ...scorecard,
      totalGross: totals.gross,
      totalNet: totals.net,
      total_par_score: totals.parScore,
      updatedAt: now,
    });
  }
  return next;
}

/** Save every card to SQLite and schedule a live sync (their totals changed). */
async function persistScorecards(
  get: GetFn,
  scorecards: Map<string, Scorecard>,
  context: string
): Promise<void> {
  const { currentRoundId } = get();
  for (const [playerId, scorecard] of scorecards) {
    await persistScorecardUpdate({ scorecard: { scorecardId: scorecard.id, scorecard }, context });
    if (currentRoundId && !scorecard.isStandalone) {
      debouncedQueueScorecardSync(scorecard.id, () => get().groupScorecards.get(playerId));
    }
  }
}

/** First hole (in hole order) not yet scored by every player; the last hole when all are. */
function firstIncompleteHoleNumber(
  holes: Hole[],
  players: Player[],
  scorecards: Map<string, Scorecard>
): number {
  const ordered = [...holes].sort((a, b) => a.number - b.number);
  for (const hole of ordered) {
    const complete = players.every((player) =>
      isHoleScored(scorecards.get(player.id)?.scores[hole.number])
    );
    if (!complete) return hole.number;
  }
  return ordered[ordered.length - 1]?.number ?? 1;
}

/**
 * The planned holes for `nineType`: from the SQLite holes cache (saveHoles
 * never deletes rows), else from the network. Holes already in memory keep
 * their objects (and yardages). Throws if neither source has them all.
 */
async function restorePlannedHoles(roundId: string, currentHoles: Hole[], nineType: NineType): Promise<Hole[]> {
  const expected = getHoleCount(nineType);
  const inMemory = new Map(currentHoles.map((hole) => [hole.number, hole]));
  const plannedFrom = (source: Hole[]): Hole[] =>
    filterHolesByNineType(source, nineType)
      .map((hole) => inMemory.get(hole.number) ?? hole)
      .sort((a, b) => a.number - b.number);

  const fromCache = plannedFrom(await getHoles(roundId));
  if (fromCache.length >= expected) return fromCache;

  const fromNetwork = await fetchCourseHolesForRound(roundId);
  if (fromNetwork) {
    const restored = plannedFrom(fromNetwork);
    if (restored.length >= expected) return restored;
  }

  throw new Error("Couldn't restore this round's holes. Reconnect and try again.");
}

export async function endRoundEarly(get: GetFn, set: SetFn, plan: EndRoundEarlyPlan): Promise<void> {
  const { currentRoundId, nineType, allowedPlayerIds, groupScorecards, gameType, handicapSource } = get();

  if (!currentRoundId) {
    throw new Error('No round ID set');
  }
  // Belt for Review Focus #5: when another device scores some players, their
  // cards can hold more holes than N. The UI hides the action in that case.
  if (allowedPlayerIds.length > 0) {
    throw new Error('A round can only be ended early from a device that scores every player');
  }
  if (plan.nineType !== nineType) {
    throw new Error(`End-round-early plan is for a ${plan.nineType} round but the round is ${nineType}`);
  }

  storeLogger.info('Ending round early', {
    roundId: currentRoundId.substring(0, 8) + '...',
    holesPlayed: plan.holesPlayed,
    lastHoleNumber: plan.lastHoleNumber,
    convertToFront9: plan.convertToFront9,
  });

  // 1. Discard every score after the last played hole: the scored entries in
  //    plan.removedScores AND stats-only rows. SQLite first: a failure throws
  //    here, before the record exists.
  for (const [playerId, scorecard] of groupScorecards) {
    const laterHoles = Object.keys(scorecard.scores)
      .map(Number)
      .filter((holeNumber) => holeNumber > plan.lastHoleNumber);
    if (laterHoles.length > 0) {
      await get().removePlayerHoleScores(playerId, laterHoles);
    }
  }

  // 2. Persist the local record so an app kill before submit keeps the end.
  useEndRoundEarlyStore.getState().setRecord(currentRoundId, {
    holesPlayed: plan.holesPlayed,
    convertToFront9: plan.convertToFront9,
    originalNineType: plan.nineType,
    endedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    gameType,
    handicapSource,
  });

  // 3a. Ended after N: the planned holes stay; only the played count changes.
  if (!plan.convertToFront9) {
    set({ holesPlayed: plan.holesPlayed });
    return;
  }

  // 3b. Exactly 9 of 18: the planned holes become the front 9 and every
  //     card's totals are recomputed on 9-hole holes (as EditNineTypeSheet).
  const frontNine = filterHolesByNineType(get().holes, 'front9');
  const recomputed = recomputeTotals(get(), frontNine, 'front9');
  set({
    holes: frontNine,
    nineType: 'front9',
    holesPlayed: null,
    groupScorecards: recomputed,
    currentHole: Math.min(get().currentHole, plan.lastHoleNumber),
  });
  await persistScorecards(get, recomputed, 'endRoundEarly');
}

export async function resumeRound(get: GetFn, set: SetFn): Promise<void> {
  const { currentRoundId } = get();
  if (!currentRoundId) return;

  const record = getEndRoundEarlyRecord(currentRoundId);
  const wasConverted = record?.convertToFront9 === true;

  // Resolve the restored holes BEFORE touching any state, so a failure leaves
  // the round (and the record) exactly as it was.
  const restoredHoles = wasConverted && record
    ? await restorePlannedHoles(currentRoundId, get().holes, record.originalNineType)
    : get().holes;
  const restoredNineType = wasConverted && record ? record.originalNineType : get().nineType;

  useEndRoundEarlyStore.getState().clearRecord(currentRoundId);

  const state = get();
  const scorecards = wasConverted
    ? recomputeTotals(state, restoredHoles, restoredNineType)
    : state.groupScorecards;
  set({
    holes: restoredHoles,
    nineType: restoredNineType,
    holesPlayed: null,
    groupScorecards: scorecards,
    currentHole: firstIncompleteHoleNumber(restoredHoles, state.currentPlayers, scorecards),
  });

  storeLogger.info('Resumed round after ending early', {
    roundId: currentRoundId.substring(0, 8) + '...',
    restoredHoleCount: restoredHoles.length,
    nineType: restoredNineType,
  });

  if (wasConverted) {
    await persistScorecards(get, scorecards, 'resumeRound');
  }
}
```

```ts
/**
 * True when `holeNumber` lies after the last played hole of a round ended
 * early (holesPlayed set, not yet submitted). The store ignores score writes
 * to such holes until Resume, so backing out of Review can't re-add scores
 * after hole N.
 */
export function isHoleAfterEarlyEnd(
  nineType: NineType,
  holesPlayed: number | null | undefined,
  holeNumber: number
): boolean {
  if (holesPlayed == null || holesPlayed <= 0) return false;
  return holeNumber > lastPlayedHoleNumber(nineType, holesPlayed);
}
```

```ts
// A scorecard as SQLite returns it after an app restart.
const cachedCard = (player: Player, holeNumbers: number[]): Scorecard => ({
  id: cardId(player.id),
  roundId: ROUND_ID,
  playerId: player.id,
  player,
  scores: Object.fromEntries(holeNumbers.map((h) => [h, { strokes: 4 }])),
  totalGross: holeNumbers.length * 4,
  totalNet: 0,
  status: 'in-progress',
  createdAt: new Date(),
  updatedAt: new Date(),
});

const ENDED_AT = '2026-10-07T01:02:03.000Z';

describe('characterization (pre round-shape init)', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    (getHoles as jest.Mock).mockResolvedValue(create18Holes());
  });

  it('loadFromOffline filters a back-9 round to holes 10–18', async () => {
    supabaseMock.__setRoundsResult({
      data: { game_type: 'stroke', handicap_source: 'profile', nine_type: 'back9', selected_tee: null, course_id: null },
      error: null,
    });
    (getScorecardsByRound as jest.Mock).mockResolvedValue([cachedCard(P1, [10, 11]), cachedCard(P2, [10, 11])]);

    const loaded = await getStore().loadFromOffline(ROUND_ID);

    expect(loaded).toBe(true);
    expect(getStore().nineType).toBe('back9');
    expect(getStore().holes.map((h) => h.number)).toEqual(range(10, 18));
    expect(getStore().currentHole).toBe(12);
  });

  it('loadFromOffline bails when the round row cannot be fetched and there is no local record', async () => {
    supabaseMock.__setRoundsResult({ __reject: true });
    (getScorecardsByRound as jest.Mock).mockResolvedValue([cachedCard(P1, range(1, 6)), cachedCard(P2, range(1, 6))]);

    const loaded = await getStore().loadFromOffline(ROUND_ID);

    expect(loaded).toBe(false);
    expect(getStore().isInitialized).toBe(false);
  });
});
```

Create `src/__tests__/hooks/scorecard/useRoundData.test.tsx`:

```tsx
/**
 * useRoundData — nine_type mismatch guard vs. a pending end-early record
 *
 * The guard resets the store when the server's nine_type differs from the
 * store's (EditNineTypeSheet recovery). A pending local front-9 conversion
 * (ended at exactly 9 of 18, not yet submitted) legitimately differs from
 * the server row and must NOT be reset back to 18 holes.
 *
 * @see src/hooks/scorecard/useRoundData.ts
 */

import { renderHook } from '@testing-library/react-native';
import { useRoundData } from '@/hooks/scorecard/useRoundData';
import { useEndRoundEarlyStore } from '@/store/endRoundEarlyStore';
import type { Hole } from '@/types';

const ROUND_ID = 'round-ee';

const mockStoreState = {
  currentRoundId: ROUND_ID as string | null,
  currentPlayers: [{ id: 'player-1', name: 'Sam' }],
  holes: [] as Hole[],
  isInitialized: true,
  nineType: 'full',
  loadFromOffline: jest.fn(() => Promise.resolve(true)),
  initializeRound: jest.fn(() => Promise.resolve()),
  ensureTeamMemberScorecards: jest.fn(() => Promise.resolve()),
  resetRound: jest.fn(),
  updateHoles: jest.fn(() => Promise.resolve()),
  setAllowedPlayers: jest.fn(),
};

jest.mock('@/store/scorecardStore', () => {
  const useScorecardStore = jest.fn(() => mockStoreState);
  (useScorecardStore as unknown as { getState: () => unknown }).getState = () => ({
    ...mockStoreState,
    groupScorecards: new Map(),
  });
  (useScorecardStore as unknown as { setState: (s: unknown) => void }).setState = jest.fn();
  return { useScorecardStore };
});

// Stable objects: the hook's callbacks depend on their identity.
const mockMetadata = {
  data: {
    id: ROUND_ID,
    gameType: 'stroke',
    isTeamRound: false,
    teamFormat: null,
    roundFormat: 'combined',
    scoringPairsRequired: false,
    ballCount: 1,
    selectedTee: null,
    selectedTeeData: null,
    courseId: 'course-1',
    courseName: 'Test Course',
    clubName: null,
    courseTees: [],
    roundStatus: 'in-progress',
    teamConfig: null,
    handicapSource: 'profile',
    nineType: 'full',
    holesPlayed: null as number | null,
    playerTeeMap: new Map(),
  },
  isLoading: false,
  error: null,
  refetch: jest.fn(),
};
const mockPlayersHook = {
  players: [{ id: 'player-1', name: 'Sam', email: '' }],
  getPlayer: jest.fn(),
  isLoading: false,
  error: null,
  refetch: jest.fn(),
};
const mockCourseHook = {
  course: null,
  holes: Array.from({ length: 18 }, (_, i) => ({ number: i + 1, par: 4, strokeIndex: i + 1 })),
  startHole: 1,
  getHole: jest.fn(),
  isLoading: false,
  error: null,
  refetch: jest.fn(),
};
const mockTeamsHook = { teams: [], getPlayerTeam: jest.fn(), isLoading: false, error: null, refetch: jest.fn() };
const mockScoringPairsHook = {
  playersToScore: [],
  scoringPairsEnabled: false,
  isLoading: false,
  error: null,
  refetch: jest.fn(),
  myScorer: null,
  isOwnScore: jest.fn(),
};

jest.mock('@/hooks/scorecard/useRoundMetadata', () => ({ useRoundMetadata: () => mockMetadata }));
jest.mock('@/hooks/scorecard/useRoundPlayers', () => ({ useRoundPlayers: () => mockPlayersHook }));
jest.mock('@/hooks/scorecard/useRoundCourse', () => ({ useRoundCourse: () => mockCourseHook }));
jest.mock('@/hooks/scorecard/useRoundTeams', () => ({ useRoundTeams: () => mockTeamsHook }));
jest.mock('@/hooks/scorecard/useRoundScoringPairs', () => ({
  useRoundScoringPairs: () => mockScoringPairsHook,
}));

jest.mock('@/store/initializeRoundSlice', () => ({
  getOfflinePlayersForRound: jest.fn(() => Promise.resolve([])),
}));
jest.mock('@/services/offline/database', () => ({
  saveScorecard: jest.fn(() => Promise.resolve()),
  markScorecardAsSynced: jest.fn(() => Promise.resolve()),
}));
jest.mock('@/services/diagnostics', () => ({ pushDiagnostic: jest.fn() }));
jest.mock('@/services/supabase/client', () => ({
  supabase: {
    from: jest.fn(() => {
      const chain: Record<string, jest.Mock> = {};
      chain.select = jest.fn(() => chain);
      chain.eq = jest.fn(() => chain);
      chain.update = jest.fn(() => chain);
      chain.is = jest.fn(() => Promise.resolve({ data: [], error: null }));
      return chain;
    }),
  },
}));
jest.mock('@/utils/debugLogger', () => {
  const makeLogger = () => ({ info: jest.fn(), debug: jest.fn(), warn: jest.fn(), error: jest.fn() });
  return {
    roundDataLogger: makeLogger(),
    storeLogger: makeLogger(),
    createModuleLogger: jest.fn(() => makeLogger()),
  };
});

const tick = () => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 20));

describe('useRoundData — nine_type guard vs. end-round-early', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    jest.clearAllMocks();
    useEndRoundEarlyStore.setState({ records: {} });
    mockStoreState.nineType = 'full';
    mockMetadata.data.nineType = 'full';
  });

  it('resets when the server nine_type changed under the store (characterization)', async () => {
    mockStoreState.nineType = 'full';
    mockMetadata.data.nineType = 'front9';

    renderHook(() => useRoundData({ roundId: ROUND_ID, competitionId: '' }));
    await tick();

    expect(mockStoreState.resetRound).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

  it('does not reset a pending front-9 conversion while the server row still says full', async () => {
    useEndRoundEarlyStore.setState({
      records: {
        [ROUND_ID]: { holesPlayed: 9, convertToFront9: true, originalNineType: 'full', endedAt: '2026-10-07T00:00:00.000Z' },
      },
    });
    mockStoreState.nineType = 'front9';
    mockMetadata.data.nineType = 'full';

    renderHook(() => useRoundData({ roundId: ROUND_ID, competitionId: '' }));
    await tick();

    expect(mockStoreState.resetRound).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});
```

```ts
    // carries the nine type the round was ended under, so it can stand in for
    // the server row. Bailing would hand init to the network path, which can't
    // run offline — and the round would come back as a full round with holes
    // N+1… re-enabled (Review Focus #1).
    await waitForEndRoundEarlyHydration();
    const endEarlyRecord = getEndRoundEarlyRecord(roundId);

    // If the metadata fetch failed (or returned no nine_type) and there is no
    // local record, we can't safely filter cachedHoles here — silently using
    // 'full' would resume a Front 9 / Back 9 round with all 18 holes visible.
    // Bail so useRoundData falls through to its hook-driven init path, which
    // uses useRoundMetadata (with React Query retry) to resolve nine_type
    // before calling initializeRound. initializeRound then filters defensively.
    if (!nineTypeKnown && !endEarlyRecord) {
      storeLogger.warn(
        'Could not determine nine_type during offline load — falling back to network init',
        { roundId }
      );
      pushDiagnostic('offline_load.nine_type_unknown', { roundId }, 'warn');
      set({ isLoading: false });
      return false;
    }

    if (!nineTypeKnown && endEarlyRecord) {
      // No server row: the record also carries the round's scoring context,
      // so a stroke / match round isn't totalled as the 'stableford' default.
      if (endEarlyRecord.gameType) gameType = endEarlyRecord.gameType;
      if (endEarlyRecord.handicapSource) handicapSource = endEarlyRecord.handicapSource;
      pushDiagnostic('offline_load.shape_from_local_record', { roundId }, 'warn');
    }

    const shape = resolveRoundShape(
      nineTypeKnown ? { nine_type: nineType, holes_played: serverHolesPlayed } : null,
      endEarlyRecord
    );
    nineType = shape.nineType;
```

**Can social rounds reach mismatch resolution? Yes**, so B4 applies the same rule there.
- `checkSubmissionReadiness` → `checkMultiScorerReadiness` (`src/services/scoreMismatch/submission.ts:110-140`) isn't gated on competitions. It applies whenever two or more distinct users wrote `score_entries` for the group's players. For example, two phones in a social round both score the whole group, so both have full scope and both may end early.
- The resolution can run on the **other** phone after this phone submitted (`useResolveMismatch` → `applyResolvedScoreToScorecard`, `src/hooks/scoreMismatch/mutations.ts:114`). At that point `rounds.holes_played` is already set, and today's code would rewrite `total_net` as gross − DHC.
- The bypass path (`applyBypassScores`) runs before this device's own snapshot, so the snapshot overwrites it. It goes through the same function anyway.
- `forceFinalizeRound` (the other `recomputeScorecardTotals` caller) is the organiser override for **competition** rounds only (`forceFinalizeRound.ts:1-9`). It passes no options and is unchanged.

```ts
// ============================================================================
// TOTAL_NET SNAPSHOT (rounds ended early)
// ============================================================================

describe('syncScorecard — total_net snapshot', () => {
  // Flat par-4 holes, SI = hole number. The tee makes the daily handicap easy
  // to check: ((18 × 113/113) + (72 − 72)) × 0.93 × 0.9986 = 16.72 → 17,
  // so every hole with SI 1–17 gives one stroke.
  const PAR_4_HOLES: Hole[] = Array.from({ length: 18 }, (_, i) => ({
    number: (i + 1) as Hole['number'],
    par: 4 as Hole['par'],
    strokeIndex: i + 1,
  }));
  const TEE: TeeBox = { name: 'Members', color: 'white', courseRating: 72, slopeRating: 113 };

  /** Fives on holes 1–6 (gross 30); holes 7–18 unscored. */
  function sixHoleCard(overrides: Partial<Scorecard> = {}): Scorecard {
    const scores: Scorecard['scores'] = {};
    for (let hole = 1; hole <= 6; hole++) scores[hole] = { strokes: 5 };
    return createTestScorecard({
      scores,
      totalGross: 30,
      totalNet: 24,
      teeData: TEE,
      coursePar: 72,
      playerGender: 'male',
      playerHandicap: 18,
      syncHoles: PAR_4_HOLES,
      syncGameType: 'stroke',
      syncNineType: 'full',
      ...overrides,
    });
  }

  function lastSnapshot(): Record<string, unknown> {
    const calls = (supabase.rpc as jest.Mock).mock.calls.filter(
      ([fn]) => fn === 'write_scorecard_snapshot'
    );
    const params = calls[calls.length - 1]?.[1] as { p_snapshot: Record<string, unknown> };
    return params.p_snapshot;
  }

  it('nets a card with no end-early stamp as gross − daily handicap (locks current behaviour)', async () => {
    await syncScorecard(sixHoleCard());

    expect(lastSnapshot().daily_handicap_used).toBe(17);
    expect(lastSnapshot().total_net).toBe(13); // 30 − 17
  });
});
```

```ts
/**
 * Calculate statistics for all players in a scorecard display
 *
 * @param players Array of player data with scores
 * @param holes The round's planned holes. Narrowed to `options.nineType`
 *   (a no-op for an already nine-filtered list and for 'full').
 * @param selectedTee Optional tee data with slope/course ratings for daily handicap calculation
 * @param handicapSource Which handicap value to use ('profile' = profile handicap, 'calculated' = Social Index, 'none' = no handicap)
 * @param options.nineType The round's nine type. A 9-hole round's live daily
 *   handicap pairs its 9-hole par with a 9-hole rating (invariant I4), as the
 *   synced `daily_handicap_used` does. Defaults to 'full'.
 * @returns Array of player statistics
 */
export function calculatePlayerStats(
  players: ScorecardPlayerData[],
  holes: Hole[],
  selectedTee?: TeeBox | null,
  handicapSource: HandicapSource = 'profile',
  options?: { nineType?: NineType | null }
): PlayerStats[] {
  // Guard against non-array holes data, then narrow to the round's nine
  // (callers on the course's raw holes get the nine's Σpar, not 72).
  const nineType: NineType = options?.nineType ?? 'full';
  const safeHoles = filterHolesByNineType(Array.isArray(holes) ? holes : [], nineType);

  // Calculate course par once for daily handicap calculations
  const coursePar = safeHoles.reduce((sum, hole) => sum + hole.par, 0);
```

Replacement (A2c's `nineType` option, nine filter and `calculateTeeDailyHandicap` DHC branch all stay; this adds `holesPlayed`):

```ts
/**
 * Calculate statistics for all players in a scorecard display
 *
 * @param players Array of player data with scores
 * @param holes The round's PLANNED holes. Narrowed to `options.nineType`
 *   (a no-op for an already nine-filtered list and for 'full'). The daily
 *   handicap is derived from their Σpar, so never pass a played-only slice.
 * @param selectedTee Optional tee data with slope/course ratings for daily handicap calculation
 * @param handicapSource Which handicap value to use ('profile' = profile handicap, 'calculated' = Social Index, 'none' = no handicap)
 * @param options.nineType The round's nine type. A 9-hole round's live daily
 *   handicap pairs its 9-hole par with a 9-hole rating (invariant I4), as the
 *   synced `daily_handicap_used` does. Defaults to 'full'.
 * @param options.holesPlayed Set when the round was ended early (`rounds.holes_played`):
 *   totals count only the first N planned holes, and net is Σ(gross − strokes
 *   received) over them instead of gross − the full daily handicap.
 * @returns Array of player statistics
 */
export function calculatePlayerStats(
  players: ScorecardPlayerData[],
  holes: Hole[],
  selectedTee?: TeeBox | null,
  handicapSource: HandicapSource = 'profile',
  options?: { nineType?: NineType | null; holesPlayed?: number | null }
): PlayerStats[] {
  // Guard against non-array holes data, then narrow to the round's nine
  // (callers on the course's raw holes get the nine's Σpar, not 72).
  const nineType: NineType = options?.nineType ?? 'full';
  const safeHoles = filterHolesByNineType(Array.isArray(holes) ? holes : [], nineType);

  // Course par for the daily handicap — always over the PLANNED holes, even
  // for a round ended early.
  const coursePar = safeHoles.reduce((sum, hole) => sum + hole.par, 0);

  // Ended early: only the first N planned holes count toward totals.
  // `safeHoles` is already nine-filtered, so 'full' keeps it as-is and takes
  // the first N.
  const holesPlayed = options?.holesPlayed ?? null;
  const isEndedEarly = holesPlayed != null && holesPlayed > 0;
  const scoringHoles = isEndedEarly
    ? filterPlayableHoles(safeHoles, 'full', holesPlayed)
    : safeHoles;
```

Add this new function directly after `calculatePlayerStats`'s closing `}` (line 250), before the `/** Calculate par totals ...` comment:

```ts
/**
 * Net total over the holes a player actually played: Σ(effective gross −
 * strokes received). Used for rounds ended early (`rounds.holes_played` set),
 * where gross − the full daily handicap would credit strokes for holes never
 * played. Shared by calculatePlayerStats, the sync snapshot (scorecardSync)
 * and mismatch resolution (recomputeScorecardTotals) so all three agree.
 *
 * - `holes` must be the PLAYED holes; `dailyHandicap` is the planned round's.
 * - Pickups count as net double bogey (getEffectiveGrossStrokes), matching the
 *   stored gross.
 * - Unscored holes and multi-ball scores are skipped (single-ball only, like
 *   the sync payload).
 * - Plus handicaps get no strokes back (getStrokesReceived floors at 0),
 *   exactly as the live store totals behave.
 */
export function calculateNetOverHolesPlayed(
  scores: Record<number, HoleScore | MultiBallHoleScore> | null | undefined,
  holes: Hole[],
  dailyHandicap: number
): number {
  let net = 0;
  for (const hole of holes) {
    const score = scores?.[hole.number];
    if (!score || !isSingleBallScore(score)) continue;
    const strokesReceived = getStrokesReceived(dailyHandicap, hole.strokeIndex);
    const strokes = getEffectiveGrossStrokes(score.strokes, hole.par, strokesReceived);
    if (strokes == null) continue;
    net += strokes - strokesReceived;
  }
  return net;
}
```

```ts
/**
```

Replacement:

```ts
/**
 * total_net for the scorecard snapshot.
 *
 * - With a daily handicap: gross − daily_handicap_used, matching
 *   calculatePlayerStats. Derived here rather than trusting the store's live
 *   total, which can drift if tee/handicap context was missing during score
 *   entry — and for Stableford the store overloads totalNet = points.
 * - Ended early (`syncHolesPlayed`, stamped by submitScorecards): Σ(gross −
 *   strokes received) over the holes played, computed from the per-hole
 *   scores; daily_handicap_used stays the planned round's value.
 * - No daily handicap: the store's totalNet, as before.
 */
function calculateSnapshotTotalNet(scorecard: Scorecard, dailyHandicap: number | null): number {
  if (dailyHandicap == null) {
    return scorecard.totalNet || 0;
  }

  const holesPlayed = scorecard.syncHolesPlayed;
  const holes = scorecard.syncHoles;
  if (holesPlayed != null && holesPlayed > 0 && Array.isArray(holes) && holes.length > 0) {
    const playedHoles = filterPlayableHoles(holes, scorecard.syncNineType ?? 'full', holesPlayed);
    return calculateNetOverHolesPlayed(scorecard.scores, playedHoles, dailyHandicap);
  }

  return (scorecard.totalGross || 0) - dailyHandicap;
}

/**
 * Sync score entries for mismatch detection
 */
```

```ts
  const holesPlayed = options?.holesPlayed ?? null;
  let totalNet: number | null = null;
  if (dhc != null) {
    totalNet =
      holesPlayed != null && holesPlayed > 0 && holeList.length > 0
        ? calculateNetOverHolesPlayed(
            scores,
            filterPlayableHoles(holeList, options?.nineType ?? 'full', holesPlayed),
            dhc
          )
        : totalGross - dhc;
  }
```

- [ ] **Step 15: Write the failing SQLite round-trip tests (fallback sync path)**

There are two sync paths:
- **The queued path** stores the whole `Scorecard` JSON in `pending_syncs`, so `syncHolesPlayed` survives.
- **The fallback path** (`syncOrchestrator.ts:352-371`) re-reads completed, unsynced cards through `ScorecardDAO.rowToScorecard`. That function never restores `syncHoles`/`syncNineType`/`syncGameType`, and would drop `syncHolesPlayed`.

On the fallback path, `calculateSnapshotTotalNet` would net an ended-early card as gross − DHC. The DHC itself would also use `nineType 'full'`, which is wrong for 9-hole rounds (a pre-existing bug, fixed by the same change). That path runs when a completed card exists without a queue item, for example after a crash between `saveScorecard` and `queueScorecardSync`.

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes:
  - `filterPlayableHoles(holes, nineType, holesPlayed)` (B2, `src/utils/holeTransformers.ts`)
  - A1a/A1b/A2a functions
- Produces (contract):
  - `calculateMatchStatus(holeResults, totalHoles = 18, holesPlayed?: number | null): MatchStatus`
  - `calculateTeamMatchStatus(holeResults, totalHoles = 18, holesPlayed?: number | null): TeamMatchStatus`
  - `computeStandaloneMatchResult(p1, p2, holes, holesPlayed?: number | null): StandaloneMatchResult | null`
- Also produces:
  - `export function resolveEndedAfter(plannedHoles: number, holesPlayed?: number | null): number | null` (`src/utils/matchPlayResult.ts`)
  - `calculateAllData(holes, p1Id, p2Id, getPlayerScore, p1Hcp = 0, p2Hcp = 0, holesPlayed: number | null = null)`
  - `calculateTeamMatchData(holes, team1, team2, getPlayerScore, holesPlayed: number | null = null)`
  - `computeMatchPlaySubMatch(sides, holes, getStrokes, holesPlayed: number | null = null)`
- Rule:
  - `holes` / `totalHoles` are always the **planned** (nine-filtered) holes.
  - With `holesPlayed`, a close-out against the planned count reached at any hole ≤ N stands. Otherwise, once N holes are decided, the result is `'N up'` / `'All Square'` (pill `'N UP'` / `'A/S'`).
- B11 documents the ended-early clause under I10.

```ts
/**
 * The ended-early hole count to honour, or null when the round was played as
 * planned. Only a positive whole number below the planned holes counts —
 * `holesPlayed` ≥ planned is just a normal finish.
 */
export function resolveEndedAfter(
  plannedHoles: number,
  holesPlayed?: number | null
): number | null {
  if (holesPlayed == null || !Number.isInteger(holesPlayed)) return null;
  if (holesPlayed <= 0 || holesPlayed >= plannedHoles) return null;
  return holesPlayed;
}
```

- **Replace the whole `computeStandaloneMatchResult` function** (doc comment through closing `}`; leave `toResult` as is) with:

```ts
/**
 * Compute a two-player match result from raw scorecards and the round's
 * planned (nine-filtered) holes. Returns null when no hole has a score from
 * both players.
 *
 * `holesPlayed` set means the round ended early after that many holes: only
 * the first `holesPlayed` holes are walked, a close-out against the planned
 * hole count still stands, and otherwise the leader wins "N UP" (level "A/S").
 *
 * A card with holes left unscored and no close-out, not ended early (legacy /
 * incomplete data), still reports "N&M" against the unplayed holes.
 */
export function computeStandaloneMatchResult(
  p1: ScorecardForMatchPlay,
  p2: ScorecardForMatchPlay,
  holes: Hole[],
  holesPlayed?: number | null
): StandaloneMatchResult | null {
  const dhc1 = p1.daily_handicap_used ?? 0;
  const dhc2 = p2.daily_handicap_used ?? 0;

  const sortedHoles = [...holes].sort((a, b) => a.number - b.number);
  const totalHoles = sortedHoles.length;
  // The holes are already the round's nine, so 'full' applies only the
  // played cut (the first N holes) when the round ended early.
  const endedAfter = resolveEndedAfter(totalHoles, holesPlayed);
  const walkedHoles = filterPlayableHoles(sortedHoles, 'full', endedAfter);

  let player1Up = 0;
  let decided = 0;

  for (const hole of walkedHoles) {
    const score1 = p1.scores?.[String(hole.number)];
    const score2 = p2.scores?.[String(hole.number)];
    const gross1 =
      score1 && isSingleBallScore(score1) && score1.strokes > 0
        ? score1.strokes
        : null;
    const gross2 =
      score2 && isSingleBallScore(score2) && score2.strokes > 0
        ? score2.strokes
        : null;
    if (gross1 == null || gross2 == null) continue;

    // Difference method: the lower-DHC player plays off scratch and the
    // higher-DHC player receives the difference on this hole.
    const { a: strokes1, b: strokes2 } = getMatchPlayStrokes(
      dhc1,
      dhc2,
      hole.strokeIndex
    );

    const net1 = gross1 - strokes1;
    const net2 = gross2 - strokes2;

    decided++;
    if (net1 < net2) player1Up++;
    else if (net2 < net1) player1Up--;

    // Early finish — decided when the lead beats the PLANNED holes left. On
    // the last planned hole (0 remaining) toResult formats it "N UP".
    const holesRemaining = totalHoles - decided;
    if (Math.abs(player1Up) > holesRemaining) {
      return toResult(p1, p2, player1Up, holesRemaining);
    }
  }

  if (decided === 0) return null;
  // An ended-early round has nothing left to play: the leader wins "N UP".
  const holesRemaining = endedAfter !== null ? 0 : totalHoles - decided;
  return toResult(p1, p2, player1Up, holesRemaining);
}
```


with

```ts
/**
 * Calculate match status from hole results.
 *
 * `totalHoles` is the planned hole count (9 or 18). Margins:
 * - closed out with holes still to play → "N & M"
 * - no holes left → "N up", or "All Square" when level — never "N & 0" (I10)
 *
 * `holesPlayed` (a positive count below `totalHoles`) means the round ended
 * early after that many holes: a close-out reached against the planned holes
 * stands; otherwise, once `holesPlayed` holes are decided, the leader wins
 * "N up" (level = "All Square").
 */
export function calculateMatchStatus(
  holeResults: Record<number, HoleResult>,
  totalHoles: number = 18,
  holesPlayed?: number | null
): MatchStatus {
  const endedAfter = resolveEndedAfter(totalHoles, holesPlayed);
  if (endedAfter !== null) {
    return calculateEndedEarlyMatchStatus(holeResults, totalHoles, endedAfter);
  }

  let player1Up = 0;
```

- **After `calculateMatchStatus` closes** (before `getMatchStatusText`), add:

```ts
/**
 * Status of a match ended early after `endedAfter` decided holes. Walks the
 * decided holes in hole order: the first close-out against the planned
 * `totalHoles` stands (at least one planned hole is always left, so it is
 * never "& 0"); otherwise the lead after `endedAfter` decided holes wins
 * "N up". Fewer decided holes than that is still in progress — the running
 * status of a scorecard row mid-way through the played holes.
 */
function calculateEndedEarlyMatchStatus(
  holeResults: Record<number, HoleResult>,
  totalHoles: number,
  endedAfter: number
): MatchStatus {
  const holeNumbers = Object.keys(holeResults)
    .map(Number)
    .sort((a, b) => a - b);
  let player1Up = 0;
  let decided = 0;

  for (const holeNumber of holeNumbers) {
    if (decided === endedAfter) break;
    const holeWinner = holeResults[holeNumber]?.winner;
    if (!holeWinner) continue;
    decided++;
    if (holeWinner === 'player1') player1Up++;
    else if (holeWinner === 'player2') player1Up--;

    const plannedRemaining = totalHoles - decided;
    const lead = Math.abs(player1Up);
    if (lead > plannedRemaining) {
      const closedOutBy = player1Up > 0 ? 'player1' : 'player2';
      return { status: 'complete', winner: closedOutBy, margin: `${lead} & ${plannedRemaining}` };
    }
  }

  const absLead = Math.abs(player1Up);
  const ahead = player1Up > 0 ? 'player1' : 'player2';

  if (decided < endedAfter) {
    const holesRemaining = totalHoles - decided;
    if (player1Up === 0) {
      return { status: 'in_progress', leader: null, holesUp: 0, holesRemaining };
    }
    return { status: 'in_progress', leader: ahead, holesUp: absLead, holesRemaining };
  }

  if (player1Up === 0) {
    return { status: 'complete', winner: 'halved', margin: 'All Square' };
  }
  return { status: 'complete', winner: ahead, margin: `${absLead} up` };
}
```

```tsx
/**
 * TeamMatchPlayScorecardTable — ended-early rendering.
 */

import React from 'react';
import { render, screen } from '@/__tests__/utils/renderHelpers';
import { TeamMatchPlayScorecardTable } from './index';
import type { Hole } from '@/types/database.types';
import type { MatchTeam } from '@/screens/scoring/TeamMatchPlayScoringScreen/types';

const eighteen: Hole[] = Array.from(
  { length: 18 },
  (_, i) => ({ number: i + 1, par: 4, strokeIndex: i + 1 }) as Hole
);
const reds: MatchTeam = {
  id: 'r',
  name: 'Reds',
  handicap: 0,
  members: [{ id: 'r1', name: 'R1', handicap: 0, score: null, pickedUp: false }],
};
const blues: MatchTeam = {
  id: 'b',
  name: 'Blues',
  handicap: 0,
  members: [{ id: 'b1', name: 'B1', handicap: 0, score: null, pickedUp: false }],
};
// Reds win holes 1-2 (3 v 4), halve 3-6; nothing after 6.
const getPlayerScore = (playerId: string, holeNumber: number): number | undefined => {
  if (holeNumber > 6) return undefined;
  if (playerId === 'r1') return holeNumber <= 2 ? 3 : 4;
  return 4;
};

describe('TeamMatchPlayScorecardTable — ended early (holesPlayed)', () => {
  it('renders only the played holes and settles the match on the lead', () => {
    render(
      <TeamMatchPlayScorecardTable
        holes={eighteen}
        team1={reds}
        team2={blues}
        getPlayerScore={getPlayerScore}
        holesPlayed={6}
      />
    );

    expect(screen.getAllByText('6').length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
    expect(screen.queryByText('7')).toBeNull();
    expect(screen.queryByText('18')).toBeNull();
    expect(screen.getAllByText('R 2 up')).toHaveLength(2);
  });

  it('renders every planned hole when played as planned (characterization)', () => {
    render(
      <TeamMatchPlayScorecardTable holes={eighteen} team1={reds} team2={blues} getPlayerScore={getPlayerScore} />
    );

    expect(screen.getAllByText('18').length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
  });
});
```

  with

```tsx
export const MatchPlayScorecardTable = React.memo(function MatchPlayScorecardTable({
  holes,
  player1,
  player2,
  getPlayerScore,
  onHolePress,
  player1Handicap = 0,
  player2Handicap = 0,
  startHole = 1,
  holesPlayed = null,
}: MatchPlayScorecardTableProps) {
  const colors = useThemeColors();

  // Rows show only the holes played; the planned `holes` still drive the
  // match maths in calculateAllData. ('full': `holes` is already nine-filtered.)
  const playedHoles = useMemo(
    () => filterPlayableHoles(holes, 'full', holesPlayed),
    [holes, holesPlayed]
  );

  // Split holes into front 9 and back 9
  const front9Holes = useMemo(
    () => playedHoles.filter((h) => h.number <= 9).sort((a, b) => a.number - b.number),
    [playedHoles]
  );
  const back9Holes = useMemo(
    () => playedHoles.filter((h) => h.number > 9).sort((a, b) => a.number - b.number),
    [playedHoles]
  );

  // Calculate all match data
  const data = useMemo(
    () =>
      calculateAllData(
        holes,
        player1.id,
        player2.id,
        getPlayerScore,
        player1Handicap,
        player2Handicap,
        holesPlayed
      ),
    [holes, player1.id, player2.id, getPlayerScore, player1Handicap, player2Handicap, holesPlayed]
  );
```

```ts
/**
 * describeEndRoundEarlyResult / planFromEndedEarlyRecord
 *
 * The confirmation sheet's one-line result must agree with the shared match /
 * leaderboard rules: no holes remaining ⇒ "N UP" / "A/S" (never "N & M"),
 * a real close-out against the planned holes stands, and only the holes that
 * will count are considered.
 */

import { describeEndRoundEarlyResult, planFromEndedEarlyRecord } from './endRoundEarly';
import type { EndRoundEarlyStatsRow } from './endRoundEarly';
import type { HoleResult } from '@/screens/scoring/MatchPlayScoringScreen/types';
import type { TeamHoleResult } from '@/screens/scoring/TeamMatchPlayScoringScreen/types';

function singles(winners: Record<number, HoleResult['winner']>): Record<number, HoleResult> {
  const results: Record<number, HoleResult> = {};
  for (const [hole, winner] of Object.entries(winners)) {
    results[Number(hole)] = {
      player1Score: 4,
      player2Score: 4,
      player1PickedUp: false,
      player2PickedUp: false,
      winner,
    };
  }
  return results;
}

function teams(winners: Record<number, TeamHoleResult['winner']>): Record<number, TeamHoleResult> {
  const results: Record<number, TeamHoleResult> = {};
  for (const [hole, winner] of Object.entries(winners)) {
    results[Number(hole)] = {
      team1Score: 4,
      team2Score: 4,
      team1PlayerScores: {},
      team2PlayerScores: {},
      winner,
    };
  }
  return results;
}

const holesOneTo = (n: number) => Array.from({ length: n }, (_, i) => i + 1);

function row(playerName: string, values: Partial<EndRoundEarlyStatsRow>): EndRoundEarlyStatsRow {
  return { playerName, totalNet: 0, totalStableford: 0, totalParScore: 0, ...values };
}
```

```ts
// =====================================================
// RESULT PREVIEW (End round early confirmation)
// =====================================================

/** Live match state a match-play scoring screen hands to the preview. */
export type EndRoundEarlyMatchContext =
  | { kind: 'singles'; holeResults: Record<number, HoleResult>; names: [string, string] }
  | { kind: 'team'; holeResults: Record<number, TeamHoleResult>; names: [string, string] };

/** Per-player totals the stroke / stableford / par preview ranks on (a PlayerStats subset). */
export interface EndRoundEarlyStatsRow {
  playerName: string;
  totalNet: number;
  totalStableford: number;
  totalParScore: number;
}

export type EndRoundEarlyResultInput =
  | (EndRoundEarlyMatchContext & {
      /** Hole numbers that will count: the first N (holes 1–9 for a front-9 conversion). */
      playedHoleNumbers: number[];
      /** Planned hole count the match is measured against (9 after a front-9 conversion). */
      plannedHoles: number;
      /** N for a round ended early; null for a front-9 conversion (a genuine 9-hole match). */
      holesPlayed: number | null;
    })
  | { kind: 'stableford' | 'stroke' | 'par'; stats: EndRoundEarlyStatsRow[] };

type MatchOutcome = { winner: 'side1' | 'side2' | 'halved'; margin: string };

function pickPlayedResults<T>(
  holeResults: Record<number, T>,
  playedHoleNumbers: number[]
): Record<number, T> {
  const played: Record<number, T> = {};
  for (const holeNumber of playedHoleNumbers) {
    const result = holeResults[holeNumber];
    if (result !== undefined) played[holeNumber] = result;
  }
  return played;
}

function resolveMatchOutcome(
  input: Extract<EndRoundEarlyResultInput, { kind: 'singles' | 'team' }>
): MatchOutcome | null {
  if (input.kind === 'singles') {
    const status = calculateMatchStatus(
      pickPlayedResults(input.holeResults, input.playedHoleNumbers),
      input.plannedHoles,
      input.holesPlayed
    );
    if (status.status !== 'complete') return null;
    const winner =
      status.winner === 'player1' ? 'side1' : status.winner === 'player2' ? 'side2' : 'halved';
    return { winner, margin: status.margin };
  }

  const status = calculateTeamMatchStatus(
    pickPlayedResults(input.holeResults, input.playedHoleNumbers),
    input.plannedHoles,
    input.holesPlayed
  );
  if (status.status !== 'complete') return null;
  const winner =
    status.winner === 'team1' ? 'side1' : status.winner === 'team2' ? 'side2' : 'halved';
  return { winner, margin: status.margin };
}

function formatNet(value: number): string {
  return Number.isInteger(value) ? `${value}` : value.toFixed(1);
}

function formatParScore(value: number): string {
  return value > 0 ? `+${value}` : `${value}`;
}

function describeLeader(
  kind: 'stableford' | 'stroke' | 'par',
  stats: EndRoundEarlyStatsRow[]
): string | null {
  if (stats.length === 0) return null;

  const valueOf = (entry: EndRoundEarlyStatsRow): number =>
    kind === 'stableford'
      ? entry.totalStableford
      : kind === 'par'
        ? entry.totalParScore
        : entry.totalNet;
  // Stroke: lowest net wins. Stableford and Par: highest wins.
  const ranked = [...stats].sort((a, b) =>
    kind === 'stroke' ? valueOf(a) - valueOf(b) : valueOf(b) - valueOf(a)
  );
  const best = valueOf(ranked[0]);
  const label =
    kind === 'stableford' ? `${best} pts` : kind === 'par' ? formatParScore(best) : `net ${formatNet(best)}`;

  if (stats.length === 1) return `${ranked[0].playerName}: ${label}`;
  const tied = ranked.filter((entry) => valueOf(entry) === best).length > 1;
  return tied ? `Tied on ${label}` : `${ranked[0].playerName} leads on ${label}`;
}

/**
 * One-line result for the End-round-early confirmation, e.g. "Dave wins 2 UP",
 * "Halved (A/S)", "Dave wins 5 & 4", "Sam leads on 31 pts".
 *
 * Pure. Match status comes from calculateMatchStatus / calculateTeamMatchStatus
 * over the played holes (planned count + holesPlayed, so a real close-out
 * stands and otherwise the final lead wins "N UP"). Totals come from the
 * caller (calculatePlayerStats with { holesPlayed }). Returns null when there
 * is nothing meaningful to show.
 */
export function describeEndRoundEarlyResult(input: EndRoundEarlyResultInput): string | null {
  if (input.kind === 'singles' || input.kind === 'team') {
    const outcome = resolveMatchOutcome(input);
    if (!outcome) return null;
    if (outcome.winner === 'halved') return 'Halved (A/S)';
    const winnerName = outcome.winner === 'side1' ? input.names[0] : input.names[1];
    return `${winnerName} wins ${outcome.margin.toUpperCase()}`;
  }
  return describeLeader(input.kind, input.stats);
}

/**
 * Rebuild the plan an already-ended round stands for (a persisted end-early
 * record, or a store whose holesPlayed came from the round row), so a
 * relaunch can route to the finish screen. removedScores is empty: those
 * scores were already removed when the round was ended.
 */
export function planFromEndedEarlyRecord(
  record: Pick<EndedEarlyRecord, 'holesPlayed' | 'convertToFront9' | 'originalNineType'>
): EndRoundEarlyPlan {
  return {
    holesPlayed: record.holesPlayed,
    plannedHoles: getHoleCount(record.originalNineType),
    nineType: record.originalNineType,
    convertToFront9: record.convertToFront9,
    lastHoleNumber: lastPlayedHoleNumber(record.originalNineType, record.holesPlayed),
    removedScores: [],
  };
}
```

```tsx
import React from 'react';

    loading: false,
    onConfirm: jest.fn(),
    onCancel: jest.fn(),
    ...overrides,
  };
  render(<EndRoundEarlySheet {...props} />);
  return props;
}

describe('EndRoundEarlySheet', () => {

    expect(screen.getByText('End round early')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText('End round after hole 6?')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText('Dave wins 2 UP')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText("This round won't count towards your handicap index.")).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.queryByText(/front-9 round/)).toBeNull();
  });

    renderSheet({
      plan: makePlan({
        removedScores: [
          { playerId: 'p2', playerName: 'Sam', holeNumber: 7 },

        ],
      }),
    });

    expect(screen.getByText('These scores will be removed:')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText('Sam – hole 7')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText('Dave – hole 8')).toBeTruthy();

  it('omits the removed-scores section when nothing is removed', () => {

    ).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.queryByText("This round won't count towards your handicap index.")).toBeNull();
  });

    });

    expect(screen.getByText('Sam – hole 16')).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('hides the result row when there is no preview', () => {
    renderSheet({ resultPreview: null });
    expect(screen.queryByText('Dave wins 2 UP')).toBeNull();
  });

  it('Keep playing cancels; End round confirms', () => {
    const props = renderSheet();

    fireEvent.press(screen.getByText('Keep playing'));
    expect(props.onCancel).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);

    fireEvent.press(screen.getByText('End round'));
    expect(props.onConfirm).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

  it('disables both actions and shows progress while ending', () => {
    const props = renderSheet({ loading: true });

    expect(screen.getByText('Ending…')).toBeTruthy();
    fireEvent.press(screen.getByTestId('end-round-early-confirm'));
    fireEvent.press(screen.getByTestId('end-round-early-cancel'));
    expect(props.onConfirm).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(props.onCancel).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('renders nothing without a plan', () => {
    renderSheet({ plan: null });
    expect(screen.queryByTestId('bottom-sheet')).toBeNull();
  });
});
```
