```tsx
/**
 * EndRoundEarlySheet — confirmation for ending a social round early.
 *
 * Presentational: the plan (finishing hole, removed scores, front-9
 * conversion) comes from planEndRoundEarly and the one-line result from
 * describeEndRoundEarlyResult, both supplied by useEndRoundEarly.
 *
 * Renders inline via BottomSheet (no RN <Modal>, `useModal` off) like
 * ChangeTeesSheet, so it sits in the screen's own theme and needs no
 * SystemModalTheme wrap.
 */

import React from 'react';
import { View, StyleSheet, ScrollView, TouchableOpacity } from 'react-native';
import { Text, Icon } from 'react-native-paper';

import { BottomSheet } from '@/components/common/BottomSheet';
import { useThemeColors } from '@/context/ThemeContext';
import { spacing, typography, borderRadius } from '@/constants/theme';
import { displayHoleNumber } from '@/utils/holeTransformers';
import type { EndRoundEarlyPlan } from '@/utils/endRoundEarly';

export interface EndRoundEarlySheetProps {
  visible: boolean;
  plan: EndRoundEarlyPlan | null;
  /** e.g. "Dave wins 2 UP", "Halved (A/S)", "Sam leads on 31 pts" */
  resultPreview: string | null;
  loading?: boolean;
  /** Display offset for combo courses (default 1); copy uses displayHoleNumber. */
  startHole?: number;
  onConfirm: () => void;
  onCancel: () => void;
}

export function EndRoundEarlySheet({
  visible,
  plan,
  resultPreview,
  loading = false,
  startHole = 1,
  onConfirm,
  onCancel,
}: EndRoundEarlySheetProps) {
  const colors = useThemeColors();

  if (!plan) return null;

  return (
    <BottomSheet
      visible={visible}
      onClose={onCancel}
      height={0.6}
      title="End round early"
      testID="end-round-early-sheet"
    >
      <View style={styles.container}>
        <ScrollView style={styles.body} contentContainerStyle={styles.bodyContent}>
          <Text style={[styles.question, { color: colors.textPrimary }]}>
            {`End round after hole ${displayHoleNumber(plan.lastHoleNumber, startHole)}?`}
          </Text>

          {resultPreview ? (
            <View style={[styles.resultRow, { backgroundColor: colors.surfaceVariant }]}>
              <Icon source="trophy-outline" size={20} color={colors.primary} />
              <Text style={[styles.resultText, { color: colors.textPrimary }]}>{resultPreview}</Text>
            </View>
          ) : null}

          {plan.removedScores.length > 0 ? (
            <View style={styles.section}>
              <Text style={[styles.sectionLabel, { color: colors.textSecondary }]}>
                These scores will be removed:
              </Text>
              {plan.removedScores.map((removed) => (
                <Text
                  key={`${removed.playerId}-${removed.holeNumber}`}
                  style={[styles.removedRow, { color: colors.textPrimary }]}
                >
                  {`${removed.playerName} – hole ${displayHoleNumber(removed.holeNumber, startHole)}`}
                </Text>
              ))}
            </View>
          ) : null}

          <View style={styles.noticeRow}>
            <Icon
              source={plan.convertToFront9 ? 'information-outline' : 'alert-circle-outline'}
              size={18}
              color={colors.textSecondary}
            />
            <Text style={[styles.noticeText, { color: colors.textSecondary }]}>
              {plan.convertToFront9
                ? 'This becomes a front-9 round. Results are recalculated on 9-hole handicaps.'
                : "This round won't count towards your handicap index."}
            </Text>
          </View>
        </ScrollView>

        <View style={styles.actions}>
          <TouchableOpacity
            style={[
              styles.button,
              styles.keepButton,
              { borderColor: colors.border, backgroundColor: colors.surfaceVariant },
              loading && styles.buttonDisabled,
            ]}
            onPress={onCancel}
            disabled={loading}
            activeOpacity={0.7}
            accessibilityRole="button"
            accessibilityLabel="Keep playing"
            testID="end-round-early-cancel"
          >
            <Text style={[styles.buttonLabel, { color: colors.textPrimary }]}>Keep playing</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
          <TouchableOpacity
            style={[styles.button, { backgroundColor: colors.error }, loading && styles.buttonDisabled]}
            onPress={onConfirm}
            disabled={loading}
            activeOpacity={0.8}
            accessibilityRole="button"
            accessibilityLabel="End round"
            accessibilityState={{ disabled: loading, busy: loading }}
            testID="end-round-early-confirm"
          >
            <Text style={[styles.buttonLabel, { color: colors.white }]}>
              {loading ? 'Ending…' : 'End round'}
            </Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>
      </View>
    </BottomSheet>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  container: {
    flex: 1,
    paddingHorizontal: spacing.lg,
    paddingBottom: spacing.lg,
  },
  body: {
    flex: 1,
  },
  bodyContent: {
    gap: spacing.md,
    paddingBottom: spacing.md,
  },
  question: {
    ...typography.bodyBold,
  },
  resultRow: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    alignItems: 'center',
    gap: spacing.sm,
    padding: spacing.md,
    borderRadius: borderRadius.lg,
  },
  resultText: {
    ...typography.bodyBold,
    flex: 1,
  },
  section: {
    gap: spacing.xs,
  },
  sectionLabel: {
    ...typography.small,
  },
  removedRow: {
    ...typography.body,
  },
  noticeRow: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    alignItems: 'flex-start',
    gap: spacing.sm,
  },
  noticeText: {
    ...typography.small,
    flex: 1,
  },
  actions: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    gap: spacing.md,
    paddingTop: spacing.md,
  },
  button: {
    flex: 1,
    height: 48,
    borderRadius: borderRadius.lg,
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',
  },
  keepButton: {
    borderWidth: 1,
  },
  buttonDisabled: {
    opacity: 0.6,
  },
  buttonLabel: {
    ...typography.bodyBold,
  },
});

export default EndRoundEarlySheet;
```

```ts
/**
 * useEndRoundEarly — gating, result preview, confirm and relaunch routing.
 *
 * The scoring store is mocked (shape only). The end-early record store, the
 * planner and the scoring utils are real, so the gate is tested end to end.
 */

import { renderHook, act, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react-native';
import { useEndRoundEarly } from './useEndRoundEarly';
import { useScorecardStore } from '@/store/scorecardStore';
import { useEndRoundEarlyStore } from '@/store/endRoundEarlyStore';
import { create18Holes } from '@/__tests__/utils/testFixtures';
import type { EndedEarlyRecord } from '@/utils/roundShape';
import type { EndRoundEarlyMatchContext, EndRoundEarlyPlan } from '@/utils/endRoundEarly';
import type { HoleResult } from '@/screens/scoring/MatchPlayScoringScreen/types';
import type { Player, Scorecard } from '@/types';

jest.mock('@/store/scorecardStore', () => ({
  useScorecardStore: jest.fn(),
}));

const mockShowErrorToast = jest.fn();
jest.mock('@/context/ToastContext', () => ({
  useToast: () => ({ showErrorToast: mockShowErrorToast }),
}));

const mockedUseScorecardStore = useScorecardStore as jest.MockedFunction<typeof useScorecardStore>;
const mockEndRoundEarly = jest.fn();

const holes = create18Holes();
const alice: Player = { id: 'p1', name: 'Alice', email: 'alice@test.com', handicap: 0 };
const bob: Player = { id: 'p2', name: 'Bob', email: 'bob@test.com', handicap: 0 };

/** Holes 1..throughHole scored for both players — Alice pars, Bob bogeys. */
function cards(
  throughHole: number,
  status: Scorecard['status'] = 'in-progress'
): Map<string, Scorecard> {
  const card = (player: Player, overPar: number): Scorecard => {
    const scores: Scorecard['scores'] = {};
    for (const hole of holes) {
      if (hole.number <= throughHole) scores[hole.number] = { strokes: hole.par + overPar };
    }
    return {
      id: `sc-${player.id}`,
      roundId: 'round-1',
      playerId: player.id,
      player,
      scores,
      totalGross: 0,
      totalNet: 0,
      status,
      createdAt: new Date('2026-10-07T00:00:00Z'),
      updatedAt: new Date('2026-10-07T00:00:00Z'),
    };
  };
  return new Map([
    [alice.id, card(alice, 0)],
    [bob.id, card(bob, 1)],
  ]);
}

function mockStore(overrides: Record<string, unknown> = {}) {
  mockedUseScorecardStore.mockReturnValue({
    currentRoundId: 'round-1',
    holes,
    nineType: 'full',
    holesPlayed: null,
    startHole: 1,
    currentPlayers: [alice, bob],
    groupScorecards: cards(6),
    allowedPlayerIds: [],
    playerTeeMap: new Map(),
    selectedTeeData: null,
    handicapSource: 'none',
    endRoundEarly: mockEndRoundEarly,
    ...overrides,
  } as any);
}

const baseArgs = { roundId: 'round-1', isStandalone: true, gameType: 'stroke' as const };

beforeEach(() => {
  mockEndRoundEarly.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
  useEndRoundEarlyStore.setState({ records: {} });
  mockStore();
});

describe('useEndRoundEarly — when it is offered', () => {
  it('offers the action on a standalone round with a complete hole and holes left to play', () => {
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useEndRoundEarly({ ...baseArgs, onEnded: jest.fn() }));

    expect(result.current.canEndRoundEarly).toBe(true);
    act(() => result.current.open());
    expect(result.current.sheetProps.visible).toBe(true);
    expect(result.current.sheetProps.plan).toMatchObject({
      holesPlayed: 6,
      plannedHoles: 18,
      lastHoleNumber: 6,
      convertToFront9: false,
    });
  });

  it('hides the action when this device scores only part of the round (Review Focus #5)', () => {
    mockStore({ allowedPlayerIds: ['p1'] });
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useEndRoundEarly({ ...baseArgs, onEnded: jest.fn() }));

    expect(result.current.canEndRoundEarly).toBe(false);
  });

  it('still offers it when the scoring scope lists every player', () => {
    // ScorecardEntryScreen always mirrors its on-screen players into allowedPlayerIds.
    mockStore({ allowedPlayerIds: ['p1', 'p2'] });
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useEndRoundEarly({ ...baseArgs, onEnded: jest.fn() }));

    expect(result.current.canEndRoundEarly).toBe(true);
  });

  const hiddenCases: [string, Partial<typeof baseArgs>, Record<string, unknown>][] = [
    ['a competition round', { isStandalone: false }, {}],
    ['a round already ended (holesPlayed set)', {}, { holesPlayed: 6 }],
    ['a round with a submitted card', {}, { groupScorecards: cards(6, 'completed') }],
    ['a round with no hole complete for every player', {}, { groupScorecards: cards(0) }],
    ['a round with every planned hole complete', {}, { groupScorecards: cards(18) }],
    ['a store still holding another round', {}, { currentRoundId: 'round-2' }],
  ];

  it.each(hiddenCases)('hides the action for %s', (_label, args, store) => {
    mockStore(store);
    const { result } = renderHook(() =>
      useEndRoundEarly({ ...baseArgs, ...args, onEnded: jest.fn() })
    );

    expect(result.current.canEndRoundEarly).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe('useEndRoundEarly — result preview', () => {
  it('previews the net leader over the holes played', () => {
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useEndRoundEarly({ ...baseArgs, onEnded: jest.fn() }));
    act(() => result.current.open());

    // handicapSource 'none' ⇒ net = gross: Alice pars holes 1–6 (23), Bob bogeys (29).
    expect(result.current.sheetProps.resultPreview).toBe('Alice leads on net 23');
  });

  it('shows no preview for team stroke formats', () => {
    const { result } = renderHook(() =>
      useEndRoundEarly({ ...baseArgs, teamFormat: 'best-ball', onEnded: jest.fn() })
    );
    act(() => result.current.open());

    expect(result.current.sheetProps.resultPreview).toBeNull();
  });

  it("previews the match result from the screen's match context", () => {
    const won = (winner: HoleResult['winner']): HoleResult => ({
      player1Score: 4,
      player2Score: 4,
      player1PickedUp: false,
      player2PickedUp: false,
      winner,
    });
    const getMatchContext = (): EndRoundEarlyMatchContext => ({
      kind: 'singles',
      names: ['Alice', 'Bob'],
      holeResults: {
        1: won('player1'),
        2: won('player1'),
        3: won('halved'),
        4: won('halved'),
        5: won('halved'),
        6: won('halved'),
      },
    });
    const { result } = renderHook(() =>
      useEndRoundEarly({ ...baseArgs, gameType: 'match-play', getMatchContext, onEnded: jest.fn() })
    );
    act(() => result.current.open());

    expect(result.current.sheetProps.resultPreview).toBe('Alice wins 2 UP');
  });
});

describe('useEndRoundEarly — confirm', () => {
  it('ends the round locally, closes the sheet, then hands the plan to the screen', async () => {
    const onEnded = jest.fn();
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useEndRoundEarly({ ...baseArgs, onEnded }));
    act(() => result.current.open());
    const plan = result.current.sheetProps.plan as EndRoundEarlyPlan;

    act(() => result.current.sheetProps.onConfirm());

    await waitFor(() => expect(onEnded).toHaveBeenCalledWith(plan));
    expect(mockEndRoundEarly).toHaveBeenCalledWith(plan);
    expect(mockEndRoundEarly.mock.invocationCallOrder[0]).toBeLessThan(
      onEnded.mock.invocationCallOrder[0]
    );
    expect(result.current.sheetProps.visible).toBe(false);

    act(() => result.current.open());

    await waitFor(() => expect(onEnded).toHaveBeenCalled());
    await act(async () => {});
    expect(onEnded).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);

  it('keeps the sheet open and does not navigate when ending fails', async () => {
    mockEndRoundEarly.mockRejectedValue(new Error('disk full'));
    const onEnded = jest.fn();
```

Create `src/hooks/scorecard/useEndRoundEarly.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * useEndRoundEarly
 *
 * Drives "End round early" on the three scoring screens (stroke / stableford /
 * par entry, singles match play, team match play):
 * - decides whether the action is offered (canEndRoundEarly);
 * - builds the plan (N, removed scores, front-9 conversion) via planEndRoundEarly;
 * - builds the one-line preview via describeEndRoundEarlyResult;
 * - on confirm, ends the round locally (store.endRoundEarly) and hands the
 *   plan to the screen, which navigates to its finish screen;
 * - when the round is already ended (store holesPlayed set, or a pending
 *   local record — e.g. the app was killed before submit), routes to the
 *   finish screen once, so the round never reopens on hole N+1.
 *
 * Offline-safe: reads only the scoring store and the persisted end-early record.
 */

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { useScorecardStore } from '@/store/scorecardStore';
import { useEndRoundEarlyStore } from '@/store/endRoundEarlyStore';
import { useToast } from '@/context/ToastContext';
import { getHoleCount } from '@/constants/scoring';
import { filterHolesByNineType, filterPlayableHoles } from '@/utils/holeTransformers';
import { calculatePlayerStats } from '@/utils/scorecardCalculations';
import {
  describeEndRoundEarlyResult,
  planEndRoundEarly,
  planFromEndedEarlyRecord,
  type EndRoundEarlyMatchContext,
  type EndRoundEarlyPlan,
  type EndRoundEarlyStatsRow,
} from '@/utils/endRoundEarly';
import { scoringLogger } from '@/utils/debugLogger';
import type { EndRoundEarlySheetProps } from '@/components/scorecard/EndRoundEarlySheet';
import type { GameType, HandicapSource, NineType, TeamFormat } from '@/types/database/enums';
import type { Hole, Player, Scorecard, TeeBox } from '@/types';

export interface UseEndRoundEarlyArgs {
  roundId: string;
  /** From the round row (competition_id == null) — NOT route params. */
  isStandalone: boolean;
  gameType: GameType;
  /**
   * Fires once the round has been ended early — or already was, on relaunch.
   * The screen navigates to its finish screen (Review, or MatchPlayScorecard
   * for singles).
   */
  onEnded: (plan: EndRoundEarlyPlan) => void;
  /** Round team format. Team stroke formats get no result preview. */
  teamFormat?: TeamFormat | null;
  /**
   * Match-play screens: returns the live match state (hole results computed
   * with the screen's match handicaps). Called when the sheet opens.
   */
  getMatchContext?: () => EndRoundEarlyMatchContext;
}

export interface UseEndRoundEarlyResult {
  canEndRoundEarly: boolean;
  open: () => void;
  sheetProps: EndRoundEarlySheetProps;
}

interface PreviewInputs {
  plan: EndRoundEarlyPlan;
  holes: Hole[];
  gameType: GameType;
  teamFormat: TeamFormat | null;
  getMatchContext?: () => EndRoundEarlyMatchContext;
  players: Player[];
  scorecards: Map<string, Scorecard>;
  playerTeeMap: Map<string, TeeBox>;
  selectedTeeData: TeeBox | null;
  handicapSource: HandicapSource;
}

/**
 * The preview runs the same math the finish screen will: the round's planned
 * holes after ending (front 1–9 for a 9-of-18 conversion, otherwise
 * unchanged) plus holesPlayed — never a played-only slice — so the daily
 * handicap (derived from Σpar) is the one the round keeps.
 */
function buildResultPreview({
  plan,
  holes,
  gameType,
  teamFormat,
  getMatchContext,
  players,
  scorecards,
  playerTeeMap,
  selectedTeeData,
  handicapSource,
}: PreviewInputs): string | null {
  const plannedNineType: NineType = plan.convertToFront9 ? 'front9' : plan.nineType;
  const plannedHoles = plan.convertToFront9 ? filterHolesByNineType(holes, 'front9') : holes;
  const holesPlayed = plan.convertToFront9 ? null : plan.holesPlayed;

  const matchContext = getMatchContext?.();
  if (matchContext) {
    const playedHoleNumbers = filterPlayableHoles(plannedHoles, plannedNineType, holesPlayed).map(
      (hole) => hole.number
    );
    return describeEndRoundEarlyResult({
      ...matchContext,
      playedHoleNumbers,
      plannedHoles: getHoleCount(plannedNineType),
      holesPlayed,
    });
  }

  if (teamFormat) return null;
  if (gameType !== 'stroke' && gameType !== 'stableford' && gameType !== 'par') return null;

  const stats: EndRoundEarlyStatsRow[] = players.map((player) => {
    const scorecard = scorecards.get(player.id);
    const [playerStats] = calculatePlayerStats(
      [
        {
          id: player.id,
          playerId: player.id,
          player: {
            id: player.id,
            name: player.name,
            handicap: player.handicap ?? null,
            handicap_index: player.handicapIndex ?? null,
            gender: player.gender ?? null,
          },
          scores: scorecard?.scores ?? null,
          hasScorecard: !!scorecard,
        },
      ],
      plannedHoles,
      playerTeeMap.get(player.id) ?? selectedTeeData,
      handicapSource,
      { holesPlayed }
    );
    return playerStats;
  });

  return describeEndRoundEarlyResult({ kind: gameType, stats });
}

export function useEndRoundEarly({
  roundId,
  isStandalone,
  gameType,
  onEnded,
  teamFormat = null,
  getMatchContext,
}: UseEndRoundEarlyArgs): UseEndRoundEarlyResult {
  const {
    currentRoundId,
    holes,
    nineType,
    holesPlayed,
    startHole,
    currentPlayers,
    groupScorecards,
    allowedPlayerIds,
    playerTeeMap,
    selectedTeeData,
    handicapSource,
    endRoundEarly,
  } = useScorecardStore();
  const pendingRecord = useEndRoundEarlyStore((state) => state.records[roundId]);
  const { showErrorToast } = useToast();

  const [visible, setVisible] = useState(false);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  // Set once this screen has routed to the finish screen for the current end,
  // so a confirm and the pending-record effect never both navigate.
  const routedToFinishRef = useRef(false);

  const isLoadedForRound =
    currentRoundId === roundId && holes.length > 0 && currentPlayers.length > 0;

  // R11: only a device that scores every player may end the round, otherwise
  // another group's cards could hold more holes than N. An empty scope means
  // "everyone"; ScorecardEntryScreen always mirrors its on-screen players into
  // allowedPlayerIds, so a scope listing every player also qualifies.
  const scoresEveryPlayer =
    allowedPlayerIds.length === 0 ||
    currentPlayers.every((player) => allowedPlayerIds.includes(player.id));

  // "Round still in progress", decidable offline: nothing submitted yet.
  const anyCardSubmitted = useMemo(
    () =>
      Array.from(groupScorecards.values()).some(
        (card) => card.status === 'completed' || card.status === 'confirmed'
      ),
    [groupScorecards]
  );

  const plan = useMemo(() => {
    if (!isStandalone || !isLoadedForRound || !scoresEveryPlayer) return null;
    if (holesPlayed != null || pendingRecord || anyCardSubmitted) return null;
    return planEndRoundEarly({
      holes,
      nineType,
      players: currentPlayers.map((player) => ({ id: player.id, name: player.name })),
      scorecards: groupScorecards,
    });
  }, [
    isStandalone,
    isLoadedForRound,
    scoresEveryPlayer,
    holesPlayed,
    pendingRecord,
    anyCardSubmitted,
    holes,
    nineType,
    currentPlayers,
    groupScorecards,
  ]);

  // Built only while the sheet is open (the match getter reads live state).
  const resultPreview = useMemo(() => {
    if (!visible || !plan) return null;
    return buildResultPreview({
      plan,
      holes,
      gameType,
      teamFormat,
      getMatchContext,
      players: currentPlayers,
      scorecards: groupScorecards,
      playerTeeMap,
      selectedTeeData,
      handicapSource,
    });
  }, [
    visible,
    plan,
    holes,
    gameType,
    teamFormat,
    getMatchContext,
    currentPlayers,
    groupScorecards,
    playerTeeMap,
    selectedTeeData,
    handicapSource,
  ]);

  // Relaunch (Review Focus #1): the round is already ended — the store resolved
  // holesPlayed (from the local record or the round row), or a local record
  // exists (incl. a 9-of-18 conversion, where the store is front9 with
  // holesPlayed null). Route to the finish screen once per mount instead of
  // reopening on hole N+1. Not gated on isStandalone: only a standalone round
  // can be ended early, and an offline cold start can't read competition_id.
  const alreadyEndedPlan = useMemo(() => {
    if (!isLoadedForRound) return null;
    if (pendingRecord) return planFromEndedEarlyRecord(pendingRecord);
    if (holesPlayed != null) {
      return planFromEndedEarlyRecord({
        holesPlayed,
        convertToFront9: false,
        originalNineType: nineType,
      });
    }
    return null;
  }, [isLoadedForRound, pendingRecord, holesPlayed, nineType]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!alreadyEndedPlan || routedToFinishRef.current) return;
    routedToFinishRef.current = true;
    onEnded(alreadyEndedPlan);
  }, [alreadyEndedPlan, onEnded]);

  const open = useCallback(() => {
    if (plan) setVisible(true);
  }, [plan]);

  const handleCancel = useCallback(() => {
    if (!loading) setVisible(false);
  }, [loading]);

  const handleConfirm = useCallback(() => {
    if (!plan || loading) return;
    const confirmedPlan = plan;
    // Claim the route before the store writes the local record, so the
    // pending-record effect doesn't navigate a second time.
    routedToFinishRef.current = true;
    setLoading(true);
    void (async () => {
      try {
        await endRoundEarly(confirmedPlan);
        setVisible(false);
        onEnded(confirmedPlan);
      } catch (error) {
        routedToFinishRef.current = false;
        scoringLogger.error('End round early failed', error, {
          roundId: roundId.substring(0, 8) + '...',
        });
        showErrorToast('Could not end the round', 'Please try again.');
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    })();
  }, [plan, loading, endRoundEarly, onEnded, roundId, showErrorToast]);

  return {
    canEndRoundEarly: plan !== null,
    open,
    sheetProps: {
      visible: visible && plan !== null,
      plan,
      resultPreview,
      loading,
      startHole,
      onConfirm: handleConfirm,
      onCancel: handleCancel,
    },
  };
}
```

```ts
/**
 * useScoreReview — submit validation over the holes that count.
 */

import { renderHook, act } from '@testing-library/react-native';
import { useScoreReview } from './useScoreReview';
import { useScorecardStore } from '@/store/scorecardStore';
import { create18Holes } from '@/__tests__/utils/testFixtures';
import type { Hole, Player, Scorecard } from '@/types';
import type { NineType } from '@/types/database/enums';

jest.mock('@/store/scorecardStore', () => ({
  useScorecardStore: jest.fn(),
}));

const mockedUseScorecardStore = useScorecardStore as jest.MockedFunction<typeof useScorecardStore>;

const alice = { id: 'p1', name: 'Alice', email: 'alice@test.com' } as Player;
const bob = { id: 'p2', name: 'Bob', email: 'bob@test.com' } as Player;

const range = (from: number, to: number) =>
  Array.from({ length: to - from + 1 }, (_, i) => from + i);

function card(player: Player, holeNumbers: number[]): Scorecard {
  const scores: Scorecard['scores'] = {};
  for (const holeNumber of holeNumbers) scores[holeNumber] = { strokes: 4 };
  return {
    id: `sc-${player.id}`,
    roundId: 'round-1',
    playerId: player.id,
    scores,
    totalGross: 0,
    totalNet: 0,
    status: 'in-progress',
    createdAt: new Date('2026-10-07T00:00:00Z'),
    updatedAt: new Date('2026-10-07T00:00:00Z'),
  };
}

function mockStore({
  holes,
  aliceHoles,
  bobHoles,
  nineType = 'full',
  holesPlayed = null,
}: {
  holes: Hole[];
  aliceHoles: number[];
  bobHoles: number[];
  nineType?: NineType;
  holesPlayed?: number | null;
}) {
  mockedUseScorecardStore.mockReturnValue({
    currentRoundId: 'round-1',
    currentPlayers: [alice, bob],
    groupScorecards: new Map([
      [alice.id, card(alice, aliceHoles)],
      [bob.id, card(bob, bobHoles)],
    ]),
    holes,
    gameType: 'stroke',
    getPlayerScore: jest.fn(),
    submitScorecards: jest.fn(),
    resetRound: jest.fn(),
    resumeRound: jest.fn(),
    setCurrentHole: jest.fn(),
    selectedTeeData: null,
    handicapSource: 'profile',
    startHole: 1,
    allowedPlayerIds: [],
    isMultiBall: false,
    ballCount: 1,
    nineType,
    holesPlayed,
  } as any);
}

describe('useScoreReview — validateScores', () => {
  it('reports every planned hole a player is missing (locks current behaviour)', () => {
    mockStore({ holes: create18Holes(), aliceHoles: range(1, 18), bobHoles: range(1, 17) });
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useScoreReview({}));

    let incomplete: ReturnType<typeof result.current.validateScores> = [];
    act(() => {
      incomplete = result.current.validateScores();
    });

    expect(incomplete).toEqual([
      { holeNumber: 18, missingPlayers: [{ id: 'p2', name: 'Bob' }] },
    ]);
  });
});
```

Create `src/components/scorecard/EndedEarlyBanner.tsx`:

```tsx
/**
 * EndedEarlyBanner — "Ended after N of M · Resume playing" strip on the finish
 * screens (Review & Submit, Match Play Scorecard) while the round has a
 * pending local end-early record. Presentational: the label comes from
 * formatEndedEarlyLabel and Resume is handled by the screen.
 */

import React from 'react';
import { View, StyleSheet, TouchableOpacity } from 'react-native';
import { Text, Icon } from 'react-native-paper';
import { useThemeColors } from '@/context/ThemeContext';
import { spacing, typography } from '@/constants/theme';
import { formatEndedEarlyLabel, type EndedEarlyRecord } from '@/utils/roundShape';

export interface EndedEarlyBannerProps {
  record: EndedEarlyRecord;
  onResume: () => void;
}

export function EndedEarlyBanner({ record, onResume }: EndedEarlyBannerProps) {
  const colors = useThemeColors();
  const label = formatEndedEarlyLabel(record.holesPlayed, record.originalNineType);
  const text = record.convertToFront9 ? `${label} — now a front-9 round` : label;

  return (
    <View
      style={[styles.container, { backgroundColor: colors.surfaceVariant, borderBottomColor: colors.border }]}
      testID="ended-early-banner"
    >
      <Icon source="flag-checkered" size={18} color={colors.textSecondary} />
      <Text style={[styles.label, { color: colors.textPrimary }]}>{text}</Text>
      <Text style={[styles.separator, { color: colors.textSecondary }]}>·</Text>
      <TouchableOpacity
        onPress={onResume}
        style={styles.resumeButton}
        activeOpacity={0.7}
        accessibilityRole="button"
        accessibilityLabel="Resume playing"
        testID="ended-early-resume"
      >
        <Text style={[styles.resumeText, { color: colors.primary }]}>Resume playing</Text>
      </TouchableOpacity>
    </View>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  container: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    alignItems: 'center',
    gap: spacing.sm,
    paddingHorizontal: spacing.lg,
    borderBottomWidth: 1,
  },
  label: {
    ...typography.smallBold,
    flexShrink: 1,
  },
  separator: {
    ...typography.small,
  },
  resumeButton: {
    minHeight: 44,
    justifyContent: 'center',
  },
  resumeText: {
    ...typography.smallBold,
  },
});

export default EndedEarlyBanner;
```

```ts
  const playerStats = useMemo(
    () => calculatePlayerStats(players, holes, selectedTeeData, handicapSource),
    [players, holes, selectedTeeData, handicapSource]
  );

    () => (Array.isArray(holes) ? holes : []).reduce((sum, hole) => sum + hole.par, 0),
```

Replacement:

```ts
  // Rows render the holes actually played: every planned hole, or the first N
  // once the round was ended early. `holes` is already the round's planned
  // (nine-filtered) list, so 'full' only takes the first N.
  const playedHoles = useMemo(
    () => filterPlayableHoles(Array.isArray(holes) ? holes : [], 'full', holesPlayed),
    [holes, holesPlayed]
  );

  // Calculate player statistics (with daily handicap if tee data available).
  // Planned holes + holesPlayed: the daily handicap derives from Σpar of the
  // planned holes, and net is per hole over the played ones.
  const playerStats = useMemo(
    () => calculatePlayerStats(players, holes, selectedTeeData, handicapSource, { holesPlayed }),
    [players, holes, selectedTeeData, handicapSource, holesPlayed]
  );

  // Par totals for the rows shown
  const parTotals = useMemo(() => calculateParTotals(playedHoles), [playedHoles]);

  // Course par for the daily handicap — always the planned holes
  const coursePar = useMemo(
    () => (Array.isArray(holes) ? holes : []).reduce((sum, hole) => sum + hole.par, 0),
    [holes]
  );

  // Split the rows shown
  const { front9, back9 } = useMemo(() => splitHolesByNine(playedHoles), [playedHoles]);
```

| Component (index.tsx line) | Receives | Why |
|---|---|---|
| `MatchScorecardTabContent` (410) | planned `holes` + B5's `holesPlayed` | Match status needs the planned count for close-outs. **B5 owns it; untouched here.** |
| `ScorecardTabContent` → `ScorecardTable` (423) | planned `holes` + `holesPlayed` | `calculatePlayerStats` derives DHC from Σpar of `holes`. It slices for rows internally (B7a). |
| `StatsTab` (460) | **played** holes | Render-only per-hole stats with no handicap math. Default `nineType='full'` doesn't re-filter. |
| `ContributionsTabContent` (470) | **played** holes | Per-hole contributions; `totalHoles = holes.length` should read N. |
| `SubMatchLeaderboardTab` (484) | planned `holes` (unchanged) | Split rounds are competition-only, so an ended-early round never reaches it. |
| `ScrambleLeaderboardTab` (502) | **played** holes | Team handicap comes from members (`calculateScrambleTeamHandicap`). Strokes are per hole, and "· N holes" compares to `holes.length`. |
| `MatchPlayLeaderboardTab` (515) | planned `holes` + B5's `holesPlayed` | Same as `MatchScorecardTabContent`. **B5 owns it.** |
| `LeaderboardTabContent` (530) | **played** holes | Per-hole net and points off `dailyHandicaps`, which `leaderboardDailyHandicaps` computes from the **planned** `holes` (kept). |
| `SkinsTabContent` / `WolfTabContent` / `ShotLogList` | played count via `holeCount` | "N of M holes completed" copy and the in-progress card hide at N. Payout pricing is A5's `SkinsHoleCounts`. |
| `PayoutsTabContent` (572) | unchanged | A5 threads the hole counts. |
| `leaderboardDailyHandicaps` memo (184) | planned `holes` (unchanged, comment added) | DHC from Σpar. |

`isAllComplete`, lines 160-165. Current:

```ts
  // Calculate if all holes are complete (both players have scores for all holes)
  const isAllComplete = useMemo(() => {
    if (holes.length === 0) return false;
    const completedCount = getCompletedHolesCount();
    return completedCount === holes.length;

```

Replacement:

```ts
  // Holes the match is settled over: every planned hole, or the first N once
  // the round has been ended early (holes after N were removed).
  const playedHoles = useMemo(
    () => filterPlayableHoles(holes, nineType, holesPlayed),
    [holes, nineType, holesPlayed]
  );

  // Played holes where both players have a score (a pickup counts).
  const completedPlayedHoleCount = useMemo(
    () =>
      playedHoles.filter(
        (hole) =>
          isHoleScored(getPlayerScore(player1.id, hole.number)) &&
          isHoleScored(getPlayerScore(player2.id, hole.number))
      ).length,
    [playedHoles, getPlayerScore, player1.id, player2.id, groupScorecards]
  );

  // Review & Submit is offered once every played hole is complete.
  const isAllComplete =
    playedHoles.length > 0 && completedPlayedHoleCount === playedHoles.length;
```

Create `src/services/rounds/applyEndRoundEarly.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * applyEndRoundEarly
 *
 * Writes a social round's early end to the server through the
 * `end_round_early` RPC — SECURITY DEFINER, because skins results can only be
 * deleted by the skins game's creator under RLS. It sets `holes_played = N`
 * (or converts an 18-hole round ended after exactly 9 to `front9`) and deletes
 * the round's skins results, wolf decisions and score entries after the last
 * played hole. Idempotent, so a queued retry is safe.
 */

import { supabase } from '@/services/supabase/client';
import { createError } from '@/services/errors';
import type { EndRoundEarlyPayload } from './finalizeSubmittedRound';

export async function applyEndRoundEarly(
  roundId: string,
  payload: EndRoundEarlyPayload
): Promise<void> {
  // Typed: B1 adds end_round_early to the Database functions. The RPC raises
  // for an out-of-range N or a front-9 conversion of a back-9 round; that
  // surfaces here as a thrown error, so the round is never finalised on it.
  const { error } = await supabase.rpc('end_round_early', {
    p_round_id: roundId,
    p_holes_played: payload.holesPlayed,
    p_convert_to_front9: payload.convertToFront9,
  });

  if (error) {
    throw createError(`Failed to end round early: ${error.message}`, 'DATABASE');
  }
}
```

(The type-only import from `./finalizeSubmittedRound` is erased at compile time, so there is no runtime cycle. If B1's typed `Functions` entry has a different shape, for example `p_convert_to_front9` marked optional, the call above still type-checks because all three args are passed.)

```ts
/**
 * Hole counts for a round with a pending (or just-applied) early end. Holes
 * stay priced on the nine type the round had when it was ended — so a front-9
 * conversion keeps its 18-hole hole values — and the pot is settled over the
 * holes played.
 */
export function getSkinsHoleCountsForRecord(record: {
  holesPlayed: number;
  originalNineType: NineType;
}): SkinsHoleCounts {
  const plannedHoles = getHoleCount(record.originalNineType);
  return { plannedHoles, holesPlayed: resolveHolesPlayed(record.holesPlayed, plannedHoles) };
}
```

Replace `src/services/rounds/finalizeSubmittedRound.ts` with the full file below. Differences from A6a:
- the payload types;
- the RPC step;
- the conversion override for skins;
- `finalizeOrQueueRound` reading and clearing the local record.

```ts
/**
 * finalizeSubmittedRound
 *
 * The server steps that follow a scorecard submission, shared by every submit
 * screen and by the offline sync queue:
 *
 *   0. applyEndRoundEarly — when the round was ended early: sets
 *      holes_played (or converts to front 9) and deletes side-game rows and
 *      score entries after the last played hole. Runs first so nothing below
 *      sees discarded holes.
 *   1. finalizeRoundStatus — flips the round to `completed` once every card is
 *      terminal (never earlier; see that service for the split / multi-group
 *      rules).
 *   2. refinalizeRoundResults — competition standings (a no-op for social
 *      rounds). Runs even when the round isn't complete yet, so standings
 *      update as each group submits — exactly as the old inline submit did.
 *   3. finalizeActiveSkinsForRound — settles the round's active skins game.
 *
 * Online, `finalizeOrQueueRound` runs it straight after `submitScorecards`.
 * Offline — or when the online attempt throws — it queues a `round` sync item
 * (queueRoundFinalize) that the sync queue runs after this device's scorecards
 * upload. Before this, an offline-submitted round was never marked completed.
 */

import { finalizeRoundStatus } from './finalizeRoundStatus';
import { refinalizeRoundResults } from './refinalizeRoundResults';
import { applyEndRoundEarly } from './applyEndRoundEarly';
import { finalizeActiveSkinsForRound } from '@/services/skins/finalizeSkinsGame';
import { addPendingSync } from '@/services/offline/database';
import { getIsOnline } from '@/services/offline/sync/networkState';
import { queryClient } from '@/services/queryClient';
import {
  getEndRoundEarlyRecord,
  useEndRoundEarlyStore,
  waitForEndRoundEarlyHydration,
} from '@/store/endRoundEarlyStore';
import { getSkinsHoleCountsForRecord } from '@/utils/skins/holeCounts';
import { roundKeys, skinsKeys } from '@/hooks/queryKeys';
import { submitLogger } from '@/utils/debugLogger';
import type { SkinsGame } from '@/types/database/skins.types';

/** A social round ended early (applied by the `end_round_early` RPC). */
export interface EndRoundEarlyPayload {
  /** N — holes played, counted from the round's first hole. */
  holesPlayed: number;
  /** True only for an 18-hole round ended after exactly 9 (becomes front 9). */
  convertToFront9: boolean;
}

export interface FinalizeSubmittedRoundOptions {
  /** Apply this early end before finalising. Queued items carry it. */
  endRoundEarly?: EndRoundEarlyPayload;
}

export interface FinalizeSubmittedRoundResult {
  /** True when the round is `completed` on the server — set now or already. */
  completed: boolean;
  /** The skins game this call settled, or null when there was none to settle. */
  skinsGame: SkinsGame | null;
}

export interface FinalizeOrQueueResult extends FinalizeSubmittedRoundResult {
  /** True when the steps were queued for the next sync instead of run now. */
  queued: boolean;
}

const shortId = (roundId: string): string => roundId.substring(0, 8) + '...';

/**
 * Run the post-submit steps. Resolves `completed: false` (no throw) while not
 * every scorecard is terminal. A failed early end throws before anything else
 * runs; a database error writing the status is rethrown after results and
 * skins have still run — either way the caller can retry with the same
 * options.
 */
export async function finalizeSubmittedRound(
  roundId: string,
  opts: FinalizeSubmittedRoundOptions = {}
): Promise<FinalizeSubmittedRoundResult> {
  if (opts.endRoundEarly) {
    await applyEndRoundEarly(roundId, opts.endRoundEarly);
  }

  let completed = false;
  let statusError: unknown = null;
  try {
    completed = await finalizeRoundStatus(roundId);
  } catch (error) {
    statusError = error;
    submitLogger.error('Round status update failed', error, { roundId: shortId(roundId) });
  }

  await refinalizeRoundResults(roundId);

  // A front-9 conversion leaves the round row reading "front 9, played as
  // planned", but its skins holes were priced while it was an 18 — settle on
  // 18 planned / 9 played so the payouts stay zero-sum. Every other round's
  // counts come from the row (holes_played was just written above).
  const skinsHoleCounts = opts.endRoundEarly?.convertToFront9
    ? getSkinsHoleCountsForRecord({
        holesPlayed: opts.endRoundEarly.holesPlayed,
        originalNineType: 'full',
      })
    : undefined;
  const skins = await finalizeActiveSkinsForRound(roundId, skinsHoleCounts);
  if (skins.error) {
    submitLogger.warn('Skins finalization failed (non-blocking)', {
      roundId: shortId(roundId),
      error: skins.error,
    });
  }

  queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: roundKeys.detail(roundId) });
  if (skins.finalized) {
    queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: skinsKeys.all });
  }

  if (statusError) throw statusError;

  return { completed, skinsGame: skins.game ?? null };
}

/**
 * Queue the post-submit steps as a durable `round` sync item (entity key
 * `round:<roundId>`), carrying any early-end payload. The sync queue runs
 * `round` items after this device's scorecards in each drain.
 */
export async function queueRoundFinalize(
  roundId: string,
  opts: FinalizeSubmittedRoundOptions = {}
): Promise<void> {
  await addPendingSync({
    type: 'round',
    action: 'update',
    data: { id: roundId, action: 'finalize', ...opts },
    timestamp: new Date(),
    retryCount: 0,
  });
  submitLogger.info('Round finalisation queued for sync', { roundId: shortId(roundId) });
}

/**
 * The step every submit path runs after `submitScorecards`: finalise now when
 * online, otherwise — or when the online attempt fails — queue it. A pending
 * local end-early record becomes the payload, so every submit screen carries
 * it; once the end is on the server (or in the queued item) the record is
 * cleared. Online-ness comes from the sync layer, the same signal
 * `submitScorecards` uses. Rejects only when queueing itself fails (the record
 * is then kept).
 */
export async function finalizeOrQueueRound(roundId: string): Promise<FinalizeOrQueueResult> {
  // The record is AsyncStorage-persisted; never read it before rehydration.
  await waitForEndRoundEarlyHydration();
  const record = getEndRoundEarlyRecord(roundId);
  const opts: FinalizeSubmittedRoundOptions = record
    ? {
        endRoundEarly: {
          holesPlayed: record.holesPlayed,
          convertToFront9: record.convertToFront9,
        },
      }
    : {};

  if (getIsOnline()) {
    try {
      const result = await finalizeSubmittedRound(roundId, opts);
      clearEndRecord(roundId, opts);
      return { ...result, queued: false };
    } catch (error) {
      submitLogger.warn('Round finalisation failed online — queueing a retry', {
        roundId: shortId(roundId),
        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
      });
    }
  }

  await queueRoundFinalize(roundId, opts);
  clearEndRecord(roundId, opts);
  return { completed: false, skinsGame: null, queued: true };
}

/**
 * The early end now lives on the server or in the queued item; the local
 * record has done its job. This only drops the persisted record — the scoring
 * store's holesPlayed is untouched until the submit flow's resetRound, which
 * runs after the round achievements have read it.
 */
function clearEndRecord(roundId: string, opts: FinalizeSubmittedRoundOptions): void {
  if (opts.endRoundEarly) {
    useEndRoundEarlyStore.getState().clearRecord(roundId);
  }
}
```

The sync handler from A6a already calls `finalizeSubmittedRound(sync.data.id, sync.data)`, and `sync.data` now carries `endRoundEarly`. No orchestrator change is needed.

### Task B8b: Ending early on Review/MatchPlayScorecard — readiness and skins preview

> **Merge with A2c/A2d (drafted later; read before Step 1).** This task's "Current" snippets quote code from before A2c/A2d. Where they differ, keep every A2c/A2d change and add this task's change on top:
> - Review `index.tsx`: A2d already declares `const storeNineType = useScorecardStore((s) => s.nineType);`. This task's replacement block must **omit** its own `const storeNineType = …` line.

**Readiness decision for social rounds (documented here and in a code comment).**

Today `checkSubmissionReadiness` runs for every online submit, social rounds included. It runs the scoring-pairs check if pairs are configured, and otherwise the multi-scorer auto-detect. That is unchanged for rounds played as planned.

For a round with a pending local end-early record, readiness is **skipped**:
- **Nobody to wait for.** "End round early" is only offered when this device scores every player (R11), so there's no partner or other group.
- **False blocks.** The server still holds `score_entries` for holes after N until `end_round_early` deletes them at finalise. Checking now would compare discarded holes and raise false mismatches or "waiting for other scorers".
- **The RPC can't move earlier.** If it ran before readiness, a blocked submit followed by Resume would leave `holes_played` on the server while play continues.

The skins previews on Review and MatchPlayScorecard switch to the local record: original planned holes, N played. They then match what B8a settles, including the 18/9 front-9 conversion.

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/screens/scoring/ReviewScorecardScreen/hooks/useScoreSubmission.ts` (import; readiness gate ~lines 421-427)

- Modify: `src/screens/scoring/ReviewScorecardScreen/index.tsx` (the A5d `skinsHoleCounts` block + imports)
- Modify: `src/screens/scoring/MatchPlayScorecardScreen/index.tsx` (the A5d `skinsHoleCounts` memo + imports)

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `getEndRoundEarlyRecord`, `useEndRoundEarlyStore` (B3); `getSkinsHoleCountsForRecord` (B8a); `getSkinsHoleCounts` (A5a)

```ts
/** A match-play card with gross strokes keyed by hole number. DHC 0 ⇒ no shots given. */
function card(id: string, name: string, strokes: Record<number, number>): ScorecardForMatchPlay {
  const scores: Record<string, HoleScore> = {};
  for (const [hole, value] of Object.entries(strokes)) {
    scores[hole] = { strokes: value };
  }
  return { player_id: id, scores, daily_handicap_used: 0, player: { id, name } };

/** Sam shoots 4 on every hole; Bob shoots 5 on `bobLoses`, 4 elsewhere. */

  const sam: Record<number, number> = {};
  const bob: Record<number, number> = {};
  for (const n of holeNumbers) {
    sam[n] = 4;
    bob[n] = bobLoses.includes(n) ? 5 : 4;
  }
  return [card('sam', 'Sam', sam), card('bob', 'Bob', bob)] as const;
}
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Implement `roundListMeta.ts`**

Create `src/screens/rounds/RoundListScreen/hooks/roundListMeta.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * Per-round hole metadata for the Rounds list.
 *
 * The list re-runs calculatePlayerStats and the match-play pill for completed
 * rounds so its totals match the scorecard view. That view narrows the course
 * to the round's nine_type, so this does too. A 9-hole match fed all 18 course
 * holes read as unfinished ("2&9"), and a 9-hole card's daily-handicap fallback
 * summed an 18-hole par.
 *
 * `holes` are the PLANNED holes. `holesPlayed` (rounds.holes_played) is set for
 * a social round that was ended early. Callers pass both, so the daily handicap
 * stays on the planned round, and nets and match results settle over the holes
 * played.
 */

import { filterHolesByNineType } from '@/utils/holeTransformers';
import type { Hole, TeeBox } from '@/types/database/base';
import type { HandicapSource, NineType } from '@/types/database/enums';

export interface RoundListMeta {
  /** Planned holes: the course's holes narrowed to the round's nine_type. */
  holes: Hole[];
  selectedTee: TeeBox | null;
  handicapSource: HandicapSource;
  /** rounds.holes_played — set when the round was ended early, else null. */
  holesPlayed: number | null;
}

/** The slice of a rounds row (with its course) the list selects. */
export interface RoundListMetaSource {
  nine_type: string | null;
  holes_played?: number | null;
  handicap_source: HandicapSource | null;
  selected_tee: TeeBox | null;
  courses: { holes: unknown[] | null } | null;
}

function toNineType(value: string | null | undefined): NineType {
  return value === 'front9' || value === 'back9' ? value : 'full';
}

export function buildRoundListMeta(round: RoundListMetaSource): RoundListMeta {
  const courseHoles = Array.isArray(round.courses?.holes)
    ? (round.courses!.holes as Hole[])
    : [];
  return {
    holes: filterHolesByNineType(courseHoles, toNineType(round.nine_type)),
    selectedTee: round.selected_tee,
    handicapSource: round.handicap_source ?? 'profile',
    holesPlayed: round.holes_played ?? null,
  };
}
```

```ts
function computeUserMatchResult(
  scorecards: ScorecardForMatchPlay[],
  userId: string,
  holes: Hole[] | undefined
): { won: boolean; margin: string } | null {
  if (!holes || holes.length === 0 || scorecards.length !== 2) return null;
  const userIdx = scorecards.findIndex((s) => s.player_id === userId);

  );
```

Replace with:
```ts
function computeUserMatchResult(
  scorecards: ScorecardForMatchPlay[],
  userId: string,
  holes: Hole[] | undefined,
  holesPlayed: number | null = null
): { won: boolean; margin: string } | null {
  if (!holes || holes.length === 0 || scorecards.length !== 2) return null;
  const userIdx = scorecards.findIndex((s) => s.player_id === userId);
  if (userIdx === -1) return null;

  const result = computeStandaloneMatchResult(
    scorecards[0],
    scorecards[1],
    holes,
    holesPlayed
  );
```

**The rule applied here (scoring guardrail notes):**
- Anything that derives a daily handicap from Σpar, or decides a match against the planned length, gets the **planned** holes plus `holesPlayed`. Those are `RoundScorecardTab` (both views call `calculatePlayerStats`) and `MatchTab` → `MatchPlayScorecardTable`.
- Anything that only renders or iterates holes gets the **played** holes:
  - `StatsTab` (no handicap math);
  - the scramble tabs: `ScrambleTeamLeaderboard` takes its team handicap from member handicaps, and `ScrambleScorecardTable` receives `teamHandicap` as a prop;
  - shamble / scramble contributions (`useContributionData` uses raw player handicaps);
  - the shot picker.
- **Verified and intentionally unchanged:**
  - `StrokePlayLeaderboardTab` / `StablefordLeaderboardFull` / `ParLeaderboardFull` / `IndividualTeamLeaderboardTab` iterate holes but skip unscored ones, and take the DHC from `vm.leaderboardDailyHandicaps` (the stored `daily_handicap_used`). Scores after N are removed, so their totals already cover only the holes played.
  - `SkinsTab` `parValues` is a per-hole lookup.
  - `EditStatsModal` (see Follow-ups).

Create `src/screens/rounds/ViewRoundScreen/viewRoundHoles.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * The two hole lists ViewRound hands its tabs.
 *
 * - plannedHoles: the course narrowed to the round's nine_type. Anything that
 *   derives a daily handicap from Σpar, or decides a match against the planned
 *   length, gets these (plus holesPlayed). A played-only Σpar would inflate the
 *   daily handicap by tens of strokes.
 * - playedHoles: plannedHoles cut to rounds.holes_played when a social round
 *   was ended early (identical otherwise). Anything that only renders or
 *   iterates holes gets these.
 *
 * Display-time only: the course holes in the round payload stay intact.
 */

import { filterHolesByNineType, filterPlayableHoles } from '@/utils/holeTransformers';
import type { Hole } from '@/types';
import type { NineType } from '@/types/database/enums';

export interface ViewRoundHoles {
  plannedHoles: Hole[];
  playedHoles: Hole[];
  /** rounds.holes_played — null when the round was played as planned. */
  holesPlayed: number | null;
}

export function getViewRoundHoles(round: {
  nine_type?: NineType | null;
  holes_played?: number | null;
  course?: { holes?: Hole[] | null } | null;
}): ViewRoundHoles {
  const courseHoles = Array.isArray(round.course?.holes) ? round.course!.holes! : [];
  const nineType: NineType = round.nine_type ?? 'full';
  const holesPlayed = round.holes_played ?? null;
  return {
    plannedHoles: filterHolesByNineType(courseHoles, nineType),
    playedHoles: filterPlayableHoles(courseHoles, nineType, holesPlayed),
    holesPlayed,
  };
}
```

```tsx
/**
 * StatsTab — rendered holes for 9-hole and ended-early rounds. StatsTab does
 * no handicap math, so it simply renders the played holes.
 */
import React from 'react';
import { render, screen } from '@/__tests__/utils/renderHelpers';
import { StatsTab } from './StatsTab';
import { create18Holes } from '@/__tests__/utils/testFixtures';
import type { ScorecardTablePlayer } from '@/components/scorecard/ScorecardTable/types';

jest.mock('@/components/subscription/FeatureLockCompact', () => ({
  FeatureLockCompact: ({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) => children,
}));

const holes = create18Holes();
const STATS_OFF = {
  showPutts: false,
  showFairwayHit: false,
  showGreenInRegulation: false,
  showBunkerShots: false,
  showHazards: false,
};

/** One player who made bogey on each of `holeNumbers`. */
function soloPlayer(holeNumbers: number[]): ScorecardTablePlayer[] {
  const scores: Record<string, { strokes: number }> = {};
  for (const hole of holes.filter((h) => holeNumbers.includes(h.number))) {
    scores[String(hole.number)] = { strokes: hole.par + 1 };
  }
  return [{ id: 'sc-1', playerId: 'p1', player: { id: 'p1', name: 'Sam' }, scores, hasScorecard: true }];
}

describe('StatsTab hole rows', () => {
  it('renders OUT, IN and a 72 par total for a full round played as planned', () => {
    render(<StatsTab displayPlayers={soloPlayer([1, 2, 3])} holes={holes} statsVisibility={STATS_OFF} />);

    expect(screen.getByText('OUT')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText('IN')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText('72')).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('renders only holes 1–6 for a full round ended after 6', () => {
    // Pars 4,3,5,4,4,3 = 23; bogey on each = 29.
    render(
      <StatsTab
        displayPlayers={soloPlayer([1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6])}
        holes={holes}
        statsVisibility={STATS_OFF}
        holesPlayed={6}
      />
    );

    expect(screen.queryByText('IN')).toBeNull();
    expect(screen.queryByText('7')).toBeNull(); // hole 7 row is gone
    expect(screen.getAllByText('23')).toHaveLength(2); // OUT par + TOT par
    expect(screen.getAllByText('29')).toHaveLength(2); // OUT score + TOT score
  });

  it('renders holes 10–15 for a back-9 round ended after 6', () => {
    render(
      <StatsTab
        displayPlayers={soloPlayer([10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15])}
        holes={holes}
        statsVisibility={STATS_OFF}
        nineType="back9"
        holesPlayed={6}
      />
    );

    expect(screen.queryByText('OUT')).toBeNull();
    expect(screen.getByText('IN')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText('15')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.queryByText('16')).toBeNull();
  });
});
```

```ts
interface IndividualScorecardViewProps {
  displayPlayers: ScorecardTablePlayer[];
  /** Planned holes — the daily handicap and totals are computed over these. */
  holes: Hole[];
  /** Holes actually played — the only holes rendered (and summed for par).
   *  Equals `holes` unless the round was ended early. */
  playedHoles: Hole[];
  /** rounds.holes_played when the round was ended early, else null. */
  holesPlayed?: number | null;
  /** Selected tee data for daily handicap calculation */
  selectedTeeData?: TeeBox | null;
  /** Game type — used to hide the Stableford Pts row for stroke play */
  gameType?: string;
}

const IndividualScorecardView = React.memo(function IndividualScorecardView({
  displayPlayers,
  holes,
  playedHoles,
  holesPlayed = null,
  selectedTeeData,
  gameType,
}: IndividualScorecardViewProps) {
  const showStableford = gameType !== 'stroke';
  const colors = useThemeColors();

  // Render (and par-total) only the holes played; the math stays on the
  // planned holes so the daily handicap isn't derived from a short Σpar.
  const { front9, back9 } = useMemo(() => splitHolesByNine(playedHoles), [playedHoles]);
  const parTotals = useMemo(() => calculateParTotals(playedHoles), [playedHoles]);
  const playerStats = useMemo(
    () => calculatePlayerStats(displayPlayers, holes, selectedTeeData, undefined, { holesPlayed }),
    [displayPlayers, holes, selectedTeeData, holesPlayed]
  );
```

```ts
export function computeMatchPlaySubMatch(
  sides: SubMatchSides,
  holes: Hole[],
  getStrokes: GetStrokes
): MatchPlayRowData {
  const team1 = toMatchSide(sides.a, 'a');
  const team2 = toMatchSide(sides.b, 'b');
  const calc = calculateTeamMatchData(holes, team1, team2, getStrokes);
  // Pass holes.length as totalHoles so dormie/close-out is detected for the

```
Replace with:
```ts
/**
 * Live match-play row for one sub-match (or the synthesized team-vs-team row).
 * `holes` are the round's PLANNED holes. `holesPlayed` (rounds.holes_played)
 * settles an ended-early match on the final lead after that many holes, unless
 * it was already closed out against the planned length (calculateMatchStatus).
 */
export function computeMatchPlaySubMatch(
  sides: SubMatchSides,
  holes: Hole[],
  getStrokes: GetStrokes,
  holesPlayed: number | null = null
): MatchPlayRowData {
  const team1 = toMatchSide(sides.a, 'a');
  const team2 = toMatchSide(sides.b, 'b');
  const calc = calculateTeamMatchData(holes, team1, team2, getStrokes);
  // Pass holes.length (the planned count) as totalHoles so dormie/close-out is
  // detected for the round's actual hole count (the engine otherwise defaults
  // to 18), and holesPlayed so an ended-early match settles on its final lead.
  const status = calculateMatchStatus(calc.holeResults, holes.length, holesPlayed);
```

**`RoundSubMatchLeaderboard.tsx`**. Replace the whole file with:
```tsx
import React, { useCallback, useMemo } from 'react';
import { useRoundDetails, useRoundScorecards } from '@/hooks/rounds';
import { isSingleBallScore } from '@/types/database/base';
import { filterHolesByNineType } from '@/utils/holeTransformers';
import { SubMatchLeaderboardTab } from './SubMatchLeaderboardTab';
import { resolveSplitMatchDisplayPoints } from '@/screens/scoring/ReviewScorecardScreen/utils/subMatchLeaderboard';
import type { GameType, TeamFormat } from '@/types';
import type { NineType } from '@/types/database/enums';

interface RoundSubMatchLeaderboardProps {
  roundId: string;
  competitionId?: string | null;
  currentUserId?: string;
  isRefreshing?: boolean;
  onRefresh?: () => void;
  bottomInset?: number;
}

/**
 * Self-contained live sub-match leaderboard for a round. Sources holes / tee /
 * handicap source / game type from `useRoundDetails`, and per-hole strokes from
 * the round's server scorecards (`useRoundScorecards`). Drop it in anywhere with
 * a round id — used by the ViewRound Leaderboard tab, the ViewRound Match tab
 * for team match play, and the competition per-round leaderboard for split
 * alt-shot rounds.
 *
 * Holes are the round's PLANNED holes (the course narrowed to nine_type), with
 * the nine type and rounds.holes_played passed along so a 9-hole team match is
 * scored over 9 holes on 9-hole handicaps, and an ended-early social match
 * settles on its final lead. Competition rounds are always 'full', so they are
 * unchanged.
 */
export function RoundSubMatchLeaderboard({
  roundId,
  competitionId,
  currentUserId,
  isRefreshing = false,
  onRefresh,
  bottomInset = 0,
}: RoundSubMatchLeaderboardProps) {
  const { data: round } = useRoundDetails(roundId);
  const { data: scorecards } = useRoundScorecards(roundId);

  const nineType: NineType = round?.nine_type ?? 'full';
  const courseHoles = round?.course?.holes;
  const plannedHoles = useMemo(
    () => filterHolesByNineType(courseHoles ?? [], nineType),
    [courseHoles, nineType]
  );

  const matchPoints = resolveSplitMatchDisplayPoints({
    round_format: round?.round_format ?? null,
    rules_override: round?.rules_override ?? null,
  });

  const getStrokes = useCallback(
    (playerId: string, hole: number): number | undefined => {
      const sc = scorecards?.find((s) => s.player_id === playerId);
      const raw = sc?.scores?.[String(hole)];
      if (!raw) return undefined;
      return isSingleBallScore(raw) ? raw.strokes : raw.balls?.[0]?.strokes;
    },
    [scorecards]
  );

  return (
    <SubMatchLeaderboardTab
      roundId={roundId}
      getStrokes={getStrokes}
      competitionId={competitionId}
      gameType={(round?.game_type ?? 'alt-shot') as GameType}
      teamFormat={(round?.team_format ?? null) as TeamFormat | null}
      holes={plannedHoles}
      nineType={nineType}
      holesPlayed={round?.holes_played ?? null}
      currentUserId={currentUserId}
      selectedTeeData={round?.selected_tee ?? null}
      handicapSource={round?.handicap_source ?? undefined}
      isRefreshing={isRefreshing}
      onRefresh={onRefresh ?? (() => {})}
      bottomInset={bottomInset}
      scrollable={false}
      matchPoints={matchPoints}
    />
  );
}
```

```ts

/**
 * Keep only the decisions on holes the round actually played. A round ended
 * early can still hold decisions for later holes until the end_round_early
 * RPC trims them at submit, so displays ignore them.
 *
 * @param lastHoleNumber - The round's last played hole number
 *   (lastPlayedHoleNumber(nineType, holesPlayed)); null/undefined keeps all.
 */
export function filterDecisionsThroughHole<T extends Pick<WolfHoleDecision, 'hole_number'>>(
  decisions: T[],
  lastHoleNumber: number | null | undefined
): T[] {
  if (lastHoleNumber == null) return decisions;
  return decisions.filter((d) => d.hole_number <= lastHoleNumber);
}
```

Create `src/utils/wolf/summary.ts`:
```ts
/**
 * Wolf Game Summary
 *
 * Builds the display summary (standings, net results, hole counts) for a Wolf
 * game. Extracted unchanged from useWolfSummary's memo so it can be unit
 * tested, plus an optional cut to a round's last played hole (rounds ended
 * early).
 */

import type {
  WolfDecisionWithDetails,
  WolfGameSummary,
  WolfGameWithParticipants,
  WolfPayoutWithPlayer,
} from '@/types/database/wolf.types';
import { calculateWolfPayouts } from './payouts';
import {
  calculateWolfStandings,
  filterDecisionsThroughHole,
  getSortedStandings,
} from './standings';

export function buildWolfGameSummary(
  game: WolfGameWithParticipants,
  allDecisions: WolfDecisionWithDetails[],
  payouts: WolfPayoutWithPlayer[],
  lastHoleNumber: number | null = null
): WolfGameSummary {
  const decisions = filterDecisionsThroughHole(allDecisions, lastHoleNumber);

  // Create player name map
  const playerNames: Record<string, string> = {};
  for (const participant of game.participants) {
    playerNames[participant.id] = participant.name;
  }

  // Calculate standings
  const standingsMap = calculateWolfStandings(decisions, game.participant_ids);
  const standings = getSortedStandings(standingsMap, playerNames);

  // Calculate net_result for each standing entry when pot is enabled
  if (game.pot_enabled && game.pot_value_per_point) {
    const payoutCalcs = calculateWolfPayouts(standingsMap, game.pot_value_per_point);
    for (const entry of standings) {
      entry.net_result = payoutCalcs[entry.player_id]?.netResult ?? 0;
    }
  }

  // Count completed holes (have calculated_at) and decided holes
  const holesCompleted = decisions.filter((d) => d.calculated_at !== null).length;
  const holesDecided = decisions.filter((d) => d.decided_at !== null).length;

  return {
    game,
    decisions,
    payouts,
    standings,
    holes_completed: holesCompleted,
    holes_decided: holesDecided,
  };
}
```

`useWolfSummary` (517-568). Current:
```ts
/**
 * Query hook to fetch complete Wolf game summary
 *
 * Combines game, decisions, and payouts with calculated standings.
 *
 * @param gameId - Wolf game UUID
 * @returns Query result with WolfGameSummary
 */
export function useWolfSummary(gameId: string | undefined) {
  const gameQuery = useWolfGame(gameId);
  const decisionsQuery = useWolfHoleDecisions(gameId);
  const payoutsQuery = useWolfPayouts(gameId);

  const game = gameQuery.data;

  // Compute summary using useMemo
  const summary = useMemo((): WolfGameSummary | null => {
    if (!game) return null;
    const decisions = decisionsQuery.data ?? [];
    const payouts = payoutsQuery.data ?? [];

    // Create player name map
    const playerNames: Record<string, string> = {};
    for (const participant of game.participants) {
      playerNames[participant.id] = participant.name;
    }

    // Calculate standings
    const standingsMap = calculateWolfStandings(decisions, game.participant_ids);
    const standings = getSortedStandings(standingsMap, playerNames);

    // Calculate net_result for each standing entry when pot is enabled
    if (game.pot_enabled && game.pot_value_per_point) {
      const payoutCalcs = calculateWolfPayouts(standingsMap, game.pot_value_per_point);
      for (const entry of standings) {
        entry.net_result = payoutCalcs[entry.player_id]?.netResult ?? 0;
      }
    }

    // Count completed holes (have calculated_at) and decided holes
    const holesCompleted = decisions.filter((d) => d.calculated_at !== null).length;
    const holesDecided = decisions.filter((d) => d.decided_at !== null).length;

    return {
      game,
      decisions,
      payouts,
      standings,
      holes_completed: holesCompleted,
      holes_decided: holesDecided,
    };
  }, [game, decisionsQuery.data, payoutsQuery.data]);
```
Replace with:
```ts
/**
 * Query hook to fetch complete Wolf game summary
 *
 * Combines game, decisions, and payouts with calculated standings.
 *
 * @param gameId - Wolf game UUID
 * @param options.lastHoleNumber - The round's last played hole when it was
 *   ended early; decisions after it are ignored. Null/omitted = every hole.
 * @returns Query result with WolfGameSummary
 */
export function useWolfSummary(
  gameId: string | undefined,
  options?: { lastHoleNumber?: number | null }
) {
  const gameQuery = useWolfGame(gameId);
  const decisionsQuery = useWolfHoleDecisions(gameId);
  const payoutsQuery = useWolfPayouts(gameId);

  const game = gameQuery.data;
  const lastHoleNumber = options?.lastHoleNumber ?? null;

  // Compute summary using useMemo
  const summary = useMemo((): WolfGameSummary | null => {
    if (!game) return null;
    return buildWolfGameSummary(
      game,
      decisionsQuery.data ?? [],
      payoutsQuery.data ?? [],
      lastHoleNumber
    );
  }, [game, decisionsQuery.data, payoutsQuery.data, lastHoleNumber]);
```

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes:
  - `isEndedEarly(round: { holes_played?: number | null } | null | undefined): boolean` (B2, `src/utils/roundShape.ts`);
  - the `rounds.holes_played` column and `Round.holes_played` (B1).
- Produces:
  - `calculateBunkerStats(allScores: EnrichedHoleScore[], roundsPlayed: number, roundAverageScores?: EnrichedHoleScore[]): BunkerStats`;
  - `calculateHazardStats(allScores: EnrichedHoleScore[], roundsPlayed: number, roundAverageScores?: EnrichedHoleScore[]): HazardStats`.

  Omitting `roundAverageScores` gives output identical to today.

**Rules (spec §3 Stats and R11).** An early-ended card (`rounds.holes_played != null`):
- **counts** in `roundsPlayed` / `timesPlayed`;
- **keeps** every per-hole stat: distribution, par-type stats, FIR/GIR, putts per hole, the bunker/hazard per-hole totals and course hole stats;
- is **excluded** from:
  - the 18-hole and 9-hole buckets (average/best/worst, `nineHoleRoundsPlayed`, `averageNineHoleScore`, `bestNineHoleRound`, course best/worst/average);
  - `perRoundStats` → `roundTrends`;
  - putts per round (numerator and denominator);
  - the bunker/hazard per-round averages;
- **adds** its gross to the per-hole-average numerator through its own accumulator (its holes are already in the denominator);
- **appears** in `recentRounds` through its own summaries list.

In `src/hooks/playerStatistics/advancedHelpers.ts`, replace lines 106-132:

```ts
/**
 * Calculate bunker statistics
 */
export function calculateBunkerStats(
  allScores: EnrichedHoleScore[],
  roundsPlayed: number
): BunkerStats {
  let totalBunkerShots = 0;
  let holesWithBunkers = 0;
  let totalHolesTracked = 0;

  for (const score of allScores) {
    if (typeof score.bunkerShots === 'number') {
      totalHolesTracked++;
      totalBunkerShots += score.bunkerShots;
      if (score.bunkerShots > 0) holesWithBunkers++;
    }
  }

  return {
    totalBunkerShots,
    holesWithBunkers,
    totalHolesTracked,
    averageBunkerShotsPerRound:
      roundsPlayed > 0 && totalHolesTracked > 0
        ? Math.round((totalBunkerShots / roundsPlayed) * 10) / 10
        : null,
```

with:

```ts
/**
 * Calculate bunker statistics
 *
 * @param allScores - every hole score; drives the per-hole figures.
 * @param roundsPlayed - rounds in the per-round average's denominator.
 * @param roundAverageScores - hole scores feeding the per-round numerator.
 *   Defaults to `allScores`. Callers pass a subset (with a matching
 *   `roundsPlayed`) to keep early-ended rounds out of the per-round average.
 */
export function calculateBunkerStats(
  allScores: EnrichedHoleScore[],
  roundsPlayed: number,
  roundAverageScores: EnrichedHoleScore[] = allScores
): BunkerStats {
  let totalBunkerShots = 0;
  let holesWithBunkers = 0;
  let totalHolesTracked = 0;

  for (const score of allScores) {
    if (typeof score.bunkerShots === 'number') {
      totalHolesTracked++;
      totalBunkerShots += score.bunkerShots;
      if (score.bunkerShots > 0) holesWithBunkers++;
    }
  }

  let roundAverageBunkerShots = 0;
  for (const score of roundAverageScores) {
    if (typeof score.bunkerShots === 'number') roundAverageBunkerShots += score.bunkerShots;
  }

  return {
    totalBunkerShots,
    holesWithBunkers,
    totalHolesTracked,
    averageBunkerShotsPerRound:
      roundsPlayed > 0 && totalHolesTracked > 0
        ? Math.round((roundAverageBunkerShots / roundsPlayed) * 10) / 10
        : null,
```

```ts
// src/__tests__/hooks/playerStatistics/statsFixtures.ts
/**
 * Scorecard rows shared by the player/course statistics hook tests: a full
 * 18, a 9-hole round and a social round ended early after 6 holes — all
 * standalone, completed, on the same course.
 */
import { create18Holes } from '@/__tests__/utils/testFixtures';

export const PLAYER_ID = 'player-1';
export const COURSE_ID = 'course-1';

const HOLES = create18Holes();

export const range = (start: number, end: number): number[] =>
  Array.from({ length: end - start + 1 }, (_, i) => start + i);

interface StatsCardOptions {
  id: string;
  date: string;
  holeNumbers: number[];
  strokes: number;
  putts: number;
  /** Bunker shots recorded on every hole (omitted = not tracked). */
  bunkerShots?: number;
  /** Record a hazards array on every hole (empty except hole 1 when hazardOnFirstHole). */
  trackHazards?: boolean;
  hazardOnFirstHole?: boolean;
  holesPlayed: number | null;
  points: number;
}

export function buildStatsCard(opts: StatsCardOptions) {
  const scores: Record<string, Record<string, unknown>> = {};
  opts.holeNumbers.forEach((n, index) => {
    scores[String(n)] = {
      strokes: opts.strokes,
      putts: opts.putts,
      ...(opts.bunkerShots !== undefined && { bunkerShots: opts.bunkerShots }),
      ...(opts.trackHazards && {
        hazards: opts.hazardOnFirstHole && index === 0 ? [{ type: 'water' }] : [],
      }),
    };
  });
  return {
    id: opts.id,
    round_id: `round-${opts.id}`,
    player_id: PLAYER_ID,
    scores,
    total_gross: opts.strokes * opts.holeNumbers.length,
    total_net: 0,
    total_points: opts.points,
    status: 'completed',
    submitted_at: `${opts.date}T08:00:00Z`,
    rounds: {
      id: `round-${opts.id}`,
      competition_id: null,
      round_number: 1,
      course_id: COURSE_ID,
      date: opts.date,
      game_type: 'stroke',
      team_format: null,
      handicap_source: 'profile',
      status: 'completed',
      holes_played: opts.holesPlayed,
      courses: {
        id: COURSE_ID,
        name: 'Test Course',
        holes: HOLES,
        clubs: { id: 'club-1', name: 'Test Club' },
      },
      competitions: null,
    },
  };
}

/** 18 holes × 5 = 90; 2 putts and 0 bunker shots per hole; hazards tracked, none. */
export const FULL_CARD = buildStatsCard({
  id: 'full', date: '2026-09-01', holeNumbers: range(1, 18), strokes: 5, putts: 2,
  bunkerShots: 0, trackHazards: true, holesPlayed: null, points: 30,
});

/** 9 holes × 5 = 45; 2 putts per hole; bunkers/hazards not tracked. */
export const NINE_CARD = buildStatsCard({
  id: 'nine', date: '2026-09-05', holeNumbers: range(1, 9), strokes: 5, putts: 2,
  holesPlayed: null, points: 15,
});

/** Ended early after 6 holes: 6 × 4 = 24; 1 putt and 1 bunker shot per hole; water on hole 1. */
export const ENDED_EARLY_CARD = buildStatsCard({
  id: 'ended', date: '2026-09-10', holeNumbers: range(1, 6), strokes: 4, putts: 1,
  bunkerShots: 1, trackHazards: true, hazardOnFirstHole: true, holesPlayed: 6, points: 12,
});

export const STATS_CARDS = [FULL_CARD, NINE_CARD, ENDED_EARLY_CARD];

/** supabase.from() stub: every chain method passes through; awaiting resolves `result`. */
export function resolvingQuery(result: { data: unknown; error: unknown }) {
  const chain: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  const passthrough = () => chain;
  for (const method of ['select', 'eq', 'in', 'is', 'not', 'order', 'limit']) {
    chain[method] = passthrough;
  }
  chain.then = (resolve: (value: unknown) => unknown, reject?: (reason: unknown) => unknown) =>
    Promise.resolve(result).then(resolve, reject);
  return chain;
}
```

```tsx
// src/__tests__/hooks/playerStatistics/usePlayerStatistics.endedEarly.test.tsx
/**
 * usePlayerStatistics — early-ended social rounds (rounds.holes_played set).
 *
 * An early-ended round counts as a round played and feeds every per-hole
 * metric, but stays out of every per-round aggregate: the 18- and 9-hole
 * buckets, the trend sparkline and the per-round putts / bunker / hazard
 * averages. It still shows in recent rounds.
 */
import React from 'react';
import { renderHook, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react-native';
import { QueryClient, QueryClientProvider } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { usePlayerStatistics } from '@/hooks/playerStatistics/queries';
import type { PlayerStatistics } from '@/hooks/playerStatistics/types';
import { PLAYER_ID, STATS_CARDS, resolvingQuery } from './statsFixtures';

const mockFrom = jest.fn();
jest.mock('@/services/supabase/client', () => ({
  supabase: { from: (...args: unknown[]) => mockFrom(...args) },
}));

function makeWrapper() {
  const queryClient = new QueryClient({ defaultOptions: { queries: { retry: false } } });
  return function Wrapper({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
    return <QueryClientProvider client={queryClient}>{children}</QueryClientProvider>;
  };
}

async function loadStats(): Promise<PlayerStatistics> {
  mockFrom.mockImplementation((table: string) =>
    resolvingQuery(
      table === 'scorecards' ? { data: STATS_CARDS, error: null } : { data: [], error: null },
    ),
  );
  const { result } = renderHook(() => usePlayerStatistics(PLAYER_ID), { wrapper: makeWrapper() });
  await waitFor(() => expect(result.current.isSuccess).toBe(true));
  return result.current.data!;
}

describe('usePlayerStatistics — early-ended rounds', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    mockFrom.mockReset();
  });

  it('counts the early-ended round and its holes in every per-hole stat (locks current behaviour)', async () => {
    const stats = await loadStats();

    expect(stats.roundsPlayed).toBe(3);
    expect(stats.holesPlayed).toBe(33);
    expect(stats.averageGrossScore).toBe(90);
    // (90 + 45 + 24) / 33 holes
    expect(stats.averageScorePerHole).toBe(4.82);
    // 60 putts / 33 holes
    expect(stats.averagePuttsPerHole).toBe(1.82);
    expect(stats.bunkerStats.totalBunkerShots).toBe(6);
    expect(stats.hazardStats.totalHazards).toBe(1);
    expect(stats.recentRounds.map((r) => r.roundId)).toEqual([
      'round-ended',
      'round-nine',
      'round-full',
    ]);
  });

  it('keeps the early-ended round out of the 9-hole bucket', async () => {
    const stats = await loadStats();

    // Before: 2 rounds / 34.5 / 'round-ended' — the 6-hole card was bucketed as a 9-hole round.
    expect(stats.nineHoleRoundsPlayed).toBe(1);
    expect(stats.averageNineHoleScore).toBe(45);
    expect(stats.bestNineHoleRound?.roundId).toBe('round-nine');
  });

  it('keeps the early-ended round out of the trend sparkline', async () => {
    const stats = await loadStats();

    expect(stats.roundTrends.map((t) => t.roundId)).toEqual(['round-full', 'round-nine']);
  });

  it('leaves the early-ended round out of the per-round putts, bunker and hazard averages', async () => {
    const stats = await loadStats();

    // Before: 60 / 3 = 20, 6 / 3 = 2, 1 / 3 = 0.3.
    expect(stats.averagePuttsPerRound).toBe(27); // (60 − 6) / 2
    expect(stats.bunkerStats.averageBunkerShotsPerRound).toBe(0);
    expect(stats.hazardStats.averageHazardsPerRound).toBe(0);
  });
});
```

```tsx
/**
 * useCourseStatistics — early-ended social rounds follow the same rules as
 * usePlayerStatistics: counted and in every per-hole stat, out of every
 * per-round aggregate, still in recent rounds.
 */
import React from 'react';
import { renderHook, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react-native';
import { QueryClient, QueryClientProvider } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { useCourseStatistics } from '@/hooks/playerStatistics/courseQueries';
import type { CourseStatisticsData } from '@/hooks/playerStatistics/types';
import { COURSE_ID, PLAYER_ID, STATS_CARDS, resolvingQuery } from './statsFixtures';

const mockFrom = jest.fn();
jest.mock('@/services/supabase/client', () => ({
  supabase: { from: (...args: unknown[]) => mockFrom(...args) },
}));

function makeWrapper() {
  const queryClient = new QueryClient({ defaultOptions: { queries: { retry: false } } });
  return function Wrapper({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
    return <QueryClientProvider client={queryClient}>{children}</QueryClientProvider>;
  };
}

async function loadCourseStats(): Promise<CourseStatisticsData> {
  mockFrom.mockImplementation(() => resolvingQuery({ data: STATS_CARDS, error: null }));
  const { result } = renderHook(() => useCourseStatistics(PLAYER_ID, COURSE_ID), {
    wrapper: makeWrapper(),
  });
  await waitFor(() => expect(result.current.isSuccess).toBe(true));
  return result.current.data!;
}

describe('useCourseStatistics — early-ended rounds', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    mockFrom.mockReset();
  });

  it('counts the early-ended round and its holes in every per-hole stat (locks current behaviour)', async () => {
    const stats = await loadCourseStats();

    expect(stats.timesPlayed).toBe(3);
    expect(stats.averageGrossScore).toBe(90);
    expect(stats.bestGrossScore).toBe(90);
    expect(stats.averageScorePerHole).toBe(4.82);
    expect(stats.averagePuttsPerHole).toBe(1.82);
    expect(stats.bunkerStats.totalBunkerShots).toBe(6);
    expect(stats.holeStats.find((h) => h.holeNumber === 1)?.timesPlayed).toBe(3);
    expect(stats.recentRounds.map((r) => r.roundId)).toEqual([
      'round-ended',
      'round-nine',
      'round-full',
    ]);
  });

  it('keeps the early-ended round out of the trend sparkline', async () => {
    const stats = await loadCourseStats();

    expect(stats.roundTrends.map((t) => t.roundId)).toEqual(['round-full', 'round-nine']);
  });

  it('leaves the early-ended round out of the per-round putts, bunker and hazard averages', async () => {
    const stats = await loadCourseStats();

    // Before: 20, 2, 0.3.
    expect(stats.averagePuttsPerRound).toBe(27);
    expect(stats.bunkerStats.averageBunkerShotsPerRound).toBe(0);
    expect(stats.hazardStats.averageHazardsPerRound).toBe(0);
  });
});
```
